items.name: 黑石
items.description:
让力道急升的怪石，不知是天外陨铁，还是地心凝华，可从里武林深处带来力量，一物难求。

永久提升10%攻击力及破防力。
effects: 永久提升10%攻击力及破防力。
items.description_en:
A mysterious black stone that greatly enhances physical strength. Whether it is meteoric iron from beyond the sky or a crystalline formation from within the earth's core remains unknown. It can draw power from the depths of the Discordance and is exceedingly rare.

Permanently increases Attack and Guard Break by 10%.

items.name: 黑石碎片
items.description:
形态奇异的黑色碎片，非金非玉，入手生温，若能集得四块，便可依其天然纹路彼此相扣，合而为一。

集齐四块碎片可永久提升10%攻击力及破防力。
effects: 集齐四块碎片可永久提升10%攻击力及破防力。
items.description_en:
A strangely shaped black fragment, neither metal nor jade, warm to the touch. Gather four, and their natural patterns will align to form a whole.

Collect 4 fragments to permanently increase Attack and Guard Break by 10%.

items.name: 杀气琥珀
items.description:
封存着锐利杀气的透色琥珀，危险而易碎，但真正能够驾驭杀气的强者，总会将其间力量运用自如。

永久提升10%杀气值上限。
effects: 永久提升10%杀气值上限。
items.description_en:
A translucent amber that seals away piercing Sha-Chi. Though fragile and dangerous, those with true command of Sha-Chi can harness its power with ease.

Permanently increases maximum Sha-Chi by 10%.

items.name: 杀气琥珀碎片
items.description:
杀气琥珀散碎的一片，逸散的杀气会被其吸纳其中，却也会自其缺裂处流散而去。

集齐四块碎片能够提升10%杀气值上限。
effects: 集齐四块碎片能够提升10%杀气值上限。
items.description_en:
A fragment of shattered Sha-Chi Amber. It absorbs stray Sha-Chi from its surroundings, though much of that power also leaks away through its cracks.

Collect all four fragments to increase maximum Sha-Chi by 10%.

items.name: 杀气核心
items.description:
庞镇强力怪面体内取代了心脏的杀气装置，用以试验增强力量的同时，抑止杀气暴动。此刻，它仍正源源不断地吞吐着杀气。

或许，能作为某种机关的动力之源。
items.description_en:
A Sha-Chi device implanted in place of the heart of one of Pangzhen's powerful Maskwalkers. Developed to test whether strength could be enhanced while suppressing violent Sha-Chi surges, it continues to draw in and release Sha-Chi even now.

Perhaps it could serve as a power source for some mechanism.

items.name: 榕树之心
items.description:
暗红色的心脏状结块，表面布满血管状的根须纹理。握于手中，可隐约感受到微弱而规律的跳动。

可用于解锁“能力修行”中的特殊能力。
effects: 可用于解锁“能力修行”中的特殊能力。
items.description_en:
A dark crimson, heart-shaped growth covered in vein-like roots. Held in the hand, a faint, steady pulse can be felt within.

Used to unlock special abilities in Ability Training.

items.description_en: Required to upgrade One-Handed weapons to Lv. 10.

items.description_en: Required to upgrade Destruction-type Phantom Edges from Lv. 20 to max level.

items.description_en: Required to upgrade Artifice-type Phantom Edges to Lv. 10.

items.name: 精密机关齿轮
items.description: “奇门”类影之武装从10级升至20级所需的通用材料。
items.description_en: Required to upgrade Artifice-type Phantom Edges from Lv. 10-20.

items.description_en: Required to upgrade Artifice-type Phantom Edges from Lv. 20 to max level.

items.description: “远程”类影之武装升至10级所需的材料。
items.description_en: Required to upgrade Ranged-type Phantom Edges to Lv. 10.

items.name: 天樟古木
items.description: “远程”类影之武装从10级升至20级所需的通用材料。
items.description_en: Required to upgrade Ranged-type Phantom Edges from Lv. 10-20.

items.name: 禁忌天樟古木
items.description: “远程”类影之武装从20级升至满级所需的通用材料。
items.description_en: Required to upgrade Ranged-type Phantom Edges from Lv. 20 to max level.

items.name: 招魂香灰
items.description: “召唤”类影之武装升至10 级所需的材料。
items.description_en: Required to upgrade Summon-type Phantom Edges to Lv. 10.

items.name: 迷幻香灰
items.description: “召唤”类影之武装从10级升至20级所需的通用材料。
items.description_en: Required to upgrade Summon-type Phantom Edges from Lv. 10-20.

items.name: 供奉圣母的香灰
items.description: “召唤”类影之武装从20级升至满级所需的通用材料。
items.description_en: Required to upgrade Summon-type Phantom Edges from Lv. 20 to max level.

items.name: 污秽残晶
items.description:
天然形成未经雕琢淬炼的原晶，虽带有诸多矿物杂质，但适宜研磨成粉，用以打磨珠宝饰品。

饰品首次打磨所需材料。
effects: 饰品首次打磨所需材料。
items.description_en:
A naturally formed crystal untouched by carving or refinement. Though laden with mineral impurities, it is ideal for grinding into powder to polish jewelry and accessories.

Required to polish an accessory for the first time.

items.name: 提纯靛晶
items.description:
纯净的靛色晶石。研成的粉末细腻通透，以此打磨饰品，可彰其本真而不致流于矫饰，甚为武林清流所喜。

饰品二次打磨所需材料。
effects: 饰品二次打磨所需材料。
items.description_en:
A pure indigo crystal refined time and again to remove impurities. Ground into a fine, translucent powder, it reveals an accessory's natural brilliance without excessive embellishment, making it highly prized throughout the Wulin.

Required to polish an accessory for the second time.

items.name: 学徒药师记忆
items.description:
那是初入医门时许下的誓言。以一双手，怀满腔热望，渡万人疾苦。

药瓶升至2级所需的材料。
effects: 药瓶升至2级所需的材料。
items.description_en:
That was the vow they made when they first took up the healer's path. With nothing but their hands and a heart full of hope, they would ease the suffering of countless souls.

Required to upgrade Medicine to Lv. 2.

items.name: 熟练药师记忆
items.description:
那是日复一日的积累与缺憾。救下之人的面孔已渐渐模糊，失去的人却总是历历在目。

药瓶从2级升至4级所需的材料。
effects: 药瓶从2级升至4级所需的材料。
items.description_en:
Knowledge and regret, gathered day after day. The faces of those saved slowly fade from memory; those lost remain painfully clear.

Required to upgrade Medicine from Lv. 2-4.

items.name: 大师药师记忆
items.description:
那是世事沉浮皆未磨灭的疏狂与执妄。阎王欲取三更命，我偏留人过五更。

药瓶从4级升至满级所需的材料。
effects: 药瓶从4级升至满级所需的材料。
items.description_en:
A wild defiance and stubborn conviction that no turn of fortune could ever wear away. If death comes to claim a life at midnight, I'll keep it alive till dawn.

Required to upgrade Medicine from Lv. 4 to max level.

items.name: 兵刃逆炼符
items.description:
明黄符纸之上，朱砂浓墨绘就刀剑纹路，笔锋凌厉。便是再锋锐的绝世兵刃，遇之也会褪去千锤百炼的锋芒。

武器回退至初始等级所需符纸。
effects: 武器回退至初始等级所需符纸。
items.description_en:
Across its golden paper, bold vermilion ink forms blade patterns in sharp, forceful strokes. Even the sharpest weapon loses the edge forged through countless hammer blows when touched by this talisman.

A talisman used to restore a weapon to its initial level.

items.name: 影之消退符
items.description:
暗紫色的符纸上，荧绿色的奇墨寥寥数笔，便勾勒出了弓斧之形。可逆转影之武装中所蕴含的力量。

影之武装回退至初始等级所需符纸。
effects: 影之武装回退至初始等级所需符纸。
items.description_en:
A dark violet talisman marked with just a few strokes of luminous green ink, forming the shapes of a bow and axe. It reverses the power within a Phantom Edge, restoring it to an earlier state.

A talisman used to restore a Phantom Edge to its initial level.

items.name: 穿行符
items.description:
纹裂间透出斑斓虹彩的木符。将其击碎可令异力迸发，打开一条里武林通路，以供快速穿行至其他地点。

未在铃铛附近时，可消耗此护符，穿行至已敲响过的铃铛处。
items.description_en:
A wooden talisman with iridescent hues shining through its cracks. Shattering it unleashes a strange force that opens a path through the Discordance, allowing you to traverse to other locations.

When away from a Bell, consume this Talisman to travel to any previously rung Bell.

items.name: 双生血肉花
items.description:
一对并蒂双生的白花，形态几近完全相同。

每一片花瓣都饱满而张扬，呈现出螺钿般的绚丽，摇曳着血液般甜腻的芬芳。
items.description_en:
A pair of white blossoms blooming from the same stem, almost identical in form.

Each petal is lush and vibrant, shimmering with an iridescent sheen. As they sway, an overly sweet fragrance wafts, reminiscent of blood.

items.name: 一朵血肉花
items.description:
一朵怒放的白花，与给玉儿的那一朵形态几近完全相同。

每一片花瓣都饱满而张扬，呈现出螺钿般的绚丽，摇曳着血液般甜腻的芬芳。
items.description_en:
A white blossom in full bloom, nearly identical in form to the one given to Yu'er.

Each petal is lush and vibrant, shimmering with an iridescent sheen. As it sways, an overly sweet fragrance wafts, reminiscent of blood.

items.name: 鲜红的血肉花
items.description: 玉儿掉落的血肉花，花瓣鲜艳如血，泛着腐败的血腥气味。
items.description_en: Yu'er dropped this Flesh Lily. Its petals are as bright as blood, reeking of decay.

items.name: 金创草
items.description:
玉儿所需的三味药材之一。

叶片细长，边缘微卷，像沾了露水的柳叶。
items.row_name: 玉儿需要的药材1-金创草
items.description_en:
One of the three medicinal herbs Yu'er needs.

Its slender leaves curl gently at the edges, like willow leaves touched with dew.

items.name: 凝脂叶
items.description:
玉儿所需的三味药材之一。

叶如其名，厚实饱满，揉碎后有淡淡清香。
items.row_name: 玉儿需要的药材2-凝脂叶
items.description_en:
One of the three medicinal herbs Yu'er needs.

True to its name, the leaves are thick and supple, releasing a faint, refreshing fragrance when crushed.

items.name: 止血藤
items.description:
玉儿所需的三味药材之一。

藤蔓纤细而韧，折断处会渗出暗红色汁液，有止血之效。
items.row_name: 玉儿需要的药材3-止血藤
items.description_en:
One of the three medicinal herbs Yu'er needs.

Its vines are slender yet resilient. The dark crimson sap that seeps from them when snapped is known to stem bleeding.

items.name: 玉儿所制的保命丹
items.description:
色泽温润的朱红色丸药，带着淡淡的幽香，那是玉儿特意在其中加入的安神草药的味道。

服下后可快速止血，令伤口迅速愈合，同时温补经脉，恢复气力。
items.description_en:
A vermilion pill with a warm, lustrous sheen and a faint fragrance from the calming herbs Yu'er added to it.

Once taken, it quickly staunches bleeding and mends wounds, while nourishing the meridians and restoring strength.

items.name: 三头小娃娃
items.description:
掌心大小的怪异布偶。圆润的身躯上，顶着三颗并排的小脑袋。

左首闭目沉睡，右首满面不安与瑟缩，而中间的脑袋则下巴微昂，目光凌厉。
items.description_en:
A strange cloth doll small enough to rest in one palm, with three little heads lined up atop its rounded body.

The leftmost sleeps with its eyes closed; the right draws in on itself, uneasy and timid. The middle alone holds its chin slightly raised, its gaze piercing.

items.name: 一串念珠
items.description:
朴素的木质念珠。据说，诵经万遍，便可得一分功德。它的主人究竟念诵了多少遍经文？又在等待中度过了多少个日夜？

再无人能回答了。持有这串念珠的僧人，如今已成非人之物。
items.description_en:
A simple set of wooden prayer beads. It is said that ten thousand recitations of the sutras earn a measure of merit. How many times did their owner recite them? How many nights passed in waiting?

No one is left to answer these questions; the monk who once carried these beads has become something no longer human.

items.name: 彩色的风车
items.description: 五颜六色的风车。不为此间凶险、人世悲苦所扰。只要迎着风，便会欢快地旋转起来。
items.description_en: A bright and colorful pinwheel, untroubled by the dangers of this world or the sorrows of human life. So long as the wind continues to blow, it will spin with carefree delight.

items.name: 断弦的羽弓
items.description:
羽弓客所用的长弓，弓臂处已被摩挲得油亮，依稀可见昔日挽弓者为其倾注的心血。

如今弓弦崩断了，或许驿站中的老弓手能将它修好。
items.description_en:
A longbow once used by the Old Archer's disciples. Its limbs have been polished smooth by years of use, still bearing traces of the care it once received.

Now that the bowstring has snapped, perhaps the Old Archer at the outpost can repair it.

items.name: 浑源石
items.description:
表面遍布裂纹却永不碎裂的奇石，炽热的光芒在纹隙间缓缓流淌。

此乃杀气改造塔的动力之源。据说食用后可摆脱“楔子”的控制，令人神志清明，不再浑噩度日。
items.description_en:
A strange stone covered in cracks, yet impossible to shatter. A molten glow flows slowly through the fissures.

The power source of the Sha-Chi Tower. It is said that consuming it can free one from the Mindseal's control and restore clarity of mind.

items.name: 锈蚀的龙形钥匙
items.description:
栩栩如生的龙形钥匙。尽管镶于龙目的宝石早已遗失，黄金制成的龙鳞也被人为剥离，然从锈迹覆盖的龙身上，依稀可见昔日持有者的繁盛。

它所能开启的那扇龙纹之门背后，究竟尘封着什么？
items.description_en:
A key fashioned in the shape of a Loong. The gem that once sat in its eye is long gone, and the golden scales have been stripped away by human hands. Yet beneath the rust, the key still hints at the prosperity of its former owner.

What is sealed away behind the gate it was made to open?

items.name: 杀气炉探火孔开关
items.description: 满是油污的圆形开关，在高温的熏烤下已有些许形变。手柄处刻着一行小字：杀气锻造炉底层二号探火孔控制台。
items.description_en: A grease-stained round crank, slightly warped by unrelenting heat. Small lettering is engraved on the handle: "Inspection Port No. 2 Control Console, Lower Level, Sha-Chi Forging Furnace."

items.name: 牢门钥匙
items.description:
遗落在正道弟子衣袋里的牢房门钥匙，不知对应的牢房会位于溪谷驿站何处。

时至今日，武林正道仍对“杀气改造”束手无策。一旦发现同道遭到改造，哪怕仍有神志尚存，关押监禁仍是杜绝后患的上策。
items.description_en:
A prison key found in the pocket of a Mandate disciple. It is unclear which cell in the Valley Outpost it unlocks.

To this day, the Mandate has found no answer to Transcension. Once they find one of their own undergoes Transcension, confinement remains the safest option, even if they are still lucid.

items.name: 杀气塔底营地外门钥匙
items.name_en: SHA-CHI TOWER BASE CAMP GATE KEY
items.raw_name: 杀气塔底营地外门钥匙
items.description:
一把勉强拼合起来的钥匙。原本的钥匙已经断折，齿部被草草接在一截轴承之上。

能够打开通往杀气塔底的营地围栏。
items.row_name: 杀气塔底营地外门钥匙
items.description_en:
A crudely pieced-together key. The original had snapped, and its teeth were hastily fastened onto a short metal shaft.

Opens the camp gate leading to the base of the Sha-Chi Tower.

items.name: 飞贼的秘籍
items.description:
飞贼的遗物，一本用粗线胡乱装订的薄册。

封皮为羊皮鞣制，无字。内页纸张泛黄脆硬，边缘多有焦痕与污渍，却不见虫蛀，似是用避蠹的草药汁液处理过。翻开扉页，上书五个大字：《探囊取物手》。
items.description_en:
A thief's keepsake, a thin booklet crudely bound with coarse thread.

The cover is of tanned, unmarked sheepskin. Within, the pages have yellowed and grown brittle, their edges scorched and stained. Strangely, they bear no trace of insect damage, perhaps preserved by an herbal treatment.
On the first page, five large characters give its title: "Seizing Hand."

items.name: 血色森林坑道开关
items.description: 从人屠子的肉案边发现的坑道开关，或许可以打开另一处可怖的坑道。
items.description_en: A crank found beside the Butcher's chopping block. Perhaps it opens another grisly underground passage.

items.name: 飞贼营地地牢钥匙
items.description: 粗铁钥匙，齿纹歪斜，应是勉强可以打开一扇监牢的门。
items.description_en: A crude iron key with crooked teeth. It should be just enough to open a prison cell door.

items.name: 林中驿站院门钥匙
items.description: 这驿站也曾炊烟袅袅，孩童的笑声与马蹄声交织，驿站的老板娘会在门口迎候南来北往的旅人。那时候，这钥匙就挂在她腰上。
items.description_en: Smoke once curled from the chimneys of this Outpost, children's laughter mingled with the sound of hoofbeats, and the innkeeper would wait by the door to welcome travelers from near and far. Back then, this key hung at her waist.

items.name: 洞窟监牢牢房钥匙
items.description:
一把锈迹斑驳的黄铜钥匙，齿槽间仍残留着陈年的矿尘。

从前，正道弟子在此修建牢房，关押进行了杀气改造的同道。而今，山贼、马匪占据了这处洞窟，将抓获的武林正道关押于此。
items.description_en:
A tarnished brass key, with old mine dust remaining in its grooves.

Long ago, disciples of the Mandate built these cells to confine their own who had undergone Transcension. Now, the cave has fallen into the hands of bandits, imprisoning captured righteous path fighters in these cells.

items.name: 血色森林山舍地窖开关
items.raw_name: 血色森林山舍地窖开关
items.description:
从血色森林山舍二层发现的虎首开关，槽口中依旧残存着些许毒气。

尸横遍地，哀声不绝……破屋之下的地窖中，究竟隐藏着怎样的秘密？
items.description_en:
A tiger-headed crank found on the second floor of a mountain cabin in the Crimson Forest. Traces of toxic gas still linger in its socket.

Corpses lie strewn about, while mournful cries never cease... What secrets lie in the cellar beneath the ruined cabin?

items.name: 血色森林山舍机关密室开关
items.raw_name: 血色森林山舍机关密室开关
items.description:
被一名白山派女弟子死死攥在手心的铁质开关，似乎可以打开某处密门。

从那只僵硬苍白的手中取出时，似乎仍残留着一丝余温。
items.row_name: 山尖小屋机关密室钥匙
items.description_en:
An iron crank clenched tightly in the hand of a Baishan disciple. It appears to open a secret door somewhere.

Taken from her stiff, pale hand, the crank still holds some warmth.

items.name: 血色森林杀气塔顶层钥匙
items.raw_name: 血色森林杀气塔顶层钥匙
items.description:
由某种残损零件熔炼重铸而成的钥匙，钥齿处却满是凹痕，像被什么腐蚀过一般。

能够打开通往血色森林杀气塔顶层的门。
items.row_name: 血色森林杀气塔缺失的开关
items.description_en:
A key reforged from the remnants of broken parts. Its teeth are strangely pitted as though eaten away by corrosion.

Opens the door to the top level of the Crimson Forest Sha-Chi Tower.

items.name: 破损的幻术琵琶
items.description: 残破不堪的幻术琵琶，缺少琴弦、琴头与背板，仅余琴颈至琴相处的一段，却依旧能发出微弱的、不属于现世的嗡鸣。
items.description_en: A badly damaged Illusory Pipa, missing its strings, head, and backplate. Only part of the neck and upper body remains, but it still emits a faint, otherworldly hum.

items.name: 幻术琵琶的背板
items.description:
弦者的幻术琵琶背板，自琴品处断裂。然留在漆面上的幽绿色花卉，依旧如梦似幻，栩栩如生。

只有三姐妹中的幻鬼能够拼凑出完整的琵琶，若集齐幻术琵琶的三个零件，便去庞镇的酒馆找她吧。
items.description_en:
The backplate of the Chord's Illusory Pipa, broken near the frets. The green flowers on its lacquered surface remain as vivid and dreamlike as ever.

Only Myst of the Three Sisters can restore the pipa. Once all three pieces of the Illusory Pipa have been collected, seek her out at the tavern in Pangzhen.

items.name: 幻术琵琶的琴头
items.description:
造型婀娜的琴头，曾被梦差作为信物寄给至高者，后被荡秽暗中夺得。

轻抚琴轸时，指尖会传来若有若无的震颤，仿佛弦虽不在，音犹未散。
items.description_en:
The elegantly shaped headstock of the Illusory Pipa. The Herald once sent it to the High Elder as a token before it was secretly taken by Dusk.

A light touch on the tuning pegs sends a faint tremor through your fingertips. Though the strings are gone, their sound has yet to fade.

items.name: 幻术琵琶的琴弦
items.description:
烟千岁既败，她的古琴却乍现溢彩流光，原来，她将至高者所赐的幻术琵琶琴弦，缀于自己随身的古琴之上。

只有三姐妹中的幻鬼能够拼凑出完整的琵琶，若集齐幻术琵琶的三个零件，便去找她一趟吧。
items.description_en:
After Yan Qiansui's defeat, her zither shimmered with iridescent radiance, revealing that she had strung it with the Illusory Pipa's strings, bestowed by the High Elder.

Only Myst of the Three Sisters can restore the Illusory Pipa. Once all three pieces of the Illusory Pipa have been collected, seek her out.

items.name: 染血印章
items.description:
寿山石雕就的方印，为一派掌门信物。然印角一片殷红，洇入石纹，也不知是争印之人的，还是护印之人的。

似为稀世珍宝，可在妙手小张处换得实用之物。
items.description_en:
A square seal carved from Shoushan stone, the token of a sect master. One corner is stained with blood, the deep crimson seeping into the stone. No one can say whether the blood was shed by the one who sought to seize the seal or by the one who fought to protect it.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

items.name: 掌门鼻烟壶
items.description:
以整块金珀掏膛而成的鼻烟壶。为某正道掌门从弟子处没收之物。那掌门素来训诫门下“绝五欲、远六尘”，然独处之时，却常把玩此类器物聊以消遣。

似为稀世珍宝，可在妙手小张处换得实用之物。
items.description_en:
A snuff bottle hollowed from a single piece of golden amber, confiscated from a Mandate disciple by a sect leader. The sect leader often admonished his disciples "to renounce worldly desires and temptations", yet in private, he would amuse himself with objects like this.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

items.name: 古代弩机
items.description:
精铜铸造的弩机，廓、牙、望山、悬刀四部衔接严密，扣发精准。世人视之为古代机关术之巅峰，争相求购，以彰慕古崇技之风雅，殊不知在久远年代，这不过是无数寻常弩机中的一件。

似为稀世珍宝，可在妙手小张处换得实用之物。
items.description_en:
A crossbow mechanism cast from fine bronze, its components fitted together with remarkable precision for a smooth, accurate release. Today, it is regarded as the pinnacle of ancient Engine Arts and eagerly sought after as a symbol of refined taste and appreciation for ancient craftsmanship. Few realize that long ago, it was merely one of countless ordinary crossbow mechanisms.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

items.name: 洞房花烛
items.description:
五彩蜜蜡精制而成的洞房喜烛，似乎已为那场喜宴守候多年。于烛身蹁跹的双鹊依旧鲜艳夺目，只是一侧鹊目处，不知何时渗出了一颗蜡泪，凝而不落。

似为稀世珍宝，可在妙手小张处换得实用之物。
items.description_en:
A pair of wedding candles finely crafted from multicolored beeswax, seemingly waiting all these years for that wedding feast. The two magpies dancing across the candles remain as vibrant as ever. Yet at the corner of one magpie's eye rests a single waxen tear, formed at some unknown time and frozen in place before it could fall.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

items.name: 双童玉佩
items.description:
羊脂白玉透雕而成的双童憨态可掬，嬉戏于田田莲叶之间，寓意“连生贵子”，乃陆氏宗族世代相传的信物。然其最后一任主人，却是位一生都无妻无子的孤家寡人。

似为稀世珍宝，可在妙手小张处换得实用之物。
items.description_en:
A pendant intricately carved from fine white jade, depicting two cheerful children at play among lush lotus leaves, a traditional blessing for many generations of children. Passed down through the Lu family for generations, it ultimately came into the hands of a man who lived and died alone, without a wife or children.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

items.name: 尚未蒙花的雕像
items.description:
整块黄花梨雕琢而成的菩萨坐像，姿态安然，眉眼悲悯。村中神像皆被陆氏村民用红花遮面，奉为“蒙花圣母”，唯独这一尊，见证着一场无声的抵抗。

似为稀世珍宝，可在妙手小张处换得实用之物。
items.description_en:
A seated Bodhisattva carved from a single piece of huanghuali wood, serene in posture with a compassionate gaze. The Lu Villagers have covered the faces of every other statue with red flowers, worshipping them as the "Lady of the Veil." This one alone remains uncovered, bearing silent witness to an act of resistance.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

items.name: 玉笔架
items.description:
祥云纹青玉笔，配着青山玉笔架。是早年间，阔老爷从哪位落魄的寒门状元手里得来的宝贝。那状元后来的境遇无人记得，而这玉笔，终日卧在少爷的案头，再未吐露过半句锦绣章文。

似为稀世珍宝，可在妙手小张处换得实用之物。
items.description_en:
A blue-green jade brush carved with auspicious cloud motifs, paired with a mountain-shaped jade brush rest. Years ago, a wealthy patron acquired the set from an impoverished scholar who had placed first in the imperial examinations. No one remembers what became of the scholar. The jade brush, meanwhile, has spent its days lying on the young master's desk, never again putting a single elegant line to paper.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

items.name: 虎型镇纸
items.description:
纯金铸就的卧虎镇纸，覆着喜庆的朱漆。原是某位明姓掌门赐予天香阁一位画娘的大手笔。奈何这乱世里，一朝是压在画纸上人人艳羡的彩头，一夕是压在人心上催命的符咒。

似为稀世珍宝，可在妙手小张处换得实用之物。
items.description_en:
A reclining tiger paperweight cast from solid gold and finished in festive vermilion lacquer. It was once a lavish gift from a sect leader surnamed Ming to a painter at Tianxiang Pavilion. But in times of chaos, fortunes can turn overnight: one day, it was an enviable treasure holding down a sheet of paper; the next, a deadly burden weighing on its owner's heart.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

items.name: 墨
items.description:
蝉蜕状的药墨锭。昔年某位乡绅答谢将军武轩及其麾下抗击怪面的赠礼。只是，此药实在难治一众残缺之躯，又怎能比得龙体改造那般立竿见影？

似为稀世珍宝，可在妙手小张处换得实用之物。
items.description_en:
A medicinal ink stick shaped like a cicada shell. Years ago, a local landowner presented it to General Wu Xuan and his men in gratitude for their defense against the Maskwalkers. But this medicine could do little to mend so many broken bodies. How could it compare to the immediate effects of Perfect Transcension?

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

items.name: 雕花边砚
items.description:
雕琢此砚的匠人病了，沉睡渐多，清醒渐少，终是紧握着刻刀，再未能醒来。未完工的砚台被医者收进了库房。可此后，常有医者在库中撞见个木人，正一刀一刀，雕着一方砚台。

似为稀世珍宝，可在妙手小张处换得实用之物。
items.description_en:
The craftsman carving this inkstone fell ill, spending ever longer asleep and ever less time awake, until one day he never woke again, his carving knife still clenched in hand. The unfinished inkstone was placed in storage by the healers. But ever since, they have occasionally come across a Wooden Puppet inside, quietly carving an inkstone, one stroke at a time.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

items.name: 观浊星盘
items.description:
得此星盘者，无不坚信能凭它推演出“浊”的行迹。可许多年过去，他们仍困于繁复的演算，如痴人般呢喃着晦涩之语。也许他们真的算出了结果，只是再也无法道与世人。

似为稀世珍宝，可在妙手小张处换得实用之物。
items.description_en:
Everyone who came into possession of this astrolabe believed it could reveal the movements of the Blight. Yet even after years of complex calculations, they remained consumed by their work, muttering cryptic words like madmen. Perhaps they really did find the answer, only to lose the ability to share it with the world.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

items.name: 无常日晷
items.description:
不知是何人手笔，晷面残缺之处，竟以水晶嵌合修补。此物不计光阴，专卜命运。而窥见命运所指，未必总是幸事。

似为稀世珍宝，可在妙手小张处换得实用之物。
items.description_en:
No one knows whose work it was, but the missing sections of the sundial were repaired with inlaid crystal. It does not measure time. It divines fate. And seeing where fate leads is not always a blessing.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

items.name: 蓝花司南
items.description:
精巧的司南匣，匣面雕有蓝花。匣中司南，可指善恶，指吉凶，亦指向执此物者心之所求。切莫过多依赖此物，毕竟再是精密，也有人心难测。

似为稀世珍宝，可在妙手小张处换得实用之物。
items.description_en:
An exquisite compass case engraved with blue flowers. The compass within can point to good and evil, fortune and misfortune—even to what its bearer desires most. But rely on it too heavily at your peril. However precise the instrument, the human heart is never so easily read.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

items.name: 将军铜镜
items.description:
嵌有绿松石的古铜镜，传闻，为古代将军照破邪物之器。底部残缺处熔毁斑驳，似为邪力侵蚀所留的残痕。

似为稀世珍宝，可在妙手小张处换得实用之物。
items.description_en:
An ancient bronze mirror inlaid with turquoise. Legend has it that a general of old once used it to expose evil forces. The damaged base is scorched and mottled, as though eaten away by some lingering corruption.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

items.name: 金银香囊
items.description:
金银饰片交叠缀覆的香囊。为商会的姚东家特意寻来，赠予百戏名角之物。待到名角于走索上凌空蹁跹，腰间香囊便如游龙轻抖细鳞，金银相击，泠泠有声；一舞终了，满座盈香。而姚东家总会坐到散场之后。

似为稀世珍宝，可在妙手小张处换得实用之物。
items.description_en:
A sachet layered with overlapping gold and silver ornaments. Patron Yao had it specially commissioned as a gift for a celebrated acrobat. As the performer danced high above on the tightrope, the sachet at their waist shimmered like a Loong in motion, its golden and silver scales chiming softly with each step. By the end of the performance, the entire hall was filled with its fragrance. And Patron Yao would always remain seated long after everyone else had gone.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

items.name: 云月金簪
items.description:
云纹蜿蜒，缭绕簪首美玉，宛若流云抱月。昔年戏梦山庄的百戏宴上，有伶人施展幻术，引簪中云月化作台上真景，满座宾客皆莫辨是真是幻。

似为稀世珍宝，可在妙手小张处换得实用之物。
items.description_en:
Cloud motifs curl around the fine jade set into the hairpin, like drifting clouds cradling the moon. Long ago, during a grand performance banquet at The Mirage Estate, an entertainer used Phantom Arts to bring the clouds and moon depicted on the hairpin to life upon the stage. The guests could no longer tell where illusion ended and reality began.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

items.name: 猎户的犬铃
items.description: 一枚小巧的铃铛，曾属于猎户心爱的猎狗“大黄”。而今，丢失爱犬的猎户将这铃铛握在手中，沉入了再不能醒来的梦。
items.description_en: A small bell once worn by Dahuang, the hunter's beloved hunting dog. The bell now rests in the hunter's clenched hands as he sinks into a dream from which he will never awaken.

items.name: 小翠的红头绳
items.description:
一根有些褪色的红发绳，以三股棉线编成。

更小的时候，爹娘与爷爷，都曾给小翠绑过头发，可如今，爹爹、阿娘和爷爷，都去哪儿了呢？
items.description_en:
A faded red ribbon braided from three strands of cotton.

When Cui was younger, her father, mother, and grandfather would each tie her hair with it. But now, where have they all gone?

items.name: 老根头家的黄铜钥匙
items.description: 传了几辈人的老钥匙，比老根头的年纪都大哩。
items.description_en: An old key passed down through generations, older even than Old Man Gen himself.

items.name: 坑道牢笼小钥匙
items.description:
人偶指骨做成的钥匙，苍白的指节上，又突兀地横生着三根小指，共同构成钥匙的齿部。

不止村民，还有在飞贼密道中的飞贼。梦差的属下会将他们关入牢笼，作为制作人偶的素材。
items.description_en:
A key fashioned from a puppet's finger. Three smaller fingers jut unnaturally from the knuckles, together forming the key's teeth.

Villagers were not the only captives here. The Herald's subordinates also caged thieves from the Smuggler's Tunnel, all destined for the making of puppets.

items.name: 陆家村村舍地窖钥匙
items.description:
由好几根铁条拼合而成的钥匙，似乎除了能打开某处贼窝的密门外，还常被其主人用作溜门撬锁的工具。

尾端刻着一个“陆”字，应是陆家村中某间老宅的地窖钥匙。
items.description_en:
A key pieced together from several iron bars. Besides opening the hidden entrance to the Smuggler's Tunnel, it seems to have served its owner just as often for picking locks.

The character for "Lu" is engraved on one end, it may be the cellar key to an old house in Village of Lu.

items.name: 落灰的老旧木梳子
items.description: 老妇人留下的木梳子。那未曾被手指握住的地方，落了一层薄薄的灰尘。
items.description_en: A wooden comb left behind by the old woman. A thin layer of dust has settled on the parts her fingers never touched.

items.name: 炎茹的炽焰面具
items.description:
暴烈的火焰于面具上熊熊燃烧，炽烈不熄。

闯入者事件后，“禁忌遗迹”已经完全封锁，即使是追杀叛徒的“灭法之法”四人，也无法单独进入……
items.description_en:
A mask engulfed in a fierce, undying flame.

The Forbidden Ruins have been sealed shut ever since an intruder caused havoc within. Even the four Acolytes tasked with hunting down traitors can no longer enter on their own.

items.name: 雷婷的霹雳面具
items.description:
金与绿交织的面具，雷霆的力量在其间涌动。

闯入者事件后，“禁忌遗迹”已经完全封锁，即使是追杀叛徒的“灭法之法”四人，也无法单独进入……
items.description_en:
A mask of interwoven gold and green, with thunderous power surging within.

The Forbidden Ruins have been sealed shut ever since an intruder caused havoc within. Even the four Acolytes tasked with hunting down traitors can no longer enter on their own.

items.name: 蛊鹤的剧毒面具
items.description:
表面带有腐蚀性剧毒的紫色面具。

闯入者事件后，“禁忌遗迹”已经完全封锁，即使是追杀叛徒的“灭法之法”四人，也无法单独进入……
items.description_en:
A purple mask coated in deadly, corrosive poison.

The Forbidden Ruins have been sealed shut ever since an intruder caused havoc within. Even the four Acolytes tasked with hunting down traitors can no longer enter on their own.

items.name: 寒岁的坚冰面具
items.description:
坚冰与幻术构筑而成的面具，浴火不融，坚不可摧。

闯入者事件后，“禁忌遗迹”已经完全封锁，即使是追杀叛徒的“灭法之法”四人，也无法单独进入……
items.description_en:
A mask formed from hardened ice and Phantom Arts, impervious to flame and impossible to shatter.

The Forbidden Ruins have been sealed shut ever since an intruder caused havoc within. Even the four Acolytes tasked with hunting down traitors can no longer enter on their own.

items.name: 四十四号人偶的独眼
items.description: 飞贼密道深处的通路，被“四十四号”人偶封锁住了，而这枚眼珠，正是打开人偶锁的钥匙。
items.description_en: The passage deep within the Smuggler's Tunnel is blocked by Puppet No.44. This eye is the key to the puppet lock.

items.name: 水晶人偶眼珠【阴】
items.description:
水晶材质的人偶眼珠，其内透出一抹鱼形的黑色，如同太极的阴仪。

与另一枚内藏“阳仪”的水晶眼珠构成一对。
items.description_en:
A crystal puppet eye with a black, fish-shaped form visible within, resembling the Yin half of a taiji symbol.

It forms a pair with another crystal eye containing the Yang half.

items.name: 水晶人偶眼珠【阳】
items.description:
水晶材质的人偶眼珠，其内透出一抹鱼形的白色，如同太极的阳仪。

与另一枚内藏“阴仪”的水晶眼珠构成一对。
items.description_en:
A crystal puppet eye with a white, fish-shaped form visible within, resembling the Yang half of a taiji symbol.

It forms a pair with another crystal eye containing the Yin half.

items.name: 人偶舌头
items.description:
一把舌头形态的钥匙，陶瓷亦或某种精心打磨的骨材所制。

舌根处刻有三重槽道，对应着梦差幻境中的三道门扉。每开启一道，三眼人偶口中的舌头，便会多向外弹出一分。
items.description_en:
A tongue-shaped key made of ceramic or finely polished bone.

The three grooves at its base correspond to the three gates within the Herald's illusion. Every gate it unlocks causes the Three-Eyed Puppet's tongue to spring a little farther out.

items.name: 八卦阁楼顶钥匙
items.description:
长约四寸的八卦阁顶层钥匙。

钥齿铸作乾卦之形，三道阳爻横陈，刚健而肃穆——天行有常，而世间隐秘皆入此阁。
items.description_en:
A key to the uppermost level of the Pavilion of Knowledge. The teeth are cast in the shape of the Qian trigram: three unbroken yang lines, strong and solemn.

Heaven follows its constant course, while the world's secrets gather within this pavilion.

items.name: 兰家大宅大门钥匙
items.description:
华丽的古铜钥匙，表面雕刻着精致的兰花纹饰，似已传承百年，却仍然光泽未减。

有了这把钥匙，便可寻找机会，救出兰宅中的那些孩子了吧？
items.description_en:
An ornate bronze key engraved with delicate orchid motifs. Though it appears to have been passed down for a century, its luster remains undimmed.

With this key, perhaps there will be a chance to rescue the children inside the Lan Manor.

items.name: 天香阁钥匙
items.description:
带着脂粉香气的雕花钥匙。

能够打开天香阁的大门。
items.description_en:
An engraved key carrying a faint scent of rouge and powder.

Opens the main gate to Tianxiang Pavilion.

items.name: 黄家大宅钥匙
items.description: 挂着祥云金坠的黄家大宅大门钥匙，看起来很是值钱。
items.description_en: Key to the front gate of the Huang Manor, adorned with a gold auspicious cloud charm. It appears to be worth a fair sum.

items.name: 破碎的“侠胆”
items.description:
名为“侠胆”的碎玉，看起来有些污浊。

许多人相信玉有灵性，受忠勇侠义、仁德良善之气陶冶，可日渐纯净无瑕。
items.description_en:
A fragment of jade known as "Hero's Courage", now somewhat clouded.

Many believe jade possesses a spirit of its own, growing ever purer when nurtured by loyalty, courage, righteousness, and compassion.

items.name: 头牌花旦的脂粉
items.description: 因工序繁杂，材料稀少，因而极为珍贵的脂粉。仅可供头牌花旦使用。
items.description_en: Its intricate preparation and rare ingredients make this rouge exceptionally precious. Reserved only for Leading Opera Actresses.

items.name: 残破的舞扇
items.description: 鲜红的舞扇，一身凄惨的豁口。
items.description_en: A crimson dance fan, now marred by ragged tears.

items.name: 失去光彩的破损玉佩
items.description:
从玉儿父亲的遗体上掉落下来的黯淡玉佩。

它曾寄托着玉儿父亲对亡妻的怀念，对命运的期许。如今，随着老人的离世，玉佩也失去了光彩，似在哀叹这苦涩而微末的命运。
items.description_en:
A dim jade pendant that fell from the body of Yu'er's father.

It once carried his longing for his late wife, and his hopes for the future. With his passing, the pendant too has lost its luster, as though mourning a life of quiet hardship and sorrow.

items.name: 厚重的狮门钥匙
items.description:
舞狮绣球形状的银质钥匙，能够打开舞狮馆大门。

日光穿过镂空处，投下狮子衔球的剪影。钥匙沉甸甸的分量里，仿佛还封存着往日的锣鼓喧天。
items.description_en:
A silver key shaped like a lion dance ball. It opens the main gate to the Lion Dance Hall.

When sunlight passes through its openwork, it casts the silhouette of a lion with a ball in its jaws. Its weight seems to hold the echo of drums and gongs from days past.

items.name: 熄火烈焰狮头
items.description:
狮首形态的喷火器，可惜已经耗尽了火焰燃料，暂时无法使用。

若能装满燃料，或许可以烧开阻碍道路的荆棘。
items.description_en:
A lion-headed flamethrower, now cold and silent after its fuel ran dry. For the time being, it can not be used.

If refueled, it may be able to burn through bramble barriers on the path.

items.name: 后街秘密地窖开关
items.description:
粗糙的金属把手上缠着一圈红布。勒得很紧，大概是为了防滑。

能够打开后街中那处隐秘的地窖。
items.description_en:
A rough metal crank with red cloth wrapped tightly around its handle, probably to keep it from slipping.

Opens the hidden cellar in the backstreets.

items.name: 龙形令牌·阴
items.description:
一条俯首而下的龙，鳞片纹路细密如真，龙目以墨玉镶嵌，在暗处隐隐泛着幽光。

其左侧边缘的缺口光滑圆润，似乎可与另一块残片相互嵌合。
items.description_en:
A Loong with its head bowed, its finely detailed scales almost lifelike. Its eyes, inlaid with black jade, glow faintly in the darkness.

A smooth, rounded notch along its left edge appears to fit together with another fragment.

items.name: 龙形令牌·阳
items.description:
一条昂首向天的龙，龙须飘逸灵动，龙目以玛瑙点睛，灼灼若有神采。

其右侧边缘的缺口光滑圆润，似乎可与另一块残片相互嵌合。
items.description_en:
A Loong with its head raised toward the heavens, its whiskers flowing gracefully. Its eyes, inlaid with agate, gleam as though alive.

A smooth, rounded notch along its right edge appears to fit together with another fragment.

items.name: 龙形令牌
items.description:
拼合完整的令牌。其上一龙盘旋、一龙昂扬，共同穿梭于云涛日月之间。

似乎可以打开某处的龙形锁。
items.description_en:
An emblem pieced together into a whole. Upon it, one Loong coils while another rises proudly, both weaving among billowing clouds, the sun and the moon.

It seems capable of opening a Loong-shaped lock somewhere.

items.name: 红色蛇信
items.description:
猩红的蛇信，鲜艳、冰冷而栩栩如生。根部的机括，恰能扣合某处隐秘的锁孔。

这枚精心安置于赤蛇屋中的信物，将会开启怎样的秘密？
items.description_en:
A mechanical serpent's tongue. Cold, lifelike, and exquisitely crafted. The mechanism at its base seems made to fit a hidden keyhole.
 
This token was carefully placed within the Red Serpent Manor. What secret might it unlock?

items.name: 黑色蛇牙
items.description:
由晶石精雕细琢而成的蛇牙，光滑如镜，锋利如刀，也许稍有不慎，便会刺穿窥探秘密之人。

但总有人甘冒此险，只为窥见门后的真相。
items.description_en:
A serpent's fang finely carved from crystal, smooth as a mirror and sharp as a blade. The slightest carelessness could see it pierce anyone seeking its secrets.

Yet there are always those willing to brave this risk, if only to glimpse the truth beyond the door.

items.name: 白色蛇眼
items.description: 一枚形同蛇眼的琥珀色晶石，剔透的晶体正中天然嵌有一道暗色光带，会随视角的不同而闪动变化，如被蛇目紧盯，如影随形。
items.description_en: An amber crystal shaped like the eye of a serpent. Within its translucent core is a naturally embedded dark band, shimmering and shifting with the angle of the light, as if the serpent's gaze were following your every move.

items.name: 正道大营外门钥匙
items.description:
质地粗糙的铁质备用钥匙，纹饰单调呆板，似乎是仓促中打造的产物。

能够开启通往正道大营的山道大门。
items.description_en:
A roughly forged iron spare key. The plain, rigid design suggests it was made in haste.

Opens the outer gate of the mountain road leading to the Mandate's encampment.

items.name: 营前山谷大门钥匙
items.description: 正道联盟据山谷建起防御工事，并在山谷内修建了一条前往正道大营的通路。
items.row_name: 营前山谷神秘大门钥匙
items.description_en: The Mandate fortified the valley and built a route to their encampment.

items.name: 墨玑子房门钥匙
items.description:
秀气的扁条形钥匙，首端一侧出一圆钮孔，用以勾住锁条。

墨玑子在时，居处的大门常不落锁，无论是前来求教、拜会，还是论剑比试者，皆会获其礼遇。墨玑子下落不明后，弟子们便将屋门紧锁，以防师父所留被荒行子的爪牙糟蹋破坏。
items.description_en:
A slender, flat key with a round opening at one end for hooking onto the locking bar.

When Moji was here, the door to his residence was usually left unlocked. Those who came to seek instruction, pay a visit, or test their skills against him were always welcome. After his disappearance, his disciples kept the house tightly locked to protect their master's legacy from Huangxing's followers.

items.name: 校场大门钥匙
items.description: 黄玉制成的环扣上挂着一把钥匙，可以打开大校场大门。
items.description_en: A key hanging from a yellow jade ring. Opens the main gate to the Training Grounds.

items.name: 折断的铁剑
items.description:
一柄断成两截的铁剑，已完成了它所能承载的一切，本该随它的英雄一同于地下长眠。

可似乎有人为翻找什么，竟将此剑从坟冢中掘出，又弃置在一边。
items.description_en:
An iron sword broken in two. It had long fulfilled its purpose, and should have forever rested beside the hero it once belonged to.

Yet someone seems to have unearthed it from the grave in search of something, only to cast it aside.

items.name: 朴素的发钗
items.description:
一支造型古朴的发钗，钗身素净，独其上点缀的珠玉仍保有莹莹光彩。钗尾处刻着一个小小的“婉”字，不知是曾属于一位名中带“婉”的女侠，还是一件用以睹物思人的信物。

这发钗曾被一方手帕仔细包裹着，奉于墓前，但今不知何故，它连带着帕子，一同零落在了泥土之间。
items.description_en:
A simply fashioned hairpin. Only the tiny pearls and jade ornaments still retain a soft luster. A small character, "Wan", is engraved on one end. Perhaps it once belonged to a heroine of that name, or perhaps it was kept as a token of remembrance.

It was carefully wrapped in a handkerchief and placed before a grave. For reasons unknown, both now lie scattered in the dirt.

items.name: 漆黑的刀鞘
items.description:
通体漆黑的狭长刀鞘，上覆虬结纹路，如经脉般蔓延。纵然鞘内的刀已然下落不明，但能被这绝非凡品的刀鞘收纳的，定然是一柄削铁如泥的宝刀。

然那刀鞘上并行排列的划痕，又是何种武器所致？
items.description_en:
A slender black scabbard with twisting patterns running across the surface like veins. The blade it once carried is nowhere to be found, but such an extraordinary scabbard befit only a sword capable of cleaving through iron with ease.

What weapon, then, left those parallel scars on the scabbard?

items.name: 红布木门的钥匙
items.description:
系着一截褪色红布条的门钥匙。

洞房花烛，金榜题名，又或是他乡遇故知，人们总要在宴席之间，挂一抹喜庆的红。
items.description_en:
A key with a faded strip of red cloth tied to the end.

Be it a wedding, success in the examinations, or a reunion with an old friend far from home, a touch of festive red always adorns such celebrations.

items.name: 无根仙露
items.description: 罕见的草药，具有遏制疫病复发及传染的效果，可直接服用。横刀队长尚存一丝理智之时，曾想以此药来推迟自己发狂的时间。
items.description_en:
A rare medicinal herb that curbs the recurrence and spread of plague. It can be consumed directly.

While he still retained a sliver of his sanity, Giant Saber Commander hoped this medicine would delay his descent into madness.

items.name: 脱落的牢笼拉杆
items.description: 锈迹斑斑的铁制拉杆，似乎是从某处脱落下来的，也许会成为操作某种控制机关的关键所在。
items.description_en: A rusted iron lever appears to have come loose from some larger mechanism. Despite its condition, it may yet prove key to some other mechanism.

items.name: 沾血的项链
items.description:
老旧的项链，如今已不值几个钱。

它曾是某位母亲的希望，坠上隐约可见“陈氏”二字。
items.description_en:
An old necklace, now worth little.

It once carried a mother's hope. The characters for "Chen Clan" are still faintly visible on the pendant.

items.name: 庞镇后街小院钥匙
items.description:
怪面陈柱留下的小钥匙，看起来还很新。

可打开庞镇后街中的一处小院。
items.row_name: 庞镇后街小院钥匙（白雪儿）
items.description_en:
A small key left behind by the Maskwalker, Chen Zhu. It doesn't seem to have been used much.

Opens the gate to a courtyard in Pangzhen's backstreets.

items.name: 墨玑子的染血剑
items.description:
一柄满是血污的佩剑，剑尖古朴无锋，大巧若拙。若有行家看一眼，定能知晓此剑来历。

原是砺剑山庄所铸当世名剑，由昆仑派墨玑子所有。至于它为何流落此处，主人又身在何处，无从得知。
items.description_en:
A sword stained with blood. Its blade ends in a plain, unassuming tip, deceptively simple in appearance. A discerning eye would recognize its provenance at a glance.

Forged by Lijan Manor, it was once a famed sword of its time and belonged to Moji of the Kunlun Sect. How it came to rest here, and what became of Moji, remain unknown.

items.name: 升降机缺失的开关
items.description: 登顶山道上升降机丢失的开关。正道联盟修建了通往宗祠顶部的升降机，用于运送物资。后来荒行子亲卫队将开关拆卸取走，以便隐藏宗祠中的秘密。经过一番争夺后，这个开关似乎流落到了一个不属于任何势力的凶残疯妇手中。
items.row_name: 登顶山道升降机缺失的开关
items.description_en:
The crank missing from the lift along the mountain path to the summit. The Mandate built the lift to move supplies to the shrine at the top. Later, Huangxing's personal guards removed the crank to conceal the shrine's secrets.

After a struggle for possession, it seems to have ended up with a ruthless madwoman.

items.name: 通往宗祠的山门钥匙
items.description: 打开通往宗祠必经之路的山门钥匙。由荒行子的亲卫队藏匿在牢笼洞窟之中。
items.description_en: The key to the mountain gate on the only path to the shrine. It was hidden within the caverns by Huangxing's personal guards.

items.name: 戏票
items.description:
戏梦山庄的戏素来一票难求，如今非但未变，反倒愈演愈烈。囚命之人竞相争逐，甚至不惜争得头破血流。

凭此戏票，方可进入戏园。
items.description_en:
Tickets to performances at the Mirage Estate have always been hard to come by, and the competition for them has only grown fiercer. The Thread-Binders fight over a single ticket, spilling blood for the chance to attend.

Only with this ticket may one enter the Opera Theater.

items.name: 后山钥匙
items.description: 戏梦山庄后山的侧门钥匙，柄部雕刻着精致的山水纹样，中间镶嵌一颗红翡。
items.description_en: A key to the side gate on the hill behind the Mirage Estate. Its handle is engraved with delicate landscape motifs and set with a piece of jade mottled red and green. Its teeth follow the outline of traditional roof eaves, unusual yet finely crafted.

items.name: 吹火楼钥匙
items.description: 染着一层白灰的钥匙，像一段燃尽的枯骨。

items.name: 无限煌心
items.description:
一颗精巧的机械心脏。一颗永远在跳动的心。一颗可以生发无限杀气而不会引发反噬的心。一颗企图吞噬万物的贪婪之心。一颗筹谋掌控武林乃至掌控天外之力的傲慢之心。

又或是，一颗不曾磨灭的侠义之心。一颗会带来无限可能的心。
items.description_en:
An intricate mechanical heart. A heart that beats without end. A heart that can generate limitless Sha-Chi without corruption. A greedy heart that would devour all things. An arrogant heart that seeks to rule the Wulin—and even command powers beyond this world.

Or perhaps, a heart whose sense of justice has never faded. A heart that holds infinite possibilities.

items.name: 无名大师的断指
items.description: 因冰雪封存而未曾腐朽的断指，作为宗门至宝的扳指，仍挂在那苍白的指节上。
items.description_en: A severed finger preserved in ice and snow, untouched by decay. A thumb ring symbolizing the highest authority of the sect still encircles its pale knuckle.

items.name: 断魂山工具间钥匙
items.description: 正道队伍常备的门锁钥匙，已被断魂山的漫天风雪冻得龟裂，唯独槽口一线仍锃亮如新。
items.description_en: A standard key often carried by members of the Mandate. The endless wind and snow of Soulrend Mountain have cracked the metal, yet the groove along its teeth still gleams like new.

items.name: 庞镇染坊外院钥匙
items.description:
这不过是间寻常染坊。

木架上飘荡的布料，蓝草发酵的气味，染匠指间洗不去的青色，妇人们换上新衣时的欢喜，都在那怪病的啃噬下凋零，褪成片片残旧的靛蓝。
items.description_en:
This was once nothing more than an ordinary dyehouse.

The cloth fluttering from wooden racks, the fermented scent of indigo plants, the blue stains that never washed from the dyers' fingers, the joy on women's faces as they donned new clothes—all withered beneath the ravages of that strange illness, fading into tattered remnants of indigo.

items.name: 食物防腐护符残片·之一
items.raw_name: 食物防腐护符残片·之一
items.description:
一枚被利刃整齐切开的护符上半部分，切口处仍残留着油脂与血污。

原主人似乎是个贪婪的商贩，总想用障眼法欺骗买主。而屠夫只是还了他一个公道。
items.row_name: 食物防腐护符（下半部分）
items.description_en:
The upper half of a talisman cleanly severed by a sharp blade. Grease and blood still stain the cut edge.

Its former owner appears to have been a greedy merchant, always using cheap tricks to deceive his customers. The butcher merely gave him what he deserved.

items.name: 食物防腐护符残片·之二
items.raw_name: 食物防腐护符残片·之二
items.description:
护符的下半部分，齐整的断口昭示着那一刀的干脆利落。

若与上半部分合而为一，便可带来削弱毒伤之效。
items.row_name: 食物防腐护符（上半部分）
items.description_en:
The lower half of the talisman. Its clean break bears witness to the swift, decisive stroke that severed it.

When reunited with its upper half, it reduces poison damage.

items.name: 药罐残片·盖
items.description: 粗陶烧制的药罐盖子，状如根瘤，表面粗粝。
items.description_en: The lid of a medicine pot fired from coarse clay, shaped like a knotted root and rough to the touch.

items.name: 药罐残片·链
items.description: 几乎完好的铁链，用以吊住罐体，将之悬于火上。
items.description_en: An almost intact iron chain used to suspend the pot over a fire.

items.name: 药罐残片·柄
items.description: 形如根块的药罐残柄，早已浸透了苦涩的药气。
items.description_en: A broken, root-shaped handle from a medicine pot, permeated with the bitter scent of medicinal herbs.

items.name: 药罐残片·腹
items.description: 她的命运大抵就像这药罐，被铁链吊住，架于火上，再不得解脱。
items.description_en: Her fate was much like this medicine pot: suspended by iron chains over the fire, never to be freed.

items.name: 力士神像碎片·头
items.description: 怒目圆睁的力士神像头颅。它曾见证供奉者以武证道，也见证着此人颤抖着向自己举起石块。
items.description_en: The head of the Guardian Idol, its eyes still wide with fury. It once witnessed its worshippers seek the Way through martial discipline, only to watch one of them raise a stone against it with trembling hands.

items.name: 力士神像碎片·臂
items.description: 正道中人曾抚此神像臂膀起誓，可后来，他们却用起誓的手，将其手臂砸断。
items.description_en: Members of the Mandate once laid a hand upon this arm to swear their oaths. Later, those very same hands shattered it.

items.name: 力士神像碎片·躯
items.description: 残躯碎裂处的断口已经磨平了，不知被多少人捡起，又被多少人丢下。
items.description_en: The fractured edges of its broken form have long since been worn smooth. No one knows how many hands have picked it up, only to cast it aside again.

items.name: 力士神像碎片·腿
items.description: 面对怪面肆虐的无尽恐惧，神像从不曾退却的双腿，终究未能撑住轰然倒塌的人心。
items.description_en: In the face of the endless terror wrought by the Maskwalkers, these legs never once gave ground. Yet in the end, even they could not support the people's collapsing resolve.

items.name: 暗源方块·榫
items.description: 表面布满扭曲凹痕的残榫，形如被蚕食啃噬后的碎屑残渣。
items.description_en: A broken tenon piece covered in twisted dents and gouges, resembling the scraps left behind after something has been gnawed away.

items.name: 暗源方块·卯
items.description: 带有奇异折角的金属残片，持握之时，似乎可以听到某种遥远的嗡鸣。
items.description_en: A metal fragment with strangely angled folds. When held in hand, a distant hum seems to echo.

items.name: 傩面碎片·喜
items.description: 朱门设宴三千客，宾主皆着笑皮囊。散席揭面寻旧友，却忘自家本来相。
items.description_en: Three thousand guests feast behind vermilion gates, hosts and guests alike wearing smiling masks. When the feast ends, they unmask in search of old friends, only to find they've forgotten their own true faces.

items.name: 傩面碎片·怒
items.description: 高台棒喝声声震，赤口獠牙呼夜长。谁知一腔锄奸气，最先灼穿自心肠。
items.description_en: From the high platform, cries of rebuke thunder without cease; crimson jaws and bared fangs howl through the endless night. Who knew that the fire raised to purge evil would first scorch the heart that kindled it?

items.name: 傩面碎片·哀
items.description: 纸钱三叠风中泣，青灯一盏照荒凉，常替他人哭生死，回首不记自家丧。
items.description_en: Three stacks of paper offerings weep in the wind; a lone lamp shines upon the desolation. Forever mourning the lives and deaths of others, one looks back only to find one's own bereavement forgotten.

items.name: “组织”
items.description:
“组织”就是“组织”，它没有别的名字。

“组织”无善也无恶，只为执行其所认定的“规则”而存在。

任何人既入组织，终生不得离开。如若私自逃离，组织绝不容其存活于世。
items.description_en:
The Order is the Order. It has no other name.

The Order is neither good nor evil. It exists only to enforce the "Rules" it recognizes.

Once a person enters the Order, they shall never leave. Should anyone flee of their own accord, the Order shall not permit them to remain among the living.

items.name: “组织”就是“组织”
items.raw_name:
“组织”就是“组织”，它没有别的名字。

“组织”杀人，杀别人杀不了的人；“组织”也救人，救别人救不了的人。

“组织”维护武林所公认的“规则”，并专注公平，摒弃“正邪不两立”的道德标准，将其一视同仁。

正凭此理念，数十年间，创始人沐天邈将这个最初仅有三人的“组织”不断壮大。时至今日，“组织”维护“规则”所构成的压力已然无处不在。但它的实际情况仍然鲜少为外界所知。

items.description_en:
The Order is simply the Order. It has no other name.

The Order kills those no one else can kill. It saves those no one else can save.

The Order upholds the "rules" recognized throughout the Wulin. It concerns itself with fairness, rejecting the belief that good and evil must always stand opposed, and judging both by the same standard.

Guided by this principle, founder Mu Tianmiao spent decades growing what began as an organization of just three people. To this day, the pressure exerted by the Order in enforcing the "Rules" can be felt throughout the Wulin, yet little is known of how the Order itself truly operates.

items.name: 冥主与冥使们
items.raw_name:
【冥主：沐天邈】
“组织”创始人，武艺超群，更能识人用人。四十年来，在其领导下，“组织”吸收了众多高手，更使其贯彻的规则影响了整个武林。

【冥使：虚空】
武林中首屈一指的幻术大师，掌握整个“组织”的情报组织，并处理所有与“里武林”有关的事宜。在与“十一人阁”的战斗中肉身毁灭，只能依靠意识投影现身。

【冥使：小厮】
机关术天才，似乎出身机关世家，因触犯禁忌而遭驱逐，故以“小厮”之名卑微自称。制造了大量神奇的机关造物，远超这个时代。

【冥使：“魔僧”暗禅】
僧人，修炼了三百六十种已经失传的邪派武功，并至少在九种兵器的用法上可排入武林前十之列。但性情喜怒无常，已经消失无踪。

【冥使：“黑伤”魂】
沐冥主义子之一，少时被收养到“组织”之中。其身法“影”形如鬼魅，刀法“刃”一击毙命，是“组织”最锋利的尖刀。

【冥使：“紫冥”左殇】
沐冥主义子之一，与魂一同被收养在“组织”中。精于布局，智谋不逊于冥主，剑术亦达到化境，并拥有绝世无双的黄金剑气。

【第六冥使】
记录已销毁。

items.description_en:
[Shadow Sovereign: Mu Tianmiao]
Founder of the Order. A peerless martial artist, and a keener judge of men still. Over forty years under his leadership, the Order has drawn countless masters into its ranks, and the rules it enforces have come to shape the entire Wulin.

[Shadow Edict: Inanis]
The foremost master of Phantom Arts in all the Wulin. She commands the Order's entire intelligence network and handles every matter touching the Discordance. Her body was destroyed in the battle against the Eleven; she now appears only as a projection of consciousness.

[Shadow Edict: The Servant]
A genius of the Engine Art, seemingly born to a storied family of mechanists and cast out for breaking a taboo—hence the lowly name he gives himself, "the Servant." He has built a wealth of wondrous machina constructs far beyond this era.

[Shadow Edict: "Dark Monk" Channa]
A monk who has mastered three hundred and sixty heretical arts long lost to the world, and ranks among the Wulin's ten finest in the use of at least nine different weapons. Volatile and unpredictable by nature, he has since vanished without a trace.

[Shadow Edict: "Black Scar" Soul]
One of Sovereign Mu's adopted sons, taken in by the Order as a child. His movement art, "Phantom," makes him a specter in combat; his "Blade" art kills in a single stroke. He is the sharpest knife the Order wields.

[Shadow Edict: "Purple Shadow" Zuo Shang]
One of Sovereign Mu's adopted sons, taken in by the Order alongside Soul. A master of the long game, his cunning is the equal of the Sovereign's own. His swordsmanship has reached the realm of perfection, crowned by a golden sword aura without peer in this world.

[The Sixth Shadow Edict]
This record has been destroyed.

items.name: 组织高手
items.raw_name:
【雷当】
原为魂的搭档，为人刚直稳重，赤胆忠心。数年前右臂被斩断，后装上了一门巨大虎炮，有以一敌百之能。

【长鸿】
长枪武者，侠肝义胆，沉着可靠，无心涉足纷争，意在护其妻女安宁。枪法卓绝，虽常在种种艰巨任务中出生入死，却总能转危为安。

【玉妖】
少主沐小葵的贴身护卫，能以凌厉身法，施展穿戴于腿脚上的一双利刃——“妖锯”，凌空舞动间，便使敌人身首异处。

【铁鬼】
与玉妖同为少主沐小葵的贴身护卫，使用玄铁打造的一双拳套，拳法刚猛无俦，并将其精髓传授于少主沐小葵。

items.description_en:
[Lei Dang]
Soul's former partner. Straightforward, steadfast, and fiercely loyal. After losing his right arm years ago, he fitted himself with a massive Tiger Cannon, granting him the power to take on a hundred men alone.

[Chang Hong]
A spearman with a strong sense of honor and justice, calm and dependable. He has no desire to become embroiled in conflict, wishing only to keep his wife and daughter safe. His spearmanship is peerless. Though he often faces mortal danger on the most difficult of missions, he always manages to turn danger aside.

[Jade Dancer]
Personal guard to the Young Mistress, Mu Xiaokui. With ferocious footwork she wields the Fiend Saws, a pair of blades worn on her legs—dancing through the air, she parts heads from shoulders.

[Iron Fiend]
The other of Mu Xiaokui's personal guards. Wielding a pair of Iron Gauntlets, his fists fall with unmatched force—and he has passed the essence of that art down to the Young Mistress herself.

items.name: 十一人阁
items.raw_name:
昔年，各派高手为观摩一本“天书残册”，蜂拥至断魂崖。而后却受到奇特钟声的影响，在断魂崖相互厮杀，血流成河。

可是，当时仍有十人幸存了下来，连同一位现场逝者的遗孤，这“十一人阁”依托“天书残册”中的知识，获得了新生。在杀气的影响下，他们为各自的执念炮制阴谋与惨剧，使“杀气改造”蔓延至整个武林。

后来，经过数年艰苦的战斗，“组织”将“十一人阁”逐个击破。但是，他们是否能真正死去呢？

items.description_en:
Many years ago, masters from every corner of the Wulin flocked to Soulrend Cliff to view a surviving fragment of the Celestial Tome. There, maddened by the tolling of a strange bell, they turned on one another—and the cliff ran with rivers of blood.

Yet ten survived the slaughter, along with the orphaned child of one who died there. Drawing on the knowledge within the Tome fragment, these Eleven were given new life. Under Sha-Chi's sway, their obsessions swelled, and in service of them they crafted schemes and tragedies alike, spreading Transcension across the whole of the Wulin.

Then, after years of bitter fighting, the Order broke the Eleven one by one. But can such beings ever truly die?

items.name: 机关船和船坞
items.raw_name:
小厮的“机关工坊”为“组织”开发了许多便于出行的装置，机关船便是其中之一，以杀气为动力，驱动船快速行进。

临水的城镇中，往往设有船坞，供这些机关船修整和补给。而管理码头的船老大们，必定都有两把刷子——一是精通机关船的构造与维护，二是人脉深厚，往来船队带回水路信息、城镇动向、周边势力情报，无一能逃脱船老大的耳目。

items.description_en:
The Servant's "Engine Workshop" has developed many devices for the Order that make travel easier. The Engine Boat is one such creation, powered by Sha-Chi to travel swiftly across the water.

Waterside towns often have docks where these Engine Boats can be repaired and resupplied. The boatmasters who oversee the docks are invariably capable men. Not only do they know the construction and maintenance of Engine Boats inside and out, they also have extensive connections. Passing fleets bring them information on waterways, developments in nearby towns, and intelligence on surrounding factions. Little escapes the boatmasters' ears.

items.name: 灭龙魔
items.raw_name:
三十余年前，“组织”与龙氏家族里应外合，攻破暗魔天堡。

此战后不足一月，“组织”又迅速以连环计离间、分化龙氏家族，致使龙氏家族内战，而后分散为诸多小家族，最终于武林销声匿迹。

据传，“组织”分别从暗魔天堡与龙氏家族各俘获一名婴儿，秘密培养至今。

items.description_en:
More than thirty years ago, the Order worked from both inside and out with the Lóng Clan to launch an all-out siege on the Bastion of Mó and destroy them.

Less than a month after this battle, through a series of interlocking schemes, The Order rapidly sowed discord and divided the Lóng Clan. This incited a civil war, causing the Lóng Clan to fracture into numerous minor families and eventually disappear from the Wulin.

Rumor has it that The Order captured one infant from the Bastion of Mó and another from the Lóng Clan, raising them both in complete secrecy to this day.

items.name: 鬼差和楔子
items.raw_name:
“组织”秘密培养的死士，谓之“鬼差”。

通过施加“楔子命令”——将一个意念像楔子般“钉”入其思想，将原本的思想取而代之，使被施加者自发地认同和遵从这个被“钉”入的意念，进而成为“忠诚”于“组织”的鬼差。

但这终究只是一种催眠之法，无法形成绝对的控制，更无法控制意志强大之人。

items.description_en:
The secret operatives trained by the Order are called Shadow Wardens.

Using a "Mindseal"—driving a single directive into their minds like a wedge, replacing their original thoughts—the subjects are made to accept and obey this directive as if it were their own, ensuring their "loyalty" to the Order as Shadow Wardens.

But in this way, the Mindseal does not bestow absolute control over the subject, but instead is a form of hypnosis, and it cannot control those with powerful wills.

items.name: 秘密酒馆
items.raw_name:
“组织”通过其遍布五湖四海的“酒馆”收取委托，而只完成那些“组织”认定应当出手的委托。

“合格”的委托往往出自于相对弱势的门派或个人，当他们蒙受不白之冤，遭遇不公之事，或在传统江湖的环境中求助无门时，便可以求助于“组织”。

items.description_en:
Commissions for the Order make their way across the Wulin through this network of unassuming Taverns, though few are deemed worthy of the Order's time.

A "worthy" commission is often a request from a powerless sect or individual. One who has suffered an injustice, or cannot seek help via traditional means.

items.name: 青蛇屋
items.raw_name:
<LetterBold>青蛇屋</>，位处<LetterBold>庞镇后街</>，精于仿制诸多江湖秘药。

<LetterBold>赤蛇屋</>，<LetterBold>血色森林长桥以北</>，专研医术、奇术相融之道。

<LetterBold>黑蛇屋</>，<LetterBold>陆家村西隅</>，精研解药。

<LetterBold>白蛇屋</>，<LetterBold>梅谷湖东部岛屿</>，已停止配药。

items.description_en:
, located in the back streets of Pangzhen, specializes in reproducing many secret medicines of the Wulin.

Red Serpent House, north of the long bridge in Crimson Forest, is dedicated to studying the fusion of medicine and Esoteric Arts. 

Black Serpent House, in the western corner of the Village of Lu, specializes in antidotes. 

White Serpent House, on an island in eastern Meigu Lake, has stopped dispensing medicine.

items.name: 沉思杂记
items.description: 沉思者遍历武林各处，纵是无名小派，也绝无偏颇遗漏。而待他倏然而去，诸般奥秘、门派底蕴，皆悉数记载于册。
items.description_en: The Thinker traveled throughout the Wulin, showing no bias and overlooking nothing, not even the smallest nameless sect. And when he departed as suddenly as he came, every mystery and every sect's hidden foundation had been recorded in this volume.

items.name: 影境武林
items.raw_name:
影境东临无尽大海，北及雪原冰川，西面与茫茫荒漠相连，南部则遍布火山沼泽。

平原依耕地而繁荣，河海因商贸而富庶，而山林戈壁则因偏僻贫瘠，或人烟稀少，或动荡不休。

但无论是何处所在，有人的地方，便有三教九流，便有人情世故。一人独行，两人携手，三人齐聚，便有了武林。成千上万的大小门派，各行各业的贩夫走卒，便汇聚成这武林中的芸芸众生。

武林中不乏阴谋诡计，更未曾有过恒久不变的顶峰。但总会有真切的情感、人性应有的尊严与辉光，无法被那残酷的角逐所掩埋。

items.description_en:
The Phantom World meets a boundless sea to the east and fields of snow and glacial ice to the north; a vast desert borders it to the west, and volcanoes and marshland blanket its south.

Its plains prosper on farmland; its rivers and coasts grow rich on trade. Its mountains and wastes, remote and barren, lie sparsely peopled—or in ceaseless turmoil.

Yet wherever there are people, every walk of life follows, and with it all the dealings of the human heart. One walks alone; two join hands; three gather together—and there the Wulin is born. Thousands of sects great and small, tradesmen and laborers of every kind—together they make up the teeming multitude of the Wulin.

The Wulin has never lacked for schemes and treachery, and no one has ever held its summit for long. But there will always be true feeling—the dignity and light that belong to being human—which no cruelty of the contest can bury.

items.name: 正道联盟
items.raw_name:
正道联盟为武林中一众名门正派共同构筑起的庞大联盟力量。

最初，武林的实际掌控者龙氏家族，召集武林中十八个主要的正道门派，组建起“武林正道联盟”，而后逐渐将其壮大，发展为联合了一百七十余门派的强大势力。而随着龙氏覆灭，武林正道联盟声望日渐衰颓。

九年前，“怪面”之乱爆发，武林中人心惶惶动乱不休，正道联盟组织力量抵抗“怪面”，却收效甚微，损失惨重，颇有分崩离析之势。

items.description_en:
A vast alliance made up of major sects in the Wulin.

The Lóng Clan, at the time the ruling power of the Wulin, united eighteen major sects to form The Mandate. The alliance expanded into a massive collective, bringing over 170 different martial arts sects under its umbrella. However, since the fall of the Lóng Clan, the Mandate's influence has been in decline.

Nine years ago, the Maskwalker crisis erupted, spreading fear and unrest throughout the Wulin. The Mandate rallied its forces against the Maskwalkers, but achieved little and suffered heavy losses, leaving the alliance on the verge of falling apart.

items.name: 庞镇
items.raw_name:
庞镇，本是因冰镇酒而兴盛的东方小镇。镇上酒楼众多，风物宜人。

富商巨贾纷纷于此置业安居，更有十二位本地富商，合建商会小筑，后又扩建为演出百戏的戏梦山庄。

items.description_en:
An eastern town that prospered on chilled wine. It is home to many taverns and restaurants, with pleasant scenery and local customs.

Wealthy merchants came here in droves to buy property and settle down. Twelve local magnates even built a small merchant guild hall together, which was later expanded into the Mirage Estate, a venue for grand performances.

items.name: 驿站，难得的休憩之所
items.raw_name:
“怪面”之乱爆发之初，正道联盟于武林各处广设驿站，供往来奔波的侠客、商贾落脚歇息。

然随着怪面日益猖獗，正道式微，驿站也日渐凋敝，纵使屋舍尚存，亦无人打理照应。

而那些仍有正道中人驻守的驿站，便是难得的休憩之所。

items.description_en:
When the "Maskwalker" uprising first broke out, the Mandate established outposts across the Wulin, giving weary wanderers, merchants, and travelers a place to stop and rest.

But as the Maskwalkers grew ever more rampant and the righteous path declined, the outposts gradually fell into ruin. 
Even where the buildings still stand, no one remains to tend them. 

Those outposts that are still guarded by members of the righteous path have become rare places of rest.

items.name: 伤其无血，毒火不侵，独畏雷击。
items.name_en: Their wounds do not bleed, poison and flame cannot harm them, and only lightning can bring them down.
items.raw_name:
“十一人阁”覆灭后，其制造“怪面”的杀气改造塔尽数被毁。唯余塔内熔炉，因无人知晓关闭之法，只得任其日夜空转，黑烟蔽日。

然近年，炉心频生异变。深入塔内者，极易受其污染，体表逐渐硬化如金属。但有僧人的功法可抵御此等侵蚀，甚至能化其力为己用，<LetterBold>伤其无血，毒火不侵，独畏雷击。</>

受此牵连，近来大量僧人被诱入废墟深处，不知这幕后黑手，究竟是何方势力？
items.description: 受此牵连，近来大量僧人被诱入废墟深处，不知这幕后黑手，究竟是何方势力？
items.description_en: As a result, large numbers of monks have recently been lured deep into the ruins. But what force is really behind it all?

items.name: 然若抵达，还需穿过一处山洞。
items.name_en: you'll have to pass through a mountain cave to reach it.
items.raw_name:
这溪谷中的龙柱虽近在眼前，<LetterBold>然若抵达，还需穿过一处山洞。</>

昔年幻术师行事无忌，肆意在影境中撕开连通表里武林的裂缝，终酿滔天大祸。

其间因果，或与当时统御武林的龙氏家族有关。故而为安抚人心，龙氏家族耗巨资，聚异士，筑起封印通路“入口”的“楔子”。便成了这遍布影境的龙柱。

如今，多数龙柱已在龙氏覆灭与怪面之乱中崩毁。但也有部分残柱，竟被其所封之物“唤醒”，反现大凶之象。此处龙柱杀气弥漫，莫非正是此因？

items.description_en:
Long ago, Illusionists of the Phantom Arts acted without restraint, recklessly tearing open Rifts within the Phantom World that connected the Waking Realm and the Discordance. In the end, their actions brought about a devastating catastrophe.

The cause and effect behind it all may somehow be connected to the Lóng Clan, which ruled the Wulin at the time. To ease public fears, the clan spared no expense, gathering skilled masters to construct "Mindseals" that sealed the entrances to these passages. These became the Lóng Pillars scattered throughout the Phantom World.

Today, most of the Lóng Pillars lie in ruins, destroyed during the fall of the Lóng Clan and the Maskwalker uprising. Yet some of the remaining pillars have somehow been "awakened" by the very things they sealed away, showing signs of grave danger. Could that be why this Lóng Pillar is now overflowing with Sha-Chi?

items.name: 里武林
items.raw_name:
里武林，即有着不同于现世时间、空间运作规则的一片异空间。因无数修习“幻术”之人的不断触及、开启，而逐渐显现出宽广与复杂。

里武林中，人的意识可投影出新的事物、景象。已死之人残留的意识，也可在此存在。

而“里武林”中的争斗，虽无流血，却更加凶险——败者会迷失于胜者的幻境中，连心智也被其操纵。

items.description_en:
The Discordance is a realm apart, where time and space operate by different rules from those of the Waking Realm. As countless Illusionists of the Phantom Arts continued to reach into and open the Discordance, its vastness and complexity gradually revealed themselves.

Within the Discordance, human consciousness can project new objects and scenes into existence. Even the lingering consciousness of the dead can persist here.

Though battles within the Discordance spill no blood, they are all the more dangerous. The defeated can become lost within the victor's illusions, their very minds falling under the victor's control.

items.name: 血色森林
items.raw_name:
血色森林，本为苍翠所在。

两年前，昆仑三杰率正道于林间设伏，围剿怪面，战况惨烈。正道、怪面皆尸骸成丘，死伤无数。杀气伴着血气，下渗根须，上染叶脉，浸红满山林木。

而今，借着残存邪器进行了改造的山贼马匪，仍在林中游荡。枝头红叶已愈发凄艳，宛若泣血。

items.description_en:
The Crimson Forest was once a land of deep green.

Two years ago, the Pillars of Kunlun led the Mandate in an ambush against the Maskwalkers here. The battle was brutal. Bodies from both sides piled high, with countless dead and wounded. Sha-Chi mingled with the bloodshed, seeping into the roots below and spreading through the veins of the leaves above, until the entire forest was stained crimson.

Even now, bandits and marauders altered using the corrupted relics left behind still roam these woods. The red leaves have only grown more vivid, as though the forest itself were weeping blood.

items.name: 妙手小张是何许人？
items.raw_name:
江湖中曾有一奇侠，千变万化，真假莫辨，分身亦有数个。专盗名门利刃、稀世秘籍，却从不碰穷人家的米粮。

而今，江湖又出一奇人，分身不多，只有五个，所携奇货，却是无所不有——溶剂、金属、香灰、符纸……样样皆备。凡有价之物，皆可与他交换。

纵然是这般的世道，也无人敢偷他的东西。起这心思的人，要么连他的影子都摸不着，要么便被那系着铜钱的飞刀，高高挂到树上。

如今，此人新接了一桩买卖：为身份非同寻常的雇主，寻访几件遗失的珍宝。

若问此人是谁，论年纪，当非那位奇侠本人，倒该是他子侄辈的人物。

items.description_en:
There was once a legendary wanderer who roamed the Wulin, assuming countless forms until none could tell the real from the false. He even had several Reflections of himself. He stole prized weapons and rare martial manuals from prestigious sects, yet never touched a grain of rice from the poor.

Now, another curious figure has appeared in the Wulin. He has only five Reflections, but the unusual goods he carries cover just about everything: solvents, metal, incense ash, talismans... He has it all. Anything of value can be traded with him.

Even in times like these, no one dares steal from him. Those foolish enough to try either fail to even catch his shadow, or end up hanging high from a tree, courtesy of his coin-strung throwing knives.

Recently, he has taken on a new job: recovering several lost relics for a client of no ordinary standing.

As for who he really is? Judging by his age, he cannot be that legendary wanderer himself. More likely, he is a son or nephew of his.

items.name: 白山派
items.raw_name:
立派数百年之久的白山派曾为武林大派，更是武林正道的中流砥柱。

直到彼年的掌门继任大会，独孤灵鹤凭借杀气改造的力量，血洗了整个白山，以报昔年杀子之仇。自此，白山派再不复往日鼎盛。

门派倾颓之际，毕桃桃担起掌门之职，重整旗鼓，并率领众弟子加入了昆仑三杰领导的正道力量，共抗怪面。

items.description_en:
Founded several centuries ago, the Baishan Sect was once one of the great sects of the Wulin and a pillar of the righteous path.

That changed at a succession ceremony for the sect's new leader, when Dugu Linghe used the power of Transcension to slaughter her way through Baishan, avenging the death of her child years before. From that day on, the Baishan Sect never regained its former glory.

With the sect on the brink of collapse, Bi Taotao took up the mantle of sect leader and rallied its disciples. She then led them in joining the righteous forces under the Three Pillars of Kunlun to fight the Maskwalkers.

items.name: 镜林游记
items.raw_name:
今日独行，误入林薮深处。烟霞渐浓，笼罩四野，忽见一古榕蟠踞于前，肤理纠结，迥非凡俗。

其干罅隙间，竟生一人面，轮廓栩栩，神情诡谲，引人心胆生寒。霎时，此树方圆妖氛乍现，乾坤倒错，邪异之象破空而出……心下大骇，急寻出路。
items.description:
今日独行，误入林薮深处。烟霞渐浓，笼罩四野，忽见一古榕蟠踞于前，肤理纠结，迥非凡俗。

其干罅隙间，竟生一人面，轮廓栩栩，神情诡谲，引人心胆生寒。霎时，此树方圆妖氛乍现，乾坤倒错，邪异之象破空而出……心下大骇，急寻出路。
items.description_en:
I strayed deep into the woods while wandering alone today. A thick haze rolled in and swallowed every direction, and then an ancient banyan stood before me, its gnarled bark twisting in patterns that belonged to no ordinary tree. In the cracks of its trunk, I swear, there had grown a human face—lifelike in its features, sinister in its expression, chilling me to the marrow.

In an instant an evil air burst forth all around the tree, as if heaven and earth had turned inside out, and unnatural horrors came tearing through the empty air...Terror seized my heart, and I searched frantically for a way out.

items.name: 陆家村
items.raw_name:
陆家村，依山傍水，毗邻庞镇，故而早年便有飞贼，在村中暗设往来庞镇的密道，贩运黑货。

而为着村后梅谷湖北、枷笼山山顶，供奉着列祖列宗的陆氏宗祠，哪怕是“怪面之乱”后，此地仍屡遭怪面余孽侵扰，仍有许多村民，坚守在村中。

后来，“昆仑三杰”来此剿除怪面，为这风雨飘摇的村子撑起了一片庇护与希望。

然一年前的那场惨胜后，昆仑三杰再未共守大营；正道大营亦元气大伤，变故渐生；正道联盟更是名存实亡。陆氏村民也再次失去依仗。

他们似乎彻底断了拔剑反抗的念想。近一年来，村中对“蒙花圣母”的信仰格外盛行，甚至四下蔓延。

items.description_en:
Nestled between the mountains and the water, the Village of Lu lies close to Pangzhen. Years ago, smugglers secretly dug a tunnel between the village and Pangzhen, using it to smuggle illicit goods back and forth.

Beyond the village, north of Meigu Lake, the Lu Clan Shrine stands atop the Mountain of Imprisonment, where generations of the clan's ancestors are enshrined. Even after the Maskwalker uprising, when remnants of the Maskwalkers continued to raid the area, many villagers refused to leave their home.

Later, the Pillars of Kunlun came to hunt down the remaining Maskwalkers, giving the beleaguered village a measure of safety and hope.

But after the costly victory a year ago, the Pillars of Kunlun never again stood together at the Mandate Encampment. The encampment itself was left gravely weakened, trouble began to spread within its ranks, and before long, the Mandate existed in name only. The villagers of Lu once again found themselves with no one to rely on.

It seems they have since abandoned any thought of taking up arms in resistance. Over the past year, worship of The Merciful Lady of the Blossom Veil has taken a powerful hold in the village and has begun spreading well beyond it.

items.name: 龙氏家族
items.raw_name:
龙氏家族，武林正道联盟的领导者，江湖公认的第一世家。

龙氏以商贾起家，继而逐步暗控武林财脉，更创立独门武学，以独有的金色剑气名震江湖。

除了极具威势的财力与武力，龙氏家族亦行事光明磊落，兼具裁决江湖是非之威望，故而深受传统正道门派的敬服与追随。

聚拢同道，铁腕伐异，使龙氏长盛不衰。而在鼎盛背后，龙氏内部的争斗，也从未止息过。

items.description_en:
The Lóng Clan stood at the head of the Mandate and was widely regarded as the foremost family in the Wulin.

The clan began as merchants, gradually gaining control over much of the Wulin's wealth and trade. In time, they also developed their own unique martial arts, becoming renowned for their signature Golden Sword Qi.

Yet the Lóng Clan commanded respect for more than its wealth and martial strength. Known for acting with honor and integrity, the clan also earned a reputation as a trusted arbiter of disputes throughout the martial world. As a result, many traditional Mandate sects respected their authority and willingly rallied behind them.

By gathering allies and dealing ruthlessly with their rivals, the Lóng Clan remained powerful for generations. But beneath the height of its prosperity, infighting within the clan never truly ceased.

items.name: 暗魔天堡
items.raw_name:
暗魔天堡，昔年江湖唯一能与龙氏分庭抗礼的“黑道”势力。

其先祖意外与龙氏家族结怨，以致暗魔天堡被龙氏为首的江湖正道敌视打压。

身负奇异血脉，天性孤高冷傲的魔堡中人，无心角逐，却也不惧敌对。抗衡之中，魔堡获得了边缘门派与叛逆之众的拥戴，也顺势成为“异端”的庇护。

而不同于龙氏家族，暗魔天堡避世独立，不立宗派；族中人丁不盛，但理念相通。加之独特的武功与行事作风，使得魔堡以一种神秘的强大威慑武林。

直至三十余年前，暗魔天堡覆灭在一场蓄谋已久的大火中。

items.description_en:
The Bastion of Mó was once the only outlaw power in the Wulin capable of rivaling the Lóng Clan.

The Bastion's forebears became embroiled in a feud with the Lóng clan by chance. From then on, the Bastion faced hostility and suppression from the orthodox forces of the Wulin, led by the Lóng Clan.

Born of an unusual bloodline, the people of the Bastion were proud and aloof by nature. They had little interest in vying for power, but neither did they fear those who opposed them. In standing against their enemies, the Bastion gained the support of fringe sects and rebellious outcasts, and in turn became a refuge for those branded as "heretics."

Unlike the Lóng Clan, the Bastion of Mó kept to itself and never formed a sect. Its numbers were few, but its people were united by shared ideals. Their distinctive martial arts and way of doing things gave the Bastion an air of mystery and a formidable presence throughout the Wulin.

That all ended more than thirty years ago, when the Bastion of Mó was destroyed in a fire that had been planned long in advance.

items.name: 八卦阁
items.raw_name:
八卦阁乃武林中消息汇聚之所，散布影境各地，分号五十有余。

其分号主事，皆非“八卦童子”；江湖之中，亦无此号人物。

然若将五十余位主事算作一人，便成了那所谓的“八卦童子”。

天下没有“八卦童子”不知道的事。

items.description_en:
The Pavilion of Knowledge is the martial world's foremost source of information, with more than fifty branches scattered across the Phantom World.

None of those branches is run by anyone called the "Child of Insight." In fact, no such person exists anywhere in the martial world.

But take the heads of all fifty-odd branches together, and they become the so-called "Child of Insight."

There is nothing under heaven the "Child of Insight" does not know.

items.name: 梅谷六景
items.raw_name:
百年前，此地兵戈鏖战，白骨沉泥。后有渔者网鲤，丰硕鲜美，竟胜他处百倍。又有梅树伴水而生，红艳欲滴。

故风雅之士日渐结庐于此，讳谓“埋骨”，便更名“梅谷”，又建乐坊，赏梅听曲。

然每逢阴雨之夜，犹有金戈铁马声于此低徊。

items.description_en:
A hundred years ago, armies clashed fiercely here, leaving white bones sunk into the mud. Years later, fishermen found the carp in these waters unusually plump and flavorful, far beyond those caught elsewhere. Plum trees also began to flourish along the shore, their blossoms a dripping crimson.

In time, scholars and other men of refined taste began building retreats here. Avoiding the ominous name "Maigu," or "Buried Bones," they gave the place the more graceful name "Meigu," or "Plum Valley," and built song houses where they could admire the blossoms and listen to songs.

Yet on rainy nights, the clash of weapons and the thunder of warhorses can still be heard lingering.

items.name: 断魂山地志
items.raw_name:
断魂山者，位处梅谷湖西北隅，山势奇绝，峰峦叠嶂。其间至高至险者，断魂崖也。

昔年崖顶突现奇观，戾气冲霄，当日竟飘飞雪，自此经年不化，再鲜有过客。更有传曰：“霜雪落，神鬼殁！”

items.description_en:
Soulrend Mountain lies in the northwestern corner of Meigu Lake. Its terrain is strange and perilous, with ridges rising one upon another. The highest and most treacherous among them is Soulrend Cliff.

In years past, a strange phenomenon suddenly appeared atop the cliff. A baleful aura surged into the sky, and the snow that fell on that very day has not melted in all the years since, with few travelers now daring to pass through. Some even say, "When frost and snow descend, gods and ghosts perish!"

items.name: 江湖异闻线索
items.description:
途中所受之托，暗查之事，兼几桩无人肯再细究的江湖秘事，尽数纳于此处。

若遇离奇异闻无从着手，不妨重翻旧录。字里行间，或有一二线索。
items.description_en:
Every commission taken on the road, every matter investigated in secret, and several mysteries of the martial world that no one else cared to pursue are recorded here.

If a strange case ever leaves you unsure where to begin, try looking through these old records again. Somewhere between the lines, a clue or two may be waiting.

items.name: “残钢刃”
items.raw_name:
今有狂暴怪面作乱溪谷一带。持一残破锈刃，凶戾非常。凡中招者，皆血如泉涌，应正是我队此前遗失的<LetterBold>“残钢刃”</>！

着尔等速往溪谷夺回此刀，<LetterBold>切记秘密行事，勿使荒大人知晓！</>否则我等全队人头不保！

<right>队长 陈柱</>

[Congealeaf]

It likes the water and often clings to rocks or the edges of riverbanks. Follow the stream, and you will find some eventually.

items.name: 员外的玉带
items.raw_name:
当年我也是个人物。十三岁偷<LetterBold>员外的玉带</>，十七岁摸了正道掌门的账本……

可那天翻墙一腾手，金簪子落进那穷人家的草垛子……那家小孩扒拉出来，欢喜地叫喊着，“爹的病有救了！”我就想，罢了，老子这是劫富济贫，是积德，光彩。

谁知第二日，那家男人被当贼打死，女人被发卖，孩子也丢了……我老能梦着那女人……心口插着那簪子，<LetterBold>簪头蝴蝶</>的翅膀一颤……一颤……

……是我害了他们……那孩子……我一直在找……若我遇难……请告知……<LetterBold>梁上君</>。

items.description_en:
. At seventeen, I lifted the account book of a Mandate sect leader...

Then one day, as I climbed over a wall, a gold hairpin slipped from my hand and fell into a poor family's haystack. Their child dug it out and cried with joy, "Father can be saved!" I thought, fine. I rob the rich to help the poor. That's a good deed. Something to be proud of.

The next day, the man was beaten to death as a thief. The woman was sold off. The child disappeared... I keep dreaming of that woman... with that hairpin buried in her chest, the wings of the butterfly on its head trembling... trembling...

...I did this to them... That child... I've never stopped looking... If I don't make it... please tell... the Gentle Thief.

items.name: 花千笑：
items.raw_name:
<LetterBold>花千笑：</>
剑痴。原为道门掌门，嗜酒如命，持五尺长剑，善舞醉剑，酒意愈浓则剑法愈凌厉，实力难测。
宜以灵动迅捷之招式扰其剑势，克其长刃。

<LetterBold>荆野：</>
亡命之徒。常乘快马，手持刺棘盾，腰悬斩马长刀，心性阴狠，出手不留活口。
宜以凌厉强攻破其守势，并施幻术远攻扰其心神。

<LetterBold>铁狂：</>
拳痴。赤身搏战，拳路多变，拳风刚猛。
以刚克刚绝非上策，宜以轻灵身法游斗周旋。

<LetterBold>白赤练：</>
身世不详，所持兵刃奇诡非常，可化蛇形攀咬，招式阴柔诡谲。
蛇行虽诡，反惧强攻，兼以幻术远攻，当可压制。

items.description_en:
The Sword Fanatic. Formerly the leader of a Daoist sect, he drinks heavily and wields a five-foot-long sword, specializing in Drunken Sword techniques. The more intoxicated he becomes, the fiercer his swordplay grows, making his true strength difficult to gauge.
Use swift, agile techniques to disrupt his swordplay and counter the reach of his long blade.

Jingye
A ruthless outlaw who often fights on horseback. He carries a spiked shield and a long horse-slaying saber, and never leaves his opponents alive.
Break through his defenses with fierce, aggressive attacks, while using ranged Phantom Arts to disrupt his focus.

Iron Fever
A fist fanatic who fights bare-chested. His boxing style is highly varied, and his strikes are fierce and powerful.
Meeting force with force is ill-advised. Use light, agile movement to circle him and wear him down.

Bai Chilian
Little is known of her origins. Her bizarre weapon can take on the form of a serpent, coiling and biting at its prey, while her techniques are subtle and unpredictable.
Though her serpentine attacks are difficult to read, they are vulnerable to aggressive pressure. Combine strong frontal attacks with ranged Phantom Arts to keep her suppressed.

items.name: 歌女人偶的书信
items.raw_name:
沛郎：

奴家任性，何尝不是郎君疼出来的？郎君怎能如此薄情，转头便埋怨皆是奴家的过错……

奴家便等在与郎君定下终身之地……纵使海枯石烂，天崩地裂，奴家也要等到心心念念的郎君！

<right>庆娘 念君</>
items.description:
沛郎：

奴家任性，何尝不是郎君疼出来的？郎君怎能如此薄情，转头便埋怨皆是奴家的过错……

奴家便等在与郎君定下终身之地……纵使海枯石烂，天崩地裂，奴家也要等到心心念念的郎君！

庆娘 念君
items.description_en:
My dear Pei,

Was I not spoiled into such willfulness by your own affection? How can you now be so heartless as to turn around and lay all the blame at my feet...

I will wait for you at the place where we pledged our eternal love to each other... Even if the seas run dry, the stones crumble, and Heaven and Earth fall apart, I will remain there until my dream man returns to me.

Longing for you，
Qingniang

items.name: 假身
items.raw_name:
要离开了……荡秽大人没有亲自动手……

他召唤了<LetterBold>假身</>。它与大人样貌相同，但<LetterBold>眼睛，都是红色</>的……它会<LetterBold>协助大人，保护大家，有它在，很少受伤</>……

可这次，它要来处理我们了……残次品……只能丢弃……梦差大人的命令，荡秽大人没办法。

大家说，没关系……大人已经为我们做了很多了。
items.description:
。它与大人样貌相同，但眼睛，都是红色的……它会协助大人，保护大家，有它在，很少受伤……

items.description_en:
. It looks just like him, but both its eyes are red... It helps him and protects us. With it here, we rarely get hurt...

But this time, it's here to dispose of us... Defective... To be discarded... The Herald's orders. Master Dusk has no choice.

Everyone says it is all right... He has already done so much for us.

items.name: 娘娘的嘱托
items.raw_name:
……汝等……方石……网中……

……物供之吾乃……外天自源……

……速奉此物……至梅谷湖西……吾之法相座前……

……苦厄……如是……吾允解之……
items.description:
……汝等……方石……网中……

……物供之吾乃……外天自源……

……速奉此物……至梅谷湖西……吾之法相座前……

items.description_en:
"...you... the square stone... caught within the net...

...offer it unto me... I, whose origin lies beyond the heavens...

...bring it swiftly... west of Meigu Lake... before my sacred image...

...your suffering... so be it... I grant release..."

items.name: 哥哥的来信（阿袖亲启）
items.raw_name:
吾妹阿袖：

知你受苦，为兄心如刀绞。今随信附上移魂圣水，速令婢女饮下，并以圣母之花覆面。

娘娘慈悲，必显灵佑，解此危难！

<right>兄  阿瑾</>
items.description:
吾妹阿袖：

知你受苦，为兄心如刀绞。今随信附上移魂圣水，速令婢女饮下，并以圣母之花覆面。

兄  阿瑾
items.description_en:
My dear sister Xiu,

The thought of what you have suffered cuts your brother to the heart. Enclosed with this letter is sacred Soul Displacement water. Have your maid drink it at once, then cover her face with the Lady's Blossom.

The Lady is merciful. She will surely reveal her grace and deliver you from danger!

Your brother, Jin

items.name: 断裂铁剑
items.raw_name:
<LetterBold>断裂铁剑</>
刘大侠总是凶巴巴的，但其实是个好人！

<LetterBold>女侠发钗</>
婉姐姐最心爱的发钗。我也想像她一样勇敢！

<LetterBold>漆黑的刀鞘</>
一定是无影客的。可惜，我只找到刀鞘……

无影客说过，八卦童子知道很多大侠的事，大侠们的东西，也都可以给他保管。可等大侠们回来了，发现自己的东西不见了，那该多着急？

items.description_en:
It's Master Liu's sword! He always looks angry, but he's actually a nice person!

Heroine's Hairpin
This is Sister Wan's favorite hairpin. One day, I'll be as brave as she is!

 Pitch-Black Scabbard
It must belong to The Shadowless Traveler. But I only managed to find the scabbard...

The Traveler said the Child of Insight knows everything about the heroes, and will happily accept their possessions. But won't the heroes be upset if they came back and all their stuff was gone?

items.name: 白雪儿……刺穿腹部……“瞧，大柱哥，那边的云像小兔子。”
items.name_en: Bai Xue... abdomen pierced... "Look, Dazhu. That cloud looks like a little rabbit."
items.raw_name:
方立，村民。斩首，生前最后一句：“我、我没得罪你吧？”

老枯，大夫。斩首。“你这身子骨要保重啊。”

秦菊花，馒头贩。横劈。“馒头刚出炉，你尝尝。”

邓诡匠。斩首。“前面溪流很急，当心。”

无名农夫。刺穿心脏。“……明年的红薯更大。”

<LetterBold>白雪儿……刺穿腹部……“瞧，大柱哥，那边的云像小兔子。”</>

items.name: 周平子的遗书（致雨玲书）
items.raw_name:
雨玲：

是我无用……若有来世，愿为侠客，百死无惧，唯求护卿……

<right>周平子</>
items.description:
雨玲：

是我无用……若有来世，愿为侠客，百死无惧，唯求护卿……

周平子
items.row_name: 周平子的遗书（致雨玲书）
items.description_en:
Yu Ling,

It was I who was useless... If there is another life, may I become a hero, fearless even in a hundred deaths, asking only to protect you...

Zhou Pingzi

items.name: 陆三迁绝笔：解元亲启
items.raw_name:
解元吾儿：

爹知道，陆氏百年宗祠改建成了圣母娘娘庙，你心有不平。但这是咱们陆氏造的孽障，咱就得还！

爹按梦里娘娘的嘱托，上山顶祈福。这路虽是凶险，却总能得一位高人相助。想来是娘娘知……

（信件戛然而止，突兀地留下一段墨痕。似是匆促停笔，再未能写完。）
