items.description_en:
My son Jieyuan,

I know you resent that the Lu ancestral hall, which stood for a hundred years, was converted into a shrine to the Lady. But this is a debt our clan created, and we must repay it.

Following the Lady's instructions in my dream, I am climbing to the summit to pray for blessings. The road is dangerous, yet a mysterious master always appears to help me. Surely the Lady knows...

(The letter ends abruptly in a sudden smear of ink, as though the writer stopped in haste and never returned to finish it.)

items.name: 村民遗物调查
items.description: 散落在村野间的几页皱纸，记着他们咬牙熬过的日子，记着他们也曾在这世上，用力活过。
items.description_en: A few crumpled pages scattered through the countryside, preserving the days they endured through gritted teeth, and proof that they, too, once fought hard to make a life in this world.

items.name: 绝望血书
items.raw_name:
都是怪面……不……村里那些……更可怕！

……圣母娘娘保佑！
items.description:
都是怪面……不……村里那些……更可怕！

……圣母娘娘保佑！
items.description_en: The Maskwalkers... no... Those back in the village... are even more terrifying! May the merciful Lady protect me!

items.name: 废弃田契
items.raw_name: 立契人，卖方，吴光耀，系溪谷农户。怪面凶残，毁我家室，致我一门九口仅存三人，屋舍倾颓难以为继，田亩荒芜无力稼穑。故变卖祖遗良田一段……

items.description_en: Seller: Wu Guangyao, a farmer of the Creek Valley. Those Maskwalkers ravaged my home and family, leaving only three survivors out of nine. Our ancestral home has been torn apart and desecrated. Our fields are barren, and there's no one left to till the soil. I have no choice but to sell the precious land passed down from my forefathers.

items.name: 村民借据
items.raw_name:
借银人吴铁山，溪谷农户，今向王员外借银三十两。全数用于锻造利器，共抗怪面之灾。待赶走怪面，即刻归还此银，月利二分，秋收为限。

<right>借银人：吴铁山（手印）      </>
<right>见证人：里长 吴守业（画押）</>

items.description_en:
Borrower Wu Tieshan, a farmer of the Creek Valley, hereby borrows thirty taels of silver from Master Wang. The full amount will be used to forge weapons for the fight against the Maskwalkers. Once the Maskwalkers have been driven off, the loan will be repaid without delay, at monthly interest of two fen, with the autumn harvest as the final deadline.

Borrower: Wu Tieshan (fingerprint)
Witness: Village Head Wu Shouye (mark)

items.name: 山村布告
items.raw_name:
诸溪谷父老乡亲：

乡亲们勿要慌张，只管全力布设防护、轮值守夜。

等到武林正道联盟的高手们抵达，定能斩除怪面，还咱们村庄安宁！

<right>里长 吴守业</>
items.description:

乡亲们勿要慌张，只管全力布设防护、轮值守夜。

里长 吴守业
items.description_en:
To all the good people of the Creek Valley:

Please remain calm. Focus on creating barricades with whatever you have and keep watch at night.

Once the Mandate's elite fighters arrive, they will surely drive out the Maskwalkers and restore peace to our village!

Village Head, 
Wu Shouye

items.name: 寻子启事
items.raw_name:
急寻幼子，愿以粮米五石酬谢！

吴小满，男，六岁，圆脸，四月廿五黄昏随乡迁往北部农户避难时走失。最爱笑，呼名即应。

恳请知情者，速至北部农户找吴庆、阿兰夫妇。
items.description:
急寻幼子，愿以粮米五石酬谢！

恳请知情者，速至北部农户找吴庆、阿兰夫妇。
items.description_en:
Urgent: missing child. Reward of five bushels of grain!

Wu Xiaoman, male, six years old, round-faced. He went missing at dusk on the 25th of the fourth month, while the village was evacuating to the northern farmsteads. He loves to smile and will answer when called by name.

Anyone with information, please contact his parents, Wu Qing and A-Lan, at the northern farmsteads as soon as possible.

items.name: 与家人联络的信件（与伯父的联络信）
items.raw_name:
伯父敬启：

近日庞镇突发一种嗜睡怪病，家父家母似也受了影响，日渐精神不济，令人心忧。

侄儿念及您在镇南的田庄清静，故斗胆修书，恳请暂借栖身，避此时疫。叨扰之处，侄儿先行谢罪。

<right>侄 明远 敬上</>

items.row_name: 与家人联络的信件（与伯父的联络信）
items.description_en:
Dearest Uncle,

A strange sleeping sickness has recently broken out in Pangzhen. My father and mother seem to have been affected as well, growing more tired by the day. I am deeply worried for them.

I remember that your estate south of town is quiet and secluded, so I have taken the liberty of writing to ask whether we might stay there for a time and avoid the outbreak. I apologize in advance for the trouble.

Your nephew, Mingyuan, respectfully

items.name: 保护小姐的嘱托
items.raw_name:
林锋吾士：

与许氏联姻，事关我范氏颜面与小女终身。

现命你率精锐十人，暗中随行护卫。务必确保送嫁车队如期抵达。

<right>范氏家主  示</>
items.description:
林锋吾士：

与许氏联姻，事关我范氏颜面与小女终身。

现命你率精锐十人，暗中随行护卫。务必确保送嫁车队如期抵达。

范氏家主  示
items.description_en:
Lin Feng, my trusted retainer,

This marriage alliance with the Xu family concerns both the honor of the Fan Clan and my daughter's future.

I hereby order you to lead ten elite men and discreetly escort the bridal procession. You must ensure that it reaches its destination on schedule.

Issued by the Head of the Fan Clan

items.name: 《水井封锁告示》
items.raw_name:
告全村父老乡亲：

凡惊扰井中邪祟者，不单祸及乡里，更背弃圣母神恩，罪大恶极！

昨夜丑时，樵夫陆阿四违禁触井，今晨其意识已附于人偶中哀哭不止。望诸公引以为戒！
items.description:
告全村父老乡亲：

凡惊扰井中邪祟者，不单祸及乡里，更背弃圣母神恩，罪大恶极！

昨夜丑时，樵夫陆阿四违禁触井，今晨其意识已附于人偶中哀哭不止。望诸公引以为戒！
items.description_en:
To all villagers:

Anyone who disturbs the evil within the well will not only bring calamity upon the village, but also betray the divine grace of the Lady of the Veil. Such an offense is unforgivable!

Last nigh, woodcutter Lu A-Si defied the prohibition and touched the well. By this morning, his consciousness had already become bound to a puppet, where he has wept without end. Let this serve as a warning to all!

items.name: 【坚守村民的日志】中秋
items.raw_name:
没人有心思赏月了，都在盼着失踪的人能回来。

老久倒是回来了，可又好像不是他了，像没了魂，不理人。小桂今日也病了，突然就睡倒在田里头，怎么喊都不醒。

井水，味儿好像真的变了……
items.description:
没人有心思赏月了，都在盼着失踪的人能回来。

老久倒是回来了，可又好像不是他了，像没了魂，不理人。小桂今日也病了，突然就睡倒在田里头，怎么喊都不醒。

井水，味儿好像真的变了……
items.description_en:
No one's in the mood to admire the moon anymore. We're all just waiting for the missing to come home.

Old Man Jiu did, but he's not himself anymore. It's like he lost his soul, giving no response to others.

Little Gui got sick today too. He fell asleep in the fields. No matter how much we called to him, he wouldn't wake up.

The well water... it really does seem to taste different.

items.name: 【坚守村民的日志】霜降
items.raw_name:
那木头人又在敲门，一直用娘的声音问我：“孩儿，病好了没有。”我想出去打水，可一开门，它就会突然扑上来，像人偶，被线拽了过来。

怕是真让老烟鬼说对了，那些木头疙瘩里，是人的魂儿……
items.description:
那木头人又在敲门，一直用娘的声音问我：“孩儿，病好了没有。”我想出去打水，可一开门，它就会突然扑上来，像人偶，被线拽了过来。

怕是真让老烟鬼说对了，那些木头疙瘩里，是人的魂儿……
items.description_en:
That Wooden Puppet is knocking again. It keeps using Mother's voice and asking, "My child, are you feeling better?"

I want to go outside and get some water, but every time I open the door, it jumps at me. Like a puppet being yanked forward by strings.

Maybe Old Smoker was right... Maybe there really are people's souls inside those wooden things...

items.name: 治丧簿
items.raw_name:
逝者陆三进，村中长者，素有名望。

停灵第三日夜，忽现一队木人孩童，前拥后簇，前来吊唁。焚香叩拜后飘然离去，似有形无实。唯落一纸名簿，为近年病重昏睡之孩童姓名。

众人惊叹，此乃陆氏子孙感念先辈恩德，前来告别也。

名簿所录：
明轩之子 志远
明德之女 慧心
福生之子 念恩
……

items.description_en:
The deceased, Lu Sanjin, was a respected elder of the village.

On the third night of the wake, a procession of Wooden Puppet children suddenly appeared, crowding around one another as they came to pay their respects. After burning incense and bowing in reverence, they drifted away as mysteriously as they had come, seeming to have form yet no true substance. Only a register was left behind, bearing the names of children who, in recent years, had fallen gravely ill and into deep sleep.

The crowd marveled, believing these to be descendants of the Lu Clan, grateful for the kindness of their forebear and come to bid him farewell.

Names recorded in the register:
Zhiyuan, son of Mingxuan
Huixin, daughter of Mingde
Nian'en, son of Fusheng
...

items.name: 庞镇众生相
items.description:
仿佛还是昨日的事。街上车马不歇，商贩的吆喝伴着戏台的唱腔，又一并没入锣鼓与鞭炮的轰响。

喧嚣把角落里的哀声冲得极淡，淡到似乎来不及传出巷子，便断在了风中。
items.description_en:
It feels like only yesterday. Carts and horses streamed endlessly through the streets, vendors called out over the strains of opera from the stage, and all of it dissolved into the thunder of gongs, drums, and firecrackers.

The noise drowned out the cries from a forgotten corner until they faded to near silence, barely escaping the alley before vanishing into the wind.

items.name: 无人理会的诉状
items.raw_name: 夫庞三，为得银两，前去试行“心脏移换法”，自此未归……小儿前去寻人，却被……
items.description: 夫庞三，为得银两，前去试行“心脏移换法”，自此未归……小儿前去寻人，却被……
items.description_en: My husband, Pang San, left to undergo Heart Displacement Art in exchange for money, but hasn't come home since. Our little boy went to look for him, and they...

items.name: 画押的契据
items.raw_name:
立契人，庞平，自愿试心脏移换，换取银钱二十两。特此立据。

Brother, you... stay far away...

Dad,

Grandma keeps asking me who Chang Qing is. I tell her Chang Qing is dad, our family's hero. But Grandma always forgets.

items.raw_name:
顺子：

我这条命是要交代给怪面了。如今最放不下的，就是阿妙、阿心和阿茹。

她们娘死得早，但都是好孩子。阿妙会持家，阿心烧得一手好菜，唯阿茹顽劣些，但最可人疼……

兄弟一场，她们仨，我便托付给你了！

<right>愚兄 庞辙 绝笔</>

辙哥安息，我定不负所托！

items.description_en:
Shun:

It seems my life will end at the hands of the Maskwalkers. What I cannot bear to leave behind now are Miao, Xin, and Ru.

Their mother died when they were young, but they are all good girls. Miao knows how to manage a household, and Xin is an excellent cook. Ru is a little more unruly than the others, but she is the most lovable of the three...

We have been brothers all these years. I entrust the three of them to you!

Your brother, Pang Zhe

[A newly written line.]
Rest in peace, Brother Zhe. I will not fail you!

items.name: 镇民的日记·残页
items.raw_name:
廿八 夜

打更人在唱童谣……分明是老汉的嗓子，调子却是女童才有的。我从窗缝往外看，就见他脊梁反弓着正在爬墙，脖子还拧了半圈冲我笑说：“来陪囡囡呀！”

这庞镇，已经待不得了！
items.description:
廿八 夜

打更人在唱童谣……分明是老汉的嗓子，调子却是女童才有的。我从窗缝往外看，就见他脊梁反弓着正在爬墙，脖子还拧了半圈冲我笑说：“来陪囡囡呀！”

这庞镇，已经待不得了！
items.description_en:
Twenty-Eighth, Night

The night watchman was singing a nursery rhyme... It was clearly an old man’s voice, yet the tune sounded like something only a little girl would sing. I peered through a crack in the window and saw him crawling up the wall, his spine arched backward. Then he twisted his neck halfway around, smiled at me, and said, “Come keep the little girl company!”

I can’t stay in Pangzhen any longer!

items.description_en:
I, Li, hereby sell one ancestral home in Pangzhen, three acres of farmland in the backstreets, and my dowry items, including a red willowwood chest, a pair of silver hairpins, and a silk-wrapped jade bracelet, for a total of 270 taels of silver. All proceeds shall be given to my only son, Li Yang, so that he may join the Mandate and train in martial arts.

With this contract established, payment and goods are fully exchanged. This contract shall stand as proof and may not be revoked.

items.raw_name:

哥那日说的都是气话，你怎的真往心里去，大半年都没个信儿？

年关就快到了，尽早回来就是！这些年，哥也攒了些钱，总该够你娶媳妇用了。

<right>兄  庞阿福</>

Brother,

Everything I said that day was just in anger. How could you really take it to heart and not send a word for over half a year? 

The New Year is almost here. Just come home soon! I've saved up some money over the years. It should be enough for you to find a wife.  

Your brother,
Pang Fu

items.raw_name:
患者素来身体康健。饮井水后身患怪疾，神志日渐昏沉，已历三月有余。

初时精神萎靡不振。

第二月，言语颠倒，不识亲朋，时而木讷。

第三月，长睡不醒，四肢僵直。

items.description_en:
Patient was in good health prior to onset. Developed a strange illness after drinking well water. Mental clarity gradually declined, with symptoms persisting for over three months.  

Initially, patient appeared lethargic and weak.  

Second Stage, speech became incoherent. Patient no longer recognized family and friends, and at times became withdrawn and unresponsive.  

Third Stage, patient fell into prolonged sleep and could not be awakened. Limbs became rigid.

items.name: 武生词
items.raw_name:
昔日同侪共正道，庞镇诛邪骤生变。
戏台幻术红颜醉，欲焚道牒换戏缘。

我虽不解幻法意，仍助红颜得所愿。
正道责我道不辨，厮杀怪面遣阵前。

惊闻红颜芳容改，急往故地心如焚。
不言重逢只相劝，莫让歧途误此身！

尊者老儿名声诡，恐是邪法害红颜。
才女妹妹莫深陷，此乃旁门左道焉！

items.description_en:
Once, my comrades and I walked the righteous path. But when Pangzhen purged evil, everything changed.
A play and a beauty's charm led me astray. I would have burned my righteous seal for this love.  

Though I knew not the secrets of illusion, I still helped her fulfill her wish.
The righteous blamed me for failing to see the truth and sent me to fight the Maskwalkers.  

When I heard her beauty had changed, I rushed back to where it all began.
I spoke not of our reunion, but only urged her: Do not lose yourself on this wrong path!  

That old man known as the Venerable One has a suspicious reputation. I fear his dark arts have harmed her.
Talented sister, do not fall deeper. This is but a crooked path of forbidden arts!

items.name: 青衣词
items.raw_name:
看他那，五彩霞光冲霄汉，变幻莫测引人叹。
叹一声，此等绝学世间稀，愿拜隐士高人前。

绝学之路本艰辛，舍身求法我甘愿。
但知郎君一片意，仍赴庞镇来相见。

items.description_en:
Behold, five-colored light that pierces the heavens,
Its endless changes leave all amazed. Such peerless arts are rare in this world; I wish to learn beneath a hidden master.  

The path to mastery is filled with hardship,
Yet I would give all to seek it. Knowing only my beloved's sincerity, I still travel to Pangzhen to meet him.

items.name: 字迹纤细的日记
items.raw_name:
初五 小雨

徐二哥来找我，被爹撞见了。我只是想拦住爹……可爹倒在地上，浑身是血……我的锄头上，也沾着好多血……一定是圣母娘娘显灵了！终于可以和徐二哥浪迹天涯了！徐二哥，一定会对我好的……

items.description_en:
Fifth Day — Light Rain

Brother Xu came to see me, and Father caught us. I only meant to stop Father... but he fell to the ground covered in blood... and there was so much blood on my hoe, too... The Lady must have revealed her power! At last, Brother Xu and I can roam the world together! Brother Xu will surely treat me well...

items.description_en:
Honored Master Ming,

I have long heard how heavily official duties weigh upon you. Might you have a moment of leisure in the near future?
A new song house has opened on Meigu Lake, bringing celebrated performers and musicians from the capital. Nobles from the imperial region and heroes of the Wulin alike have praised it as an exquisite destination. I thought it might suit your refined tastes and hoped you would come experience it for yourself.

These few hurried lines cannot express my full sincerity. I respectfully await your arrival.

Your humble subordinate, Li Zimao

The Pillars of Kunlun continue to claim victories against the enemy. As of now, the Maskwalker army north of the forest grows smaller by the day. The peace in the Wulin is finally within reach!

[Day 342]
Dayong's right arm... there was no saving it. He dropped to his knees and begged us to let him try Transcension. None of us could bear to see him like that, so in the end, we all agreed.

Whatever guilt comes of this, we'll bear it together.

Huzi

To Sect Leader Bi of the Baishan Sect,

I have long heard of the Baishan Sect's deep foundations and abundance of talent. Who would have thought it could fall into such dire straits? I, too, am deeply concerned.

Still, since you have the leisure to write this letter, I trust you must already have some clever plan in hand. Things are rather different here. We have been locked in bitter fighting for days. Much as I would like to send support, I fear we would be of little use and might only create further trouble... I hope your esteemed sect will understand.

Lingran, respectfully

All Maskwalkers are to be killed on sight. Show no mercy!

The Mandate (seal)

(A large number of fingerprint seals)

items.name: 【谢园往事】其一
items.raw_name:
恩师谢回春，是谢家武学传人，但于他而言，救死扶伤，远比以武艺和力量叱咤武林更有意义。

他提炼家传武学中的运气之法，自成一套医术法门，多年间救人无数。更在“怪面之乱”中散尽家财，聚各方能人，共同破解“杀气改造”之法，也助误入歧途的怪面压制杀戮欲望，找回尊严与本心。

可他没能救下的那个人……他的家人，那些村民们冲进来，叫喊着“庸医”，绑住师父，砍断了……师父的手……那是双救了无数人的手啊……

items.description_en:
My master, Xie Huichun, was the heir to the Xie clan's martial arts, but to him, saving lives and healing the wounded carried far greater meaning than making a name for himself through martial prowess and strength in the Wulin.  

He refined the Chi circulation methods within the Xie clan's martial arts and developed a unique healing art of his own, saving countless lives over the years. During the Maskwalker Crisis, he spent his entire fortune gathering talented people from across the Wulin to find a way to reverse Sha-Chi Transcension. He even helped Maskwalkers who had lost their way suppress their murderous urges, allowing them to regain their dignity and true selves.  

But the one person he couldn't save... That person's family, those villagers... they stormed in, shouting "Quack!" They tied my master up and chopped off... my master's hands...  
Those were the hands that had saved countless lives...

items.name: 【谢园往事】其二
items.raw_name:
诛邪真人真的救了师父吗……师父再也不同了……那些村民，师父没杀他们，而是将他们做成……

他们的悔恨、愤怒、哀求，全成了师父的力量和补给。师父还说：“原来，这种感觉那么好啊。”

是……我们这双手……本该救人……为何救不了这个溃烂的武林……也拦不下几个村民……留着何用？

items.description_en:
Did Zhuxie Zhenren really save my master... He's not the same anymore... He didn't kill those villagers, but instead he made them into...

Their regret, anger, and pleas for mercy all became my master's strength and supply. My master also said, "I never knew this would feel so good."

Yes... our hands... meant to save lives... why couldn't they save this decaying Wulin... nor stop a few villagers... what's the use in keeping them?

items.name: 字迹潦草的信件
items.raw_name:
昔日引狼入室，致苍生涂炭，此乃吾之罪也。

今身中“龙体之术”，苦压胸中嗜血杀意。然残烛风中，鼓声将绝。

闻阁下入局以来，搅动乾坤，如醒狮破雾，步步惊雷。老朽于黑暗中苦撑至今，所候者，或许正是阁下这位真正的“采青人”。

要事相托，持此钥，启吾舞狮馆之门。

items.description_en:
Long ago, I let the wolf into our midst, bringing untold suffering upon the people. That sin is mine to bear.

Now the "Perfect Transcension" courses through me, and I struggle to suppress the bloodlust in my heart. But my flame gutters in the wind, and the drums will soon fall silent.

Since entering this game, you have shaken Heaven and Earth. Like an awakened lion breaking through the mist, each step lands like thunder. I have held on in this darkness until now, waiting perhaps for none other than you, the true one to pluck the green.

I have an important task to entrust to you. Take this key and open the door to my lion dance hall.

items.name: 弟子家书
items.raw_name:
吾儿：

你这逆子，久不来信！

近来昆仑三杰之侠名传遍乡里，赞誉不绝。为父这才明了，原来你追随三杰，是为行此铲除怪面、为民除害之义举！为父心中甚慰。

望你切莫恃功自满。荒行子大侠乃当世宗师，你既有幸得其亲传，更当潜心向学，不负众望，匡扶正义！

<right>父字</>

items.description_en:
Son:

You unfilial child, it has been so long since you last sent word! 

Lately, the heroic deeds of the Three Heroes of Kunlun have spread throughout our hometown, earning endless praise. Only then did I realize that you followed them so you could join their righteous cause of eliminating the Maskwalkers and protecting the people. Your father is greatly relieved.  

I hope you will not become arrogant over your achievements. The great hero Huangxing is a master of this age. Having the fortune to receive his personal instruction, you must devote yourself to learning, live up to everyone's expectations, and uphold justice!  

Your father

items.name: 独眼弓客的留书
items.raw_name:
阿囡：

此去死局，阿爹无悔，唯憾不能见你及笄。

今世道险恶，邪祟多作慈悲相。若有温言许你捷径，诱你与我重逢，万不可信，万不可近！

所谓正道，唯此而已，切记切记。

<right>父 绝笔</>

items.description_en:
My little girl,

I go now to certain death without regret. My only sorrow is that I will never see you come of age.

These are dangerous times, and evil often wears the face of kindness. If anyone offers you an easy path and promises to reunite you with me, never believe them. Never go near them.

This is the only righteous path. Remember this. Remember it well.

Your Father’s Final Words

items.name: 《沾血的日记》
items.raw_name:
那洞窟防守严密，若无增援，只怕难以解救被俘同道……

虽偶得敌人书信，岂料并非机要，而是杀人赎罪之语，字字荒谬可笑……

Wenyao

items.raw_name:

混乱中，开关已流落那疯妇手中。望众弟兄暂候，待我等引荒行子亲卫与之相杀，坐收渔利！

items.description_en:
Huangxing's personal guards came to seize the lift switch, only for the madwoman Kui Yanyan to charge in. This Maskwalker is notorious for setting up pots on the mountain road and boiling people alive. She is utterly deranged.

In the chaos, the switch fell into the madwoman's hands. Brothers, hold your positions for now. We will lure Huangxing's guards into fighting her and reap the benefits once both sides are weakened!

items.name: 封山令
items.raw_name:
查梅谷湖西北断魂山脉，昔年惨变，杀气冲天。

即日起，擅入断魂山者，视同邪道，抄尽资财，江湖共讨！

<right>正道联盟  凌云九座印</>

The Soulrend Mountains, northwest of Meigu Lake, were the site of a great calamity years ago. Sha-Chi still surges skyward from their peaks.

Effective immediately, anyone who trespasses upon the Soulrend Mountains shall be deemed an agent of the unorthodox path. Their property shall be confiscated, and the Wulin shall unite against them.

By order of the Nine Heavenly Thrones of the Mandate

items.name: “四凶斧”案卷
items.description: 信笺、绝笔、札记、手稿……凡与“四凶斧”背后秘辛互有牵连之物，皆可汇于此卷，草蛇灰线，交织互证，连成一份洗雪冤屈的真相。
items.description_en: Letters, final testaments, notes, manuscripts... anything connected to the secrets behind the "Four Axes" can be gathered in this volume. Scattered traces and hidden threads intertwine, each lending credence to the others, until together they reveal the truth and clear the wrongfully accused.

items.name: 《斧老大的绝笔信》
items.raw_name:
狗屁凌云九座！人面兽心明老贼！奸杀女子被我等撞破，更颠倒黑白，血口喷人！

畜生顾凌然，与我等称兄道弟，实为明老贼走狗，残杀我三个弟兄！

……若我彭猛改造得成……必要报仇雪恨！报仇雪恨！报仇雪恨！！！
items.description:

……若我彭猛改造得成……必要报仇雪恨！报仇雪恨！报仇雪恨！！！
items.description_en:
To hell with the Nine Heavenly Thrones! That old bastard Ming is a beast in human skin! We caught him violating and killing a woman, and he twisted the truth and accused us instead!

That animal Gu Lingran called us brothers, but all along he was Old Ming's lapdog! He slaughtered three of my brothers!

...If I, Peng Meng, survive the Transcension... I'll have my revenge! I'll have my revenge! I'LL HAVE MY REVENGE!!!

items.name: 四凶斧之乱·祸乱
items.raw_name:
这些个邪道，还真有几分骨气。斧老四牙拔了八颗，大刑也上了几遍，愣是不肯签字画押。

还有那斧老三，竟是一上公堂就翻了供，亏得我还苦心杜撰了七篇他们如何奸淫掳掠，恶贯满盈……这下全都毁了！我的升迁怕是再也无望了！

items.description_en:
Those heretics have more backbone than I expected. Fourth Axe had eight teeth pulled and was put through torture time and again, yet he still refused to sign a confession.

And Third Axe actually recanted the moment he was brought before the court! I went to all that trouble fabricating seven accounts of how they violated women, abducted people, looted and pillaged, committing every evil imaginable... and now it's all ruined! At this rate, I can forget about ever getting promoted!

items.name: 四凶斧之乱·混乱
items.raw_name:
今个会审斧老二，竟被他道出桩惊天大事！

话说是十一年前，明大掌门欲奸杀女子，被凶斧四人撞破，狼狈脱逃，也从此结怨。后来，凶斧四人结识了顾大侠。一行人前脚还借着酒兴，共话明掌门腌臜，谁知转头便被顾大侠擒获，受尽酷刑。

哈哈！这厮讲得有声有色，当真让人大饱耳福！

items.description_en:
Second Axe was put on trial today, and he revealed quite the shocking scandal!

Eleven years ago, Master Ming tried to violate and kill a woman, only for the Four Axes to catch him in the act. He fled in disgrace, and bad blood has festered between them ever since. Later, the Four Axes became acquainted with Master Gu. One moment they were drinking together, talking about Master Ming's filthy deeds. The next, Master Gu had seized them, and they were subjected to every manner of brutal torture.

He told it all so vividly, haha! What a tale to hear!

items.name: 四凶斧之乱·惑乱
items.raw_name:
探子回报说，斧老大盘踞在人烟稀少处，还以废弃装置进行了粗陋的“杀气改造”，凶悍非常。

难道真如队长所言，这是我等的报应？可这世道本就冤屈者多，纵使他说的是真相，也已救不了命……又拿什么换回公道？

items.description_en:
The scouts report that Axemaster Peng Meng has holed up in a remote area and undergone a crude form of Transcension using abandoned equipment. He's said to be extremely dangerous.

Could the captain really be right? Is this our retribution? But this world has never lacked for people who were wronged. Even if what he said was true, it won't save his life now... And what could possibly make things right?

items.name: 顾凌然上书明大掌门（文稿）
items.raw_name:
谨禀明掌门尊前：

凶斧四人嗜血成性，实乃武林大患！弟子愿传书于四凶斧，谎称因盗取正道秘卷，三日后问斩，恳请来援。届时，可趁其连夜奔袭百里，疲敝不堪，一举擒获！

若此举能成，弟子虽死无憾！伏望掌门裁夺！

items.row_name: 顾凌然上书明大掌门（文稿）
items.description_en:
To the Honorable Sect Leader Ming,

The Four Axes are bloodthirsty by nature and pose a grave threat to the Wulin! I propose sending them a letter claiming that I stole a secret manual of the righteous sects and am to be executed in three days, pleading with them to come to my rescue. Once they have rushed a hundred li through the night and are utterly exhausted, we can seize them in one fell swoop!

If this plan succeeds, I shall have no regrets even if it costs me my life. I respectfully await your decision, Sect Leader.

Lingran, Disciple of the Qingfeng Sect

items.name: 《武队长绝笔信》
items.raw_name:
正道联盟九长老钧鉴：

怪面来袭，本应倾力御敌。怎料上峰顾大侠弃战而走，只为押解斧首彭猛献与明大掌门邀功请赏！

我等仓促转运囚车之际，彭猛趁乱暴起，将我十余弟兄尽数屠戮！为剿怪面，我等在所不惜！然遭此横祸，我等弟兄何以瞑目？恳请诸长老明察秋毫，严惩误事之人！

<right>武超 叩首</>

武超 叩首
items.description_en:
To the Nine Elders of the Mandate,

When the Maskwalkers attacked, we should have devoted ourselves to resisting them with all our strength. Yet, instead, Master Gu abandoned the battle to escort Axemaster Peng Meng to Sect Leader Ming, hoping to claim credit and earn rewards!

While we were hastily transporting the prison cart, Peng Meng broke free in the chaos and slaughtered over a dozen of my brothers! We would spare no sacrifice to eliminate the Maskwalkers. Yet after suffering such a disaster, how can my fallen brothers ever rest in peace? I humbly ask the Nine Elders to investigate this matter with clear judgment and punish those responsible for this grave mistake!

Wu Chao

items.name: 谋士许丰的密信
items.raw_name:
顾大人钧鉴：

今昆仑玉音子下落不明，荒行子与墨玑子亦起嫌隙。其麾下部众，已渐有散沙之势！

属下以为，大人当握此良机，即刻将四凶斧押往明大掌门处。届时，大人劳苦功高，谁人可比？玉音子之权柄，必非大人莫属！

<right>许丰</>

许丰
items.description_en:
To Esteemed Master Gu,

Yuyin of Kunlun is now missing, while discord has arisen between Huangxing and Moji. The forces under their command are already beginning to splinter!

In my humble opinion, you should seize this opportunity and immediately escort the Four Axes to Sect Leader Ming. With such distinguished service to your name, who could possibly rival you? Yuyin's position would surely be yours!

Xu Feng

items.name: 明大掌门的回信
items.raw_name:
顾贤侄：

汝素来行事果决，想来四凶斧一案，汝必能妥善处置，光我正道之威。

莫负厚望。阅后即焚。

<right>日月斋主人</>
items.description:
顾贤侄：

汝素来行事果决，想来四凶斧一案，汝必能妥善处置，光我正道之威。

莫负厚望。阅后即焚。

日月斋主人
items.description_en:
Nephew Gu,

You have always acted with decisiveness. I trust that you will handle the matter of the Four Axes with due care and uphold the dignity of the righteous path.

Do not disappoint my expectations. Burn this letter after reading.

Master of Sun Moon Hall

items.name: 杀气改造之谜
items.description:
随“十一人阁”一同在武林中播撒混乱的，是一种名为“杀气改造”的法门。

能让人战力大增，却也会使人沦为被杀气驱使的行尸走肉。无人可以幸免。
items.description_en:
Alongside the Eleven, a technique known as "Transcension" spread chaos throughout the Wulin.

It can greatly enhance one's combat prowess, but at a terrible cost, reducing its victims to walking corpses driven by Sha-Chi. No one is immune.

items.name: 杀气是什么？
items.raw_name:
杀气乃一切武功之本。

它来源于芸芸众生的恩怨情仇、嬉笑怒骂，从屠夫宰猪到高手对决，只要出手有制敌之心，就必定携带着杀气。

制敌取胜的信念越强，杀气越精纯，招式威力也越大。真正的高手，可以在微妙的平衡间操控杀气，而不会被杀气所掌控，冲昏理智。
items.description:
杀气乃一切武功之本。

它来源于芸芸众生的恩怨情仇、嬉笑怒骂，从屠夫宰猪到高手对决，只要出手有制敌之心，就必定携带着杀气。

制敌取胜的信念越强，杀气越精纯，招式威力也越大。真正的高手，可以在微妙的平衡间操控杀气，而不会被杀气所掌控，冲昏理智。
items.description_en:
Sha-Chi is the foundation of all martial arts.

It is born from the countless bonds and grudges, loves and hatreds, joys and angers of human life. From a butcher slaughtering a pig to masters crossing blades, any strike made with the intent to overcome an opponent will inevitably carry Sha-Chi.

The stronger the resolve to overcome and defeat an opponent, the purer the Sha-Chi and the greater the power of the technique. True masters can control Sha-Chi within a delicate balance, rather than allowing it to control them and cloud their judgment.

items.name: 杀气改造
items.raw_name:
杀气改造，即将杀气生成装置植入人体，辅以一定程度的肢体改造，可使人造杀气源源不断地流淌于使用者的五脏六腑、奇经八脉，充盈之盛，远非寻常武者可比。

使用者武学愈是精深，阅历愈是深厚，与此法门相合而激发的力量便愈是强横。

然而如此得来的杀气，亦会日渐侵蚀其心志，终将使用者化作只知杀戮的机器。
items.description:

items.description_en:
Transcension involves implanting a Sha-Chi generating device into the body, along with a degree of physical modification. This allows artificial Sha-Chi to flow endlessly through the user's organs and meridians, filling the body in quantities far beyond what an ordinary martial artist could achieve.

The greater the user's mastery of martial arts and the deeper their experience, the more power they can draw out through Transcension.

But Sha-Chi gained in this way gradually erodes the user's mind, eventually reducing the user to a mindless killing machine.

items.name: 机关术
items.raw_name:
以燃料能源替代杀气，操控机关齿轮等机械造物的技术，便是“机关术”。

许多机关师凭借精湛的工匠技艺，和充满巧思的机关设计行走江湖，全然不亚于最顶尖的武者。
items.description:
以燃料能源替代杀气，操控机关齿轮等机械造物的技术，便是“机关术”。

许多机关师凭借精湛的工匠技艺，和充满巧思的机关设计行走江湖，全然不亚于最顶尖的武者。
items.description_en:
Engine Art is the practice of using combustible fuel in place of Sha-Chi to power mechanisms, gears, and other mechanical constructs.

Many Engine Art masters travel the Wulin relying on their masterful craftsmanship and ingenious mechanical designs, proving every bit as formidable as the finest martial artists.

items.name: 《浑源石志·龙体改造篇》
items.raw_name:
……
以浑源石制器。杀气波动减缓者，不足二成。

粗研内服，初见成效，杀气波动减缓者，升至五成，有待继续观察。
items.description:
……
以浑源石制器。杀气波动减缓者，不足二成。

粗研内服，初见成效，杀气波动减缓者，升至五成，有待继续观察。
items.description_en:
...
Devices crafted from Primal Stone: fewer than 20% showed reduced Sha-Chi fluctuations.

Preliminary internal consumption trials showed initial results. The proportion showing reduced Sha-Chi fluctuations rose to 50%. Further observation required.

items.name: 杀气炉操作须知事项
items.raw_name:
若炉水灼蚀皮肤，当即刻削尽伤处，勿存侥幸。

杀气蚀肺，久吸必殆。操作时须覆铁面掩口。

身有伤处者，勿近炉畔。

……
items.description:
若炉水灼蚀皮肤，当即刻削尽伤处，勿存侥幸。

杀气蚀肺，久吸必殆。操作时须覆铁面掩口。

身有伤处者，勿近炉畔。

……
items.description_en:
If furnace water burns the skin, cut away all affected flesh immediately. Do not take chances.

Sha-Chi corrodes the lungs. Prolonged exposure is fatal. When operating the furnace, wear an iron mask over the mouth and face.

Anyone with an open wound must keep away from the furnace.

......

items.name: 杀气塔勘探调查
items.raw_name:
……炉火已熄，其内渣土堆积，未见浑源石残存……

今杀气暴动日益频繁……恐怕……唯内服残渣一试……
items.description:
……炉火已熄，其内渣土堆积，未见浑源石残存……

今杀气暴动日益频繁……恐怕……唯内服残渣一试……
items.description_en:
......The furnace has gone cold. Slag and debris have accumulated inside, with no trace of Primal Stone remaining......

Sha-Chi surges are becoming more frequent...... I fear...... our only option may be to eat the remaining residue......

items.name: 心脉经注
items.raw_name:
心者，生之本也。

杀气改造之法，集武学、奇术、机关术之大成者，可引杀气流贯，远胜寻常高手所蓄。

若以精巧杀气装置代人心脏，成气血之源，岂非既可得无穷杀机，亦能延人寿数乎？
items.description:
心者，生之本也。

杀气改造之法，集武学、奇术、机关术之大成者，可引杀气流贯，远胜寻常高手所蓄。

若以精巧杀气装置代人心脏，成气血之源，岂非既可得无穷杀机，亦能延人寿数乎？
items.description_en:
The heart is the root of life.

Transcension is a masterful combination of Martial, Esoteric, and Engine Arts. The Sha-Chi can be guided through the organs and meridians, far exceeding the amount of Sha-Chi an average master can maintain.  

However, if the heart itself were replaced with an exquisite Sha-Chi device, if such a device could be the source of Qi and blood, would that not mean it could both produce an infinite supply of Sha-Chi, and also extend a person's lifespan?

items.name: 医者的手记残页
items.raw_name:
白山派雯师姐素性温和，然进行龙体之术后，她竟性情大变，时有暴戾之气。

余翻阅谢氏门人旧卷，得一法门：自断双臂，以己身为器，可吸纳他人杀气。此法虽是凶险，然若抽尽毒性杀气，使大营弟子还诸本性，我辈在所不惜。

……确能抽取杀气……今渐觉男子之力苦涩难耐，唯女弟子之气清香甘甜。

……今日行医，竟将一女弟子之杀气抽尽，形如风干之木……哈哈！畅快，畅快！

……今日行医，竟将一女弟子之杀气抽尽，形如风干之木……哈哈！畅快，畅快！
items.description_en:
Baishan Sister Wen has always been a gentle soul, but she's completely different since undergoing Perfect Transcension. Now she's prone to violent outbursts.

I searched through old records left by disciples of the Xie Clan and found a method: sever both arms and use one's own body as a vessel to absorb the Sha-Chi of others. The method is extremely dangerous, but if we can drain away the toxic Sha-Chi and return the disciples at the encampment to their true selves, no sacrifice is too great.

...It really can extract Sha-Chi... I'm gradually finding the Sha-Chi of men unbearably bitter, while that of the female disciples is fragrant and sweet.

...While treating a female disciple today, I ended up draining all of her Sha-Chi. She looked like a piece of dried wood... Hahaha! Exhilarating! Absolutely exhilarating!

items.name: 新娘阿花
items.description:
约定的人没有来。来的是他的死讯，和一个痴傻的新郎。

哄睡那痴人，再摸出嫁妆箱底的刀……她听说过，有一个法子，能让死人还魂。
items.description_en:
The one she was waiting for never came. Instead came news of his death, and a simple-minded groom.

She lulled the fool to sleep, then reached for the knife hidden beneath her dowry chest... She had heard of a way to bring the dead back.

items.name: 媒婆的信
items.raw_name:
如今李员外膝下仅此一子，二十有三，天性纯良，体魄健壮，食量亦非常人可比，当真是千里挑一的佳婿！

万望宋公多加考虑，莫使令嫒错失此等良缘！

<right>媒人王氏</>
items.description:
如今李员外膝下仅此一子，二十有三，天性纯良，体魄健壮，食量亦非常人可比，当真是千里挑一的佳婿！

万望宋公多加考虑，莫使令嫒错失此等良缘！

媒人王氏
items.description_en:
Master Li has only one son, now twenty-three years old. He is good-natured, strong and healthy, and blessed with an astonishing appetite few could compare. Truly, an ideal son-in-law one could search a thousand miles and never find the equal of!

I sincerely hope you will give the matter careful thought, Master Song, lest your daughter miss such an excellent match.

Mrs. Wang, Matchmaker

items.name: 阿花父亲回信
items.raw_name:
承蒙夫人牵线搭桥！

小女得配高门，实乃祖宗积德，三生有幸！

至于小女与邻家之子交好一说，不过邻里闲话，夫人切莫挂怀！敝人亦当严加教诲，使小女更明事理，成此秦晋之好！

<right>宋孚 敬上</>
items.description:
承蒙夫人牵线搭桥！

小女得配高门，实乃祖宗积德，三生有幸！

至于小女与邻家之子交好一说，不过邻里闲话，夫人切莫挂怀！敝人亦当严加教诲，使小女更明事理，成此秦晋之好！

宋孚 敬上
items.description_en:
My eternal gratitude to you for the effort you've made to make introductions and ensure this arrangement.

For my daughter to marry into such distinguished holdings is surely the culmination of my ancestors' good deeds, and the fortune of three lifetimes!

As for the rumors that my daughter has been friends with my neighbor's son, it is nothing but neighborhood gossip, so please do not worry about it, Madam! I will be sure to strictly instruct her to be more sensible, to ensure this match is consummated!

Respectfully,
Song Fu

items.name: 阿辉的书信
items.raw_name:
李家那个大傻子，你可千万不能嫁！

我没李家有钱，但我有膀子力气！你值当地上最美的花，天上最亮的月，我都要寻来给你！

明晚半夜，村头溪边，我等你！咱们远走高飞！

<right>辉</>
items.description:
李家那个大傻子，你可千万不能嫁！

我没李家有钱，但我有膀子力气！你值当地上最美的花，天上最亮的月，我都要寻来给你！

明晚半夜，村头溪边，我等你！咱们远走高飞！

辉
items.description_en:
You absolutely can't marry that fool from the Li family!

I may not have their money, but I've got strength in my arms! You deserve the most beautiful flower on earth and the brightest moon in the sky, and I'll find them both for you!

Tomorrow at midnight, by the stream outside the village. I'll be waiting. Let's run away together!

Hui

items.name: 石蒜花谷
items.raw_name:
昨日隔壁村办喜事，不料红事变白事，新娘子给新郎开了膛，还趁乱逃之夭夭，不知去向！

听说那新娘姿色绝伦，若真能逮住，定要瞧瞧是何等人物！有胆量的，<LetterBold>石蒜花谷</>，咱们一同会会那美娇娘！
items.description: ，咱们一同会会那美娇娘！
items.description_en: . Let's go meet this lovely bride ourselves!

items.name: 浓烟滚滚的高塔下
items.raw_name:
相公啊，我一直在那<LetterBold>浓烟滚滚的高塔下</>等你……

犹记那日赏月，你指月为誓，说：“蔷薇荼荼，明月皎皎，亦可照你我二人，情意绵长，此心不渝。”

相公啊，你的誓言可还作数？

<right>阿花</>
items.description:
等你……

犹记那日赏月，你指月为誓，说：“蔷薇荼荼，明月皎皎，亦可照你我二人，情意绵长，此心不渝。”

相公啊，你的誓言可还作数？

阿花
items.description_en:
I remember the night we watched the moon together. You pointed at it and made your vow to me. You said, "The blooming flowers and this shining moon, they are witnesses to our everlasting love."

Dearest husband, does your vow still hold?

Hua

items.name: 浓烟滚滚的高塔下
items.raw_name:
相公啊，我一直在那<LetterBold>浓烟滚滚的高塔下</>等你……

犹记那日，你用草杆编花，别在我发上。你还说，有朝一日，定要为我画眉梳妆。

相公啊，你的誓言可还作数？

<right>阿花</>
items.description:
等你……

犹记那日，你用草杆编花，别在我发上。你还说，有朝一日，定要为我画眉梳妆。

相公啊，你的誓言可还作数？

阿花
items.description_en:
I remember the day you wove me flowers out of grass, and tucked them into my hair. There in that meadow, you made your vow to me. You said, "One day I'll be painting your brows for our wedding."

Dearest husband, does your vow still hold?

Hua

items.name: 浓烟滚滚的高塔下
items.raw_name:
相公啊，我一直在那<LetterBold>浓烟滚滚的高塔下</>等你……

犹记那日，我寻到你时，你正醉倒在一片红色的花丛中，像一张摊开的面皮。可你嘴里还在咕哝说，定会为我办一场最风光的喜宴。

相公啊，你何时来兑现你的誓言？

<right>阿花</>
items.description:
等你……

犹记那日，我寻到你时，你正醉倒在一片红色的花丛中，像一张摊开的面皮。可你嘴里还在咕哝说，定会为我办一场最风光的喜宴。

相公啊，你何时来兑现你的誓言？

阿花
items.description_en:
I remember when I found you. You were drunk and lying flat in a bed of crimson flowers, like a cat basking in the sun. But you whispered your vow to me. You said, "Our wedding banquet will earn the envy of even the richest families in the province."

Dearest husband, does your vow still hold?

Hua

items.name: 昆仑三杰
items.description: 时至今日，武林中依旧流传着“昆仑三杰”的赫赫威名。仿佛说得越多，传得越广，便越能守住昔日的荣光，便越能支撑住这摇摇欲坠的正道。
items.description_en: Even now, the name of the Pillars of Kunlun still carries great renown throughout the Wulin. As though the more often their deeds are told, and the farther their legend spreads, the longer the glory of those bygone days might endure, and the longer this crumbling Mandate might hold together.

items.name: 昆仑三杰是谁？
items.raw_name:
昆仑派大师姐玉音子，二师兄荒行子，三师弟墨玑子，三人并称昆仑三杰。

三人武功修为不相上下，性情则各有不同。玉音子性情刚烈，荒行子沉默寡言，墨玑子则为人温润随和。江湖中人对玉音子心怀崇敬，对荒行子多有畏惧，而对墨玑子则甚是拥护爱戴。

昔日，昆仑三杰乃正道联盟在烨城一带的中流砥柱，声威赫赫。“怪面之乱”爆发后，正道联盟特意将三人遣调至此，肩负起团结附近弱小门派，共剿怪面残余，守护武林安宁之重任。
items.description:
昆仑派大师姐玉音子，二师兄荒行子，三师弟墨玑子，三人并称昆仑三杰。

三人武功修为不相上下，性情则各有不同。玉音子性情刚烈，荒行子沉默寡言，墨玑子则为人温润随和。江湖中人对玉音子心怀崇敬，对荒行子多有畏惧，而对墨玑子则甚是拥护爱戴。

昔日，昆仑三杰乃正道联盟在烨城一带的中流砥柱，声威赫赫。“怪面之乱”爆发后，正道联盟特意将三人遣调至此，肩负起团结附近弱小门派，共剿怪面残余，守护武林安宁之重任。
items.description_en:
Senior Sister Yuyin, Second Brother Huangxing, and Junior Brother Moji of the Kunlun Sect are known together as the Three Pillars of Kunlun.

The three are evenly matched in martial prowess, but each has a distinct temperament. Yuyin is fierce and strong-willed, Huangxing is quiet and reserved, while Moji is gentle and easygoing. Those in the Wulin regard Yuyin with reverence, Huangxing with fear, and Moji with great affection and support.

The Three Pillars of Kunlun were once a mainstay of the Mandate in the Ye Town region and enjoyed great renown. After the Maskwalker uprising broke out, the Mandate specifically dispatched the three here to rally the weaker sects nearby, join forces with them to eliminate the remaining Maskwalkers, and safeguard the peace of the Wulin.

items.name: 弟子们对三杰的评价
items.raw_name:
玉音子大人武功卓绝，品性高洁，更怀慈柔之心，常收孤女入门下，不求武学精进，只为予一隅安宁。

荒行子大人寡言重行，曾孤身直入怪面据点，数日方归，竟携数颗强敌头颅。

墨玑子大人书剑双绝，君子风度，尤善调停纷争。纵江湖恩怨盘根错节，亦能化干戈为玉帛。

items.description_en:
Master Yuyin is renowned for both her exceptional martial prowess and her noble character. She also possesses a gentle and compassionate heart, and often takes orphaned girls into her care, not to push them toward martial mastery, but simply to give them a place of peace and safety.

Master Huangxing is a man of few words and decisive action. He once entered a Maskwalker stronghold alone and did not return for several days. When he finally did, he brought back the heads of several formidable foes.

Master Moji is equally accomplished with the pen and the sword, a true gentleman with a gift for resolving disputes. No matter how tangled the grudges of the martial world become, he always finds a way of turning hostility into reconciliation.

items.name: 联剿策论
items.raw_name:
今陆家村已为“怪面”所据，然村中尚有百姓藏身于地窖、废屋。怪面狂悖，若贸然于村中交战，恐致无辜罹难。

故宜于西南树林设伏，诱敌出村，引入林中。待其兵力分散，再各个击破，方为上策。

items.description_en:
The Village of Lu has now been occupied by Maskwalkers, though some villagers are still hiding in cellars and abandoned houses. The Maskwalkers are violent and unpredictable. If we engage them inside the village, innocent lives may be lost.

The best course is to set an ambush in the woods to the southwest and lure the enemy out of the village. Once their forces are drawn into the forest and spread thin, we can defeat them one by one.

items.name: 正道联盟委任状
items.raw_name:
诸江湖同道敬鉴：

怪面肆虐东部，涂炭生灵，其罪罄竹难书，剿灭之事刻不容缓！

兹正道联盟特此委任： 昆仑派玉音子为东武林总指挥，即日起统领各派精英豪杰，全权负责清剿怪面事宜。

望玉音子当仁不让，领众英荡涤邪道，早复江湖太平！

<right>特此文告       </>
<right>正道联盟  凌云九座（印）</>

items.description_en:
To all fellow of the Wulin:

The Maskwalkers have ravaged the eastern lands, bringing suffering to countless lives. Their crimes are beyond measure, and their eradication cannot be delayed. 

The Mandate hereby appoints Yuyin of the Kunlun Sect as Commander-in-Chief of the Eastern Wulin. From this day forth, she shall command the elite heroes of all sects and hold full authority over all matters concerning the eradication of the Maskwalkers. 

May Yuyin rise to this duty, lead the gathered heroes in cleansing the path of evil, and restore peace to the Wulin once more.  

Issued hereby
The Mandate, Lingyun Nine Seats (Seal)

items.name: 正道大营工事图
items.raw_name:
（森严周密的正道大营布防规划图。

营前防御工事夹道而设，踞山成关；正门一双箭塔巍然耸立，俯瞰战场。刀盾壁垒、陷阱关隘，遍及大营内外，尽显一片肃杀。）

items.description_en:
[This appears to be a diagram detailing the Mandate Encampment's meticulously planned defenses.  

Defensive fortifications are arranged along both sides of the road before the encampment, turning the mountain into a fortified gateway. Two arrow towers rise above the main gate, overlooking the battlefield. Blade-and-shield barricades, traps, and fortified checkpoints cover the encampment and its surroundings, creating a formidable defensive position.]

items.name: 六宗门书
items.raw_name:
当今怪面肆虐，武林危如累卵，我六派素为中流砥柱，理当摒弃门户之见，以技艺互补、以气节相扶。

如是聚众派之合力，凝正道之侠情，则邪道必寸隙难乘，江湖定再复清明！

<right>昆仑三杰  共书</>

items.description_en:
With the Maskwalkers running rampant and the Wulin hanging by a thread, we six sects, long its mainstay, must set aside our sectarian differences, complement one another’s skills, and stand together in honor.

If we unite the strength of our sects and the chivalrous spirit of the righteous path, the forces of evil will find no opening to exploit, and peace shall surely return to the Wulin!

Jointly written by the Three Pillars of Kunlun

items.name: 琴谱札记
items.raw_name: 偶得先人残谱，慢板幽咽如泣。而江湖逍遥自在，慢曲难追豪情，不如将旧谱重编，增其节拍，添其跌宕，不为精奇，只求快意。
items.description: 偶得先人残谱，慢板幽咽如泣。而江湖逍遥自在，慢曲难追豪情，不如将旧谱重编，增其节拍，添其跌宕，不为精奇，只求快意。
items.description_en: I happened upon an incomplete score left by those who came before. Its slow passages are plaintive, almost like weeping. Yet the Wulin is free and unrestrained, and such a slow tune can hardly capture its bold spirit. Better to rearrange the old score, quicken the rhythm, and give it more rise and fall. I seek neither refinement nor novelty, only the thrill of it.

items.name: 女弟子文书
items.raw_name:
敬禀吾师：

弟子等已于大营内外妥善布防，请师父勿要为后方诸事分心挂虑。

惟愿此番与“组织”协战，师父旗开得胜，荡涤妖邪，早日凯旋！

<right>众弟子  敬上</>
items.description:
敬禀吾师：

弟子等已于大营内外妥善布防，请师父勿要为后方诸事分心挂虑。

众弟子  敬上
items.description_en:
To our Esteemed Master,

We have laid out defenses in and around the main camp. Please, Master, do not be distracted or worry about matters in the rear.

We only wish that in this joint campaign with the Order, Master will win victory from the very start, clear away the evil, and return in triumph to us soon!

Respectfully,
Your Disciples

items.name: 抗敌檄文
items.raw_name:
吾等三人，蒙师门栽培，受正道厚望，更感念此番众门派勠力同心，诸江湖侠客千里驰援，万千百姓奋起抗暴，今特于此立誓：

吾等必倾尽所能，以正克邪。怪面不灭，誓不罢休！愿诸君共瞩，天地共鉴！

<right>玉音子 荒行子 墨玑子 共书</>

items.description_en:
The three of us owe everything to our sect's teachings and the hopes placed in us by the righteous path. We are equally moved by the united efforts of the many sects, the heroes who have traveled a thousand miles to aid us, and the countless common people who have risen against tyranny. We hereby swear:

We will exhaust every ounce of our strength to overcome evil with righteousness. Until the Maskwalkers are destroyed, we will not rest! Let all present bear witness, and let Heaven and Earth attest to our oath!

Written jointly by Yuyin, Huangxing, and Moji

items.name: 墨玑子的弟子们
items.description:
他们中，有人感念救命之恩，结草衔环；有人蒙受教化，迷途知返；有人慕名求学，终得真传；也有人悟其大道，看淡执念。

如今，或许力微，或许已晚，但他们仍愿报师恩，扶正道，倾尽此身。
items.description_en:
Among them, some owe their lives to his kindness and have never forgotten the debt. Some were guided back from the wrong path. Some came seeking instruction and ultimately inherited his true teachings. Others came to understand his greater ideals and learned to let go of their own obsessions.

Now, perhaps their strength is limited, and perhaps the hour is already late. Even so, they are still willing to repay their master's kindness, uphold the righteous path, and give everything they have.

items.name: 给倩倩的密信
items.raw_name:
倩倩师妹：

见信速离！墨大人必会安然归来，万望师妹多加珍重，切莫一时意气用事，以身犯险！一切保重！

<right>赵 魏 诸葛 联笔</>
items.description:

见信速离！墨大人必会安然归来，万望师妹多加珍重，切莫一时意气用事，以身犯险！一切保重！

赵 魏 诸葛 联笔
items.description_en:
To Junior Sister Qianqian,

Leave as soon as you get this letter! Master Moji will come back safely. Take care of yourself, and don't do anything reckless. Don't put yourself in any danger! Stay alive above all else!

- Zhao, Wei, and Zhuge

items.name: 武学答疑
items.raw_name:
恩师安启：

前日见师父以茶枝演练，叶落三寸未沾青衫，令弟子醍醐灌顶，惊觉自己误以蛮力催劲，故难得要领。

无奈今日又遇到一处疑难，恳请师父于闲暇之时，再为弟子点拨一二。

<right>弟子 严华 敬上</>

弟子 严华 敬上
items.description_en:
Master,

A few days ago, I saw you practicing with a tea branch. The leaves fell within inches of you, yet not one touched your robes. In that moment, I realized I had been relying on brute force to drive my power, and thus had failed to grasp the true principles.  

Yet today I have encountered another difficulty. I humbly ask that, when you have time, you offer me your guidance once more.  

Respectfully,
Disciple Yan Hua

items.name: 满月请帖
items.raw_name:
恩师敬启：

恩师近来可好？弟子犹记，恩师昔日曾慷慨许诺，约定若弟子得子，定来亲赐嘉名！

今犬子满月之期将至，已备薄酒诗茶，只待恩师光临寒舍！

<right>弟子怀舟 携稚子敬邀</>
items.description:

恩师近来可好？弟子犹记，恩师昔日曾慷慨许诺，约定若弟子得子，定来亲赐嘉名！

今犬子满月之期将至，已备薄酒诗茶，只待恩师光临寒舍！

弟子怀舟 携稚子敬邀
items.description_en:
To my Esteemed Master,

How have you been?

I still remember when you generously promised in the past, agreeing that if I ever had a son, you would definitely come to personally bestow a fine name!

My son's first celebration is approaching. I have prepared simple wine, poetry, and tea, and await your gracious arrival at my humble home!

Respectfully,
Huaizhou and Family

items.name: 诗歌切磋函
items.raw_name:
墨大人敬启：

承蒙墨大人赐阅诗集，弟子读至《南麓观云》一篇中“雪映松岚，剑挑松涛”一句，揣摩三日，终得“月照剑眉迎雪立，松鸣琴胆望云生”之句。今呈拙作《鹤鸣十三札》，恳请墨大人品鉴一二。

<right>邵寒潭 谨上</>
items.description:
墨大人敬启：

承蒙墨大人赐阅诗集，弟子读至《南麓观云》一篇中“雪映松岚，剑挑松涛”一句，揣摩三日，终得“月照剑眉迎雪立，松鸣琴胆望云生”之句。今呈拙作《鹤鸣十三札》，恳请墨大人品鉴一二。

邵寒潭 谨上
items.description_en:
Master Moji,

I am grateful for your kindness in allowing me to read your collection of poems. While reading your piece "Viewing Clouds from the Southern Foothills," I came across the line, "Snow reflects the pine mist, while the sword stirs the pine waves." I pondered over it for three days, and finally composed the line, "Moonlight graces sword-brows standing against the snow, while pines sing as the qin heart gazes toward rising clouds."  

I now present my humble work, "Thirteen Notes of the Crane's Song," and humbly ask that you offer your thoughts.

Sincerely, 
Shao Hantan

items.description_en:
When one wields the sword, they do so to end conflict. The sword is a reflection of the Self. To practice martial arts is to face the unknowns of the Self. To face these unknowns, the path of the martial artist begins with strengthening spirit before skill.

Arrogance, indulgence, impatience- these are the martial artist's greatest enemies. To conquer the Self, the martial artist must first cultivate the mind. Only then-

[The writing ends abruptly, forever incomplete.]

items.name: 爱管闲事弟子的遗书
items.raw_name:
玉音子大人在那场与“组织”的联合行动中失踪，荒行子和墨大人共同统率大营，可我发现，荒行子在暗中会晤一个被称为“公子”的人。

他们交往密切，似已达成了什么协议，而墨大人坚决反对。

我虽愚钝，不知那“公子”究竟是何方神圣，荒行子所图为何，但墨大人的忧虑与坚决，自是有目共睹。

……本想探查荒行子与那“公子”的会晤，但他那亲信
（纸上的字句骤然中断，只留下一片殷红的血渍。）

items.description_en:
Master Yuyin has been missing since our joint mission with the Order, and Masters Huangxing and Moji are now leading the camp together. But I learned that Huangxing is meeting with someone called "Master Bai" in secret.

They meet pretty often, and from the sound of it, have come to some kind of agreement... an agreement Master Moji refuses to accept.

I'm not that smart, and I don't know who this "Young Master" is or why Huangxing is working with them, but even I can see that Master Moji is struggling with something.

I was planning to eavesdrop on one of Huangxing's meetings with this Young Master, but that henchman of his-

[The writing cuts off mid-sentence. A splash of blood stains the bottom of the page.]

items.name: 赵笛的来信
items.raw_name:
孟兄：

自墨大人骤然失踪，大营内上下震动，都道是荒行子暗下死手。

无奈我等连日搜寻，遗骸证物一无所获。

恳请孟兄即刻率众驰援，共商对策，彻查真相！

<right>赵笛</>
items.description:
孟兄：

自墨大人骤然失踪，大营内上下震动，都道是荒行子暗下死手。

无奈我等连日搜寻，遗骸证物一无所获。

恳请孟兄即刻率众驰援，共商对策，彻查真相！

赵笛
items.description_en:
Brother Meng,

Everyone at base camp is shaken by Master Moji's sudden disappearance. We can only suspect Huangxing has secretly killed his brother, but after days of searching, we've found neither evidence nor Moji's body.

Brother, I beg you, we need outside assistance. Please bring a group of trustworthy souls, and let us discover the truth together!

Zhao Di

items.name: 赵笛三人的抵抗檄文
items.raw_name:
荒行子，托名三杰之一，实为正道叛徒！

借“龙体之术”，行杀气改造邪法，蛊惑同道，其心可诛！

凡敢于反对者，其皆反诬为贼，赶尽杀绝，不择手段！更罔顾道义戕害同门师弟，吾等恩师墨玑子大人！此仇不共戴天！

<right>赵笛 诸葛锋 魏三船 泣血</>

荒行子，托名三杰之一，实为正道叛徒！

借“龙体之术”，行杀气改造邪法，蛊惑同道，其心可诛！

凡敢于反对者，其皆反诬为贼，赶尽杀绝，不择手段！更罔顾道义戕害同门师弟，吾等恩师墨玑子大人！此仇不共戴天！

赵笛 诸葛锋 魏三船 泣血
items.description_en:
Huangxing claims the title of a Pillar of Kunlun, yet he is a traitor to the Mandate!

Under the guise of "Perfect Transcension," he practices the vile art of Transcension and deceives his fellow Wulin brethren. His wicked intentions deserve death!

Anyone who dares oppose him is falsely branded a traitor, then hunted down without mercy! Worse still, he has cast aside all honor and murdered his own junior fellow disciple, our revered master, Moji! This is a blood debt we can never forgive!

Written in tears of blood,
Zhao Di, Zhuge Feng, and Wei Sanchuan

items.name: 荒行子的背叛
items.description: 叛名之下，究竟是何居心？铁腕背后，正道又何以立身？
items.description_en: What truly lies behind the charge of treason? And beneath an iron fist, what does the Mandate have left to stand on?

items.name: 荒行子手谕
items.raw_name:
诸位同道：

玉音子掌门不幸战殁，英魂千古。墨玑子怯战潜逃，背弃联盟，实乃昆仑之耻，武林之辱。

长刃为誓，江湖共鉴！今吾已寻得“龙体之术”，吾荒行子必亲率大营弟子荡尽邪道，不灭不休！

<right>荒行子（印）</>

荒行子（印）
items.description_en:
To my fellow martial brethren,

Yuyin has tragically fallen in battle. May her heroic spirit endure through the ages. Moji fled the fighting out of cowardice and betrayed the alliance, humiliating Kunlun and bringing disgrace upon Wulin.

By my blade I swear, with the entire Wulin as witness! I have now found the art of Perfect Transcension. I, Huangxing, will personally lead the disciples at the encampment to wipe out the heretical forces. I will not rest until they are utterly destroyed!

Huangxing (seal)

items.name: 公子来信
items.raw_name:
荒行子阁下：

闻先生近日所困，吾已有良策可解。

不日当亲往贵处，详陈方略，共商大计，匡扶正义。

<right>公子  敬上</>
items.description:
荒行子阁下：

闻先生近日所困，吾已有良策可解。

不日当亲往贵处，详陈方略，共商大计，匡扶正义。

公子  敬上
items.description_en:
Master Huangxing,

I have heard of your recent struggles against the Maskwalkers, and have a solution I would like to offer you in person.

I shall be arriving in a few days to explain my plan, and to discuss our grander ambitions to restore justice.

Faithfully,
Master Bai

items.raw_name:

此法极尽巧思，不单以机巧植于人身，更辅之以……

The art of Perfect Transcension evolved from Transcension. The two share the same underlying principles, but their effects differ greatly. Perfect Transcension focuses on enhancing strength while preserving clarity of mind.

This method is remarkably ingenious, not only implanting intricate mechanisms into the human body, but also supplementing them with...

[The rest of the text has been deliberately destroyed.]

items.name: “龙体之术”执行令
items.raw_name:
诸位同道：

凡我正道弟子，皆须至校场施行龙体之术。

此法增益力量，百利无弊，正道安危皆系于此，为剿怪面势在必行！

抗命不从者，斩立决！枭首示众，以儆效尤！

<right>荒行子（印）</>

items.description_en:
To all Mandate disciples,

Report to the training grounds immediately to undergo Perfect Transcension.

The Perfect Transcension is perfectly safe, and has proven to grant its hosts with untold strength. Winning our war against the Maskwalkers is our top priority! 

Any who refuse the Perfect Transcension will be branded as traitors and beheaded. Let these dissidents serve as an example to any who would abandon their duty!

[Signed with Huangxing's personal seal.]

By Master Huangxing's order: all Powderkegs are to be reassigned to the Prison Cave immediately! If another accidental blast causes trouble, the entire unit will share the punishment!

The mountain gate key is also to be transferred to the captain of the cave guard!

items.name: 墨玑子绝笔
items.description:
临行前夜，墨玑子将旧日笔录逐页整理，合撰成册。记述一年前与“组织”联手行动的来龙去脉，以及后来接踵而来的诸多变故。

字里行间，他未曾着墨太多己见，所有是非功过，皆留待翻阅之人评说。
items.description_en:
On the night before his departure, Moji carefully sorted through his old notes page by page and compiled them into a volume. Within, he recorded the full account of his collaboration with the Order one year prior, as well as the many events that unfolded in its aftermath.

Between the lines, he offered little of his own judgment. All rights and wrongs, merits and faults, he left for those who read it to decide.

items.name: 【墨玑子绝笔信】其一
items.raw_name:
今怪面之属，何其猖獗。我等麾下亦不乏弟子，或甘堕邪法，或受杀气所惑，改造己身，倒戈相向，实乃莫大之哀。再观正道联盟，援军迟迟未至、音讯杳然，此中缘由，我至今不得其解。

所幸兄长结识了“组织”中人，使我等与之议定了联合对敌之策。据闻，此番偕行的三位俊杰，皆各怀绝技，身手不凡。能得此等豪杰鼎力襄助，无异雪中送炭。

items.description_en:
The Maskwalkers have grown utterly rampant. Among our own disciples, some have willingly fallen into forbidden arts, while others have been tempted by Sha-Chi, transforming themselves and turning against us. It is a sorrow beyond measure. Looking to the Mandate, their reinforcements have yet to arrive, and no word has come from them. Even now, I cannot understand the reason behind this.  

Fortunately, my elder brother has made contact with those of the "Order," allowing us to reach an agreement on a plan to join forces against our enemies. I have heard that the three outstanding individuals accompanying them each possess unique skills and extraordinary abilities. To receive the aid of such heroes is nothing short of a timely rescue.

items.name: 【墨玑子绝笔信】其二
items.raw_name:
是兄长带回了弦者的消息。她竟与白赤练……同归于尽了。

师姐亦匆促离开，未明去向，只交托左殇代她转达我等……此事突然，但师姐行事素有分寸，想来自有缘由……待此间事了，再向她问明便是……

items.description_en:
It was my brother who returned with news regarding The Chord. It's hard to believe she and Bai Chilian...perished together.

Sister Yuyin also left in a hurry, her destination unknown. She asked Zuo Shang to pass on her message to us...

It's all so sudden...but Yuyin has always been of a rational mind, so she must have her reasons. Once the matters here are settled, I'll ask her to clarify it then...

items.name: 【墨玑子绝笔信】其三
items.raw_name:
左殇虽言，那日行动后师姐神色如常，只道有事先行……但一连数日音信全无，追寻无果……

师姐……到底遭遇了何事？
items.description:
左殇虽言，那日行动后师姐神色如常，只道有事先行……但一连数日音信全无，追寻无果……

师姐……到底遭遇了何事？
items.description_en:
Zuo Shang said that Senior Sister appeared as usual after that day's operation, only saying she had something to attend to and would leave ahead of us... But several days have passed with no word from her, and our search has led nowhere...  

Senior Sister... what exactly happened to her?

items.name: 【墨玑子绝笔信】其四
items.raw_name:
师姐在时，我三人如鼎足而立，相互砥砺，今一足已缺，我与兄长间，便不免摇摇欲坠，渐生嫌隙……

昨日，他会晤了一名唤作“公子”的神秘人物，二人往来诡秘，似有所谋。而今日，荒行子便密令亲信者，进行那所谓的“龙体改造”之术！

什么此术可保神志清明，什么唯有此道，方可对抗怪面之祸……践行正道，岂可以恶制恶？若我辈亦行杀气改造之术，又与怪面何异！

items.description_en:
When Yuyin was here, the three of us stood as equals, supporting each other's leadership and growing together. With her gone, Huangxing and I have grown apart, and the balance between us is crumbling.

I saw my Brother meet with a mysterious "Master Bai" the other day. It seems like the two of them have been communicating in secret, no doubt to orchestrate some grand scheme. Today I learned that Huangxing ordered his personal guard to undergo that so-called Perfect Transcension!

They claim it prevents the Sha-Chi from taking over the mind. That it's the only way to win against the Maskwalkers... But if one desires justice, then how can they use evil to fight evil? If we undergo Transcension, then what separates us from the Maskwalkers?

items.name: 【墨玑子绝笔信】其五
items.raw_name:
今我二人势同水火，再无转圜余地。兄长一向行事果决，加之进行了那“龙体改造”，是否已几欲将我除之后快？无论如何，我已有决一死战之心。只要能制止那“龙体改造”的推行，弥合今大营中的分裂之势。

倘我不幸败于其手，他必定会动身前往北脉顶峰的圣母娘娘庙，会晤那位神秘的“公子”……若至斯境，万望后世有缘之人，详查其间隐曲，还武林清平安宁。

<right>昆仑  墨玑子</>

昆仑  墨玑子
items.description_en:
The bridge between Huangxing and I has burned to ashes. I'm afraid there's no hope of reconciliation. He's always been a decisive man. I wonder, now that he's undergone Perfect Transcension, has he already decided to kill me? Regardless, I am prepared for the worst. Perfect Transcension must not be allowed to continue. I will gladly risk my life reuniting the camp.

If I die by Huangxing's hand, his next course of action would be to leave for the Lady's shrine at the summit of the northern mountain to meet with Master Bai. 

If it comes to pass, I hope the heroes who come after learn the truth of what transpired here, and restore peace to the Wulin.

Moji, the Pillar of Kunlun

小张要取回的，皆是有来历的物件。

金银或许早已称不出它们的分量，但它们装着的往事，总该有人替它们讲完。

Everything Quick Hand Zhang seeks to recover comes with a story of its own.

Gold and silver may no longer be enough to measure their worth, but the memories they carry still deserve to be told to the very end.

Shadow Sovereign Zuo will be passing along the Main Road within the day.

Seal off all key routes along the way immediately. All unauthorized persons are to be driven at least one hundred zhang away.

Anyone who disobeys is to be killed on sight.

items.name: 联合讨贼盟誓
items.raw_name:
怪面猖獗，武林倾颓，吾等“组织”三人，誓与昆仑三杰勠力同心，共伐凶顽。

盟中诸事，休戚与共；战则并肩，危则相援。

怪面不灭，盟约不散；此誓昭昭，天地共鉴！

<right>左殇（印）玉音子（印）</>

怪面不灭，盟约不散；此誓昭昭，天地共鉴！

左殇（印）玉音子（印）
items.description_en:
With the Maskwalkers running rampant and the Wulin in decline, we three of the Order hereby swear to stand as one with the Pillars of Kunlun and join them in striking down our common enemy.

In all matters of this alliance, we shall share fortune and hardship alike. In battle, we stand shoulder to shoulder; in danger, we come to one another's aid.

Until the Maskwalkers are destroyed, this alliance shall endure. Let this oath stand clear, with Heaven and Earth as witness!

Zuo Shang (seal)
Yuyin (seal)

items.name: 一首未署名的诗
items.raw_name:
<center>青蛇蟠古屋，</>

<center>残体藏何处？</>

<center>像后玄门启，</>

<center>通幽戏梦庄。</>
items.description:
青蛇蟠古屋，

残体藏何处？

像后玄门启，

通幽戏梦庄。
items.description_en:
The Green Serpent coils through the ancient house,

Where lies the hidden remnant?

Behind the statue, a secret gate opens,

Leading deep into the Mirage Estate.

items.name: 一封未署名的信
items.raw_name:
“组织”永远留有后手，可能是一个密道，也可能是一颗暗棋。 

蛇牙、蛇信、蛇眼三物，还是只能留给你啊。

items.description_en:
The Order always keeps something in reserve, whether it’s a secret passage or a hidden piece on the board.

The Serpent’s Fang, Tongue, and Eye... I suppose I can only leave the three to you.

items.name: 囚命
items.description: 那个销声匿迹已久的关外奇术门派，今携“移魂之术”，再掀江湖风云。
items.description_en: That long-vanished sect from beyond the pass has returned, bringing the "Soul Displacement Art" with it and stirring the Wulin into turmoil once more.

items.name: 移魂人偶
items.raw_name:
“囚命”一派，可以“移魂之法”抽取活人的部分意识，附着于人偶之上，使人偶不仅可以不依凭丝线，便活灵活现、行动自如，且完全依照主人的命令行事，百依百顺、唯命是从。

而对被“移魂”者而言，一旦意识进入人偶，就不能再移回肉身，肉身虽未死，但已是行尸走肉。

人偶若毁坏，肉身也就死去，反之肉身若死去，人偶中的意识也就消散。

items.description_en:
The Thread-Binding Sect can use the Soul Displacement Art to extract part of a living person's consciousness and bind it to a puppet. This allows the puppet to move freely and appear completely lifelike without the need for strings, while obeying its master's every command without question.

For those subjected to Soul Displacement, once their consciousness enters the puppet, it can never return to their body. Though the body remains alive, it is reduced to a mindless shell.

If the puppet is destroyed, the body dies as well. Conversely, if the body dies, the consciousness within the puppet dissipates.

items.name: 幻术要纪
items.raw_name:
塞外边陲，曾有一门派，高徒数人，接踵而逝。

逝者五脏俱裂，经脉尽毁，然阖目若眠，无丝毫痛苦。后有医者，素精幻术，查勘后，叹曰：“此乃毒与幻之合也。毒蚀其身，幻惑其心，故身虽遭厄，而神不自知，临死犹觉安乐。”

items.description_en:
At a remote frontier beyond the pass, there was once a sect whose disciples died one after another.

The dead were found with their organs ruptured and meridians destroyed, yet their eyes were closed as if in sleep, without the slightest sign of pain. A doctor well versed in Phantom Arts later examined the bodies and sighed: "This is the work of poison and illusion combined. The poison ravages the body, while the illusion deceives the mind. Therefore, though the body suffers, the spirit remains unaware, and even at the moment of death, the victim still feels only peace."

[Pearlgrass]
Warm in nature and pungent in flavor. Can be used to make poisons that cause flesh to decay, along with numbness and burning pain.

[Fleeting Ghostcap]
Cold in nature and sweet in flavor. May cause ringing in the ears and dizziness. Can also aid in the practice of Phantom Arts.

[ Loongclaw Flower]
Its petals curl backward, shriveled like claws. It grows mainly in damp, shaded places among mountain rocks. Legend claims it can bring the dead back to life and restore flesh to bare bones. More than a dozen sects once fought to possess it, but it has since vanished from the world.

items.name: 关外门派通考
items.raw_name:
昔年，关外门派虽众，唯“囚命”一派，以其首者“邪主”阴狠暴戾，而江湖闻名。

邪主身形矮小如童子，而面相阴鸷，目如鹰隼。喜以酷刑残害俘虏，更好傀儡邪术，玩弄活人如死物，驱使奴隶如牛马。

后“囚命”为武林正道讨伐，终臣服于龙氏家族。

items.description_en:
In years past, many sects flourished beyond the Pass, but none was more notorious than the Thread-Binding Sect, whose leader, the "Twisted Master," was infamous throughout the Wulin for his cruelty and brutality.

The Twisted Master was small in stature, almost childlike, yet his features were dark and menacing, with eyes like a hawk's. He delighted in torturing captives and was especially fond of sinister Puppetry, treating living people like lifeless objects and driving his slaves like beasts of burden.

The Thread-Binding Sect was later attacked by the forces of the righteous path and ultimately submitted to the Lóng Clan.

items.description_en:
Ninth Day of the Third Moon. Jingzhe.

Cleared the Smuggler's Tunnel.

Captured the leaders "Ghost Eye" Zhang Chengwu and "Nightwalker" Li Silian alive, along with thirteen of their followers. All others were eliminated, leaving the tunnel secured. However, "Digging Rat" Lu Wuxiu feigned surrender and escaped. His whereabouts remain unknown.

The Herald was furious. Several dozen were punished and turned into puppets.

items.name: 【人偶基地簿书】空间拓展
items.raw_name:
冬月十六 小雪

实验规模与日俱增，陆氏村人尽作人偶，意识转移之术渐趋完善。

然梦差大人犹有不悦。基地渐显拥挤，亟需谋求新址，扩张场地。

items.description_en:
Sixteenth Day of the Winter Month. Xiaoxue.

The experiments continue to expand. All villagers of Lu have now been turned into puppets, and the Soul Displacement Art is steadily approaching perfection.

Yet the Herald remains dissatisfied. The base is becoming overcrowded, and a new site must be secured at once to expand operations.

items.row_name: 记录：七巧玲珑与七巧星
items.description_en:
We have confirmed that the Viper of the Seven Venmons possesses two signature poisons.

The first is Silence Poison. Highly toxic, colorless, and odorless. Anyone poisoned by it will die.

The second is Still Poison. Colorless, odorless, and non-toxic. It seals the meridians and induces a state resembling death. Even without an antidote, its effects will naturally wear off after four hours.

items.name: 记录：七巧解药
items.raw_name:
查得梦差冷荼所制七巧解药，可解七巧玲珑与七巧星。

另有一解药，质地与七巧解药极为相似，但仅可延缓七巧玲珑发作时间，不可解毒。
items.description:

另有一解药，质地与七巧解药极为相似，但仅可延缓七巧玲珑发作时间，不可解毒。
items.description_en:
We have confirmed that the Herald Leng Tu developed the Sevenfold Antidote, which can neutralize both Silence Poison and Still Poison.

Another antidote was also found, with a nearly identical texture to the Sevenfold Antidote. However, it can only delay the onset of Silence Poison and cannot neutralize the poison itself.

items.name: 移魂散
items.raw_name:
施行之法：
以<LetterBold>移魂散</>诱使生灵魂识与躯壳剥离。再引游离魂识，强渡里武林之径。最后，封注魂识于偶躯中。

成品状况：
笨拙、痴呆、嗜杀。
注：均因里武林幻径短暂不稳，剥离之意识难以完整。若偶躯与原身相仿，或可增强稳定。

批：
只可充作基本战力，待梦差大人依“零号”改良。

此经旨在广颂圣母无量恩泽，启化愚昧乡民，慰抚移魂操偶所致诸般异象之疑惧，以成圣母之弘愿。

蒙花圣母宝诰

渺渺尘寰里，劫火正洞燃。
怪面显狰狞，苍生苦倒悬。
刀兵长难靖，正道久沦陷。
长夜何漫漫，苦海渺无边。
慈怀圣母尊，济世渡劫难。
只身赴水火，垂怜遍人间。
蒙花结为契，诚心自可见。
旧像隐蒙容，圣意广流传。
祈之定必应，祷之定必安。
大慈复大悲，救苦亦救难……

items.description_en:
This scripture is intended to proclaim the boundless grace of the Lady, enlighten the ignorant villagers, and ease their fears over the strange phenomena caused by Soul Displacement and the manipulation of puppets, all in fulfillment of the Lady's grand wish.

SACRED PROCLAMATION OF THE MERCIFUL LADY OF THE BLOSSOM VEIL

Amid the dust of the mortal world,
Fires of calamity burn unchecked.
Maskwalkers bare their dreadful forms,
And countless lives hang in peril.

Blades know no rest,
The righteous path lies long in ruin.
Endless stretches the darkened night,
Boundless spreads the tide of sorrow.

Then comes the Merciful Lady,
To shelter the world from calamity.
Alone She enters flame and flood,
Her compassion reaching all beneath Heaven.

By the Blossom Veil, the covenant is sealed;
To the sincere, Her presence is revealed.
Her ancient image conceals Her countenance,
Yet Her will travels far and wide.

Pray, and surely there shall be answer.
Call, and surely there shall be peace.
Great in mercy, great in compassion,
She eases suffering and shields against calamity...

I am pleased to hear that research on "Puppet Zero" and the "Perfect Yin Vessel" is progressing well.

items.raw_name:
一、任何入“煌心”工坊者，皆须服下特制药品“七巧星”一剂。
此药效力温和，仅致服用者四肢暂时酥软无力，以便约束行动，绝无性命之虞。离坊之时服下解药，便可即刻恢复如常；亦可选择待两个时辰后药力自行消解。拒不服用者，禁止入内。

二、未经坊主亲允，访客不得擅自离开指定位次或走动观瞧，更不得擅闯重地。否则后果自负。

三、煌心工坊所见所闻，尽为坊内机密，不得于坊外妄言妄议，任何泄密者，后果自负。

……（此类规矩还有十余条。）

items.description_en:
1. Anyone entering the Radiant Heart workshop must take one dose of the specially prepared Still Poison.
The medicine is mild. It merely leaves the limbs temporarily weak and numb so that movement can be controlled, and it poses no threat to life. An antidote will restore the visitor immediately upon departure, or the effects may be allowed to fade naturally after four hours. Anyone who refuses the dose will be denied entry.

2. Without the workshop master's permission, visitors may not leave their assigned positions, wander about, or enter restricted areas. Any consequences will be their own responsibility.

3. Everything seen or heard within the Radiant Heart workshop is confidential. It may not be discussed outside the premises. Anyone who divulges its secrets will bear the consequences.

... (More than ten additional rules follow.)

items.description_en:
Master Bai,

Thanks to your ingenious assistance, the Lady's sacred vessel is nearing completion through the techniques developed for Vessel Zero. Final calibration should be finished within seven days.

This male-bodied Perfect Yang Vessel differs from the Lady's Perfect Yin Vessel in both yin and yang and has required considerable labor. It has been crafted especially for you as a modest token of my gratitude for your invaluable help.

As for visiting the Radiant Heart workshop, I must ask for your understanding and insist that its rules be observed. These precautions are essential to the experiment, and even you cannot be exempt. Should you send a subordinate in your stead, that person must receive a double dose of the required medicine. Rest assured: it will pose no danger to life or martial ability.

Few in the Wulin still dare oppose me. What should I feed it next?

items.raw_name:
“三魂归一”……可为什么……我们没好起来？<LetterBold>三头小娃娃</>……也丢了……

忘掉那可笑的谎话吧！那个<LetterBold>白赤练</>败了！等梦差去了心池，我们就藏到<LetterBold>那片森林</>！

不 再 被 操 控——不！那里不够冷！

那就用你的冰，把那变成冬天！

不不……他会知道……我们……逃不掉的！！！

No more... being controlled—no! It isn't cold enough there!

Then turn it into winter with your ice!

No, no... he'll know... we... can't escape!!!

items.name: 关于“玉琮”的研究笔录
items.raw_name:
“玉琮”之内，寒气、邪火、钢刃之锐意，三力调和，无坚不摧，亦无法分离。

今以幻术试其破绽，“混沌”虽厌冰寒，但反应不敏，而“寒冰”稍遇热物，便会奋力挣扎。若以极热兵刃攻击，可打破三力平衡，令三魂短暂分离……

一旦分离，三魂实力骤减，毫无裨益，可惜可惜。

items.description_en:
Within Yucong, frost, chaos, and steel exist in perfect balance. Together, the three forces are unstoppable, yet impossible to separate.

Through Phantom Arts, I have uncovered a weakness. Though the chaos abhors the cold, it reacts sluggishly. Frost struggles violently when exposed to intense heat. A weapon of extreme heat may shatter the balance between the three forces, briefly separating the three souls... 

Once divided, the three souls lose most of their strength. A pity... What a terrible waste.

These Mandate heroines have a will and lineage that is hundreds of times more useful than those slack-jawed villagers!

And Vessel Zero...such a splendid body, and an outstanding Phantom Art Illusionist! That icy and somber, yet resilient spirit...studying her is breakthrough after breakthrough!

As expected, Master Bai's scheme was truly exceptional. With Vessel Zero in my possession, my research will advance much faster.

终于可以开始“无限煌心”实验了。

一旦此法完成，圣躯便能以煌心作为能量之源，待圣母娘娘的意识完整无缺地转移其中，煌心所生之杀气，必能任圣母娘娘取之不尽用之不竭！

我的圣母娘娘啊，仁德宽厚的圣母娘娘啊，已被那些卑劣的规则束缚于里武林太久了！如今，表里武林，皆可归于圣母娘娘的掌心了！

At last, the Radiant Heart experiment can begin.

Once this method is complete, the Perfect Yin Vessel will draw its power from the Radiant Heart. When the Lady's consciousness has been transferred into it whole and intact, the Sha-Chi generated by the heart will be hers to command without end!

My Lady, my benevolent and merciful Lady, has been bound within the Discordance by those wretched rules for far too long! Soon, both the Waking Realm and the Discordance will rest in the palm of her hand!

items.description:
【第三百六十一日】
今日会晤至高尊者，所议皆妥。待煌心与圣躯结合后，便可实行仪式。

此事何其幸甚！至高尊者得圣婴助力，将“门”打开的时间提前了一甲子之多！

圣母娘娘临世，实属天意！
items.description_en:
Day 361

I met with the High Elder today, and all matters have been settled. Once the Radiant Heart and the Perfect Yin Vessel are joined, the ritual may begin.

What extraordinary fortune! With the Sacred Infant's aid, the High Elder has brought forward the opening of the "gate" by an entire sixty-year cycle!

The Lady's descent into this world is surely the will of Heaven!

items.name: 【梦差实验手札】备用圣躯
items.raw_name:
【第三百六十二日】
那“组织”叛徒实在难测……为防变故，需先将备用圣躯“六号”送至断魂山顶。

Day 362
That traitor from the Order is impossible to predict... As a precaution, the backup vessel, No. 6, must first be sent to the summit of Soulrend Mountain.

items.name: 圣母娘娘之谜
items.description: 蒙花遮面，究竟是为迎圣母降临人间，还是为了遮蔽叩拜者的双眼？
items.description_en: Are their faces veiled in blossoms to welcome the Lady into the mortal realm, or simply to keep her worshippers from seeing the truth?

items.name: 圣母告谕
items.raw_name:
<center>大慈大悲救苦救难蒙花圣母至尊</>

<center>将自净土莲台</>

<center>示微垂迹于尘寰浊世</>

<center>托显一切金身宝像</>

<center>接引沉溺之众生</>

<center>度脱苦厄于无常</>
items.description:
大慈大悲救苦救难蒙花圣母至尊

将自净土莲台

示微垂迹于尘寰浊世

托显一切金身宝像

接引沉溺之众生

度脱苦厄于无常
items.description_en:
The Merciful Lady of the Blossom Veil

Shall descend from Her lotus throne in the Pure Land
And reveal Her divine presence in this troubled mortal world
Manifesting Her sacred form for all to behold
To guide all beings lost in suffering
And deliver them from affliction and impermanence

items.name: 法事榜文：如何面见圣母娘娘？
items.raw_name:
结花为先。备洁净红布三尺，宽约盈掌，结作稠密花团。

再遮面。系花团于面上，遮蔽耳目，隔绝外物。

三入梦。平卧榻上，静气凝神，祈福求愿默念于心。

items.row_name: 法事榜文：如何面见圣母娘娘？
items.description_en:
First, bind the flowers. Prepare three chi of clean red cloth, about a palm's width across, and knot it into a dense cluster of blossoms.

Next, veil the face. Fasten the flower cluster over the face, covering the eyes and ears to shut out the outside world.

Third, enter the dream. Lie flat upon the bed, calm your breath and focus your mind, silently holding your prayers and wishes in your heart.

items.name: 【圣母宝卷】其一：庞声遇圣
items.raw_name:
蒙花圣母者，慈悲济世之神灵也。其使者梦差，常以红花系于诸佛像面容，使圣母得窥人间疾苦。

昔有庞姓青年，名声，生而羸弱。一夕，心口剧痛，呻吟彻夜。庞母得圣母托梦曰：“汝子病根深重，当以绸花覆面，夜寐时诚心默念吾名。”

庞家依法而行，果见庞声沉疴尽去，不日便身强体健，更得武艺傍身。

庞家依法而行，果见庞声沉疴尽去，不日便身强体健，更得武艺傍身。
items.description_en:
The Lady of the Veil is a divine spirit of great compassion, bringing relief to the suffering of the world. Her emissary, the Herald, often ties red blossoms to the faces of Buddha statues, allowing the Lady to witness the suffering of humankind.

There once was a young man named Pang Sheng, frail from birth. One night, he was struck by agonizing pain in his chest and groaned until dawn. The Lady appeared to Pang Sheng’s mother in a dream and said, “Your son’s illness runs deep. Cover his face with a silk blossom, and as he sleeps at night, have him sincerely repeat my name in silence.”

The Pang family followed her instructions. Sure enough, Pang Sheng’s lingering illness vanished. Within days, he had grown strong and healthy, and even acquired martial skill.

items.name: 【圣母宝卷】其二：木人换心
items.raw_name:
祸福相依，盛极必衰。一日，庞声与江湖豪客较技，竟被其长枪贯穿心口。

然一游方术士经过，叹此子与圣母有缘，取良木雕成人形，将庞声心脏纳入其中，又制面具一副，酷似庞声容貌，覆于木人面上。须臾，木人双目忽睁，起身而立，竟比生前更显精神！

庞声死而复生，皆因蒙花圣母护佑。凡遇此等奇事，当知天地间确有圣母娘娘在焉，不可不敬也。

items.description_en:
Fortune and misfortune go hand in hand, and what reaches its height must one day decline. One day, Pang Sheng was matching skills with a Wulin fighter when a spear pierced straight through his chest.

A wandering practitioner happened to pass by. Remarking that the young man was fated to have a connection with the Lady, he took a piece of fine wood and carved it into human form. He placed Pang Sheng’s heart inside, then fashioned a mask in Pang Sheng’s likeness and set it upon the wooden man’s face. Moments later, the wooden man suddenly opened its eyes and rose to its feet, looking even more vigorous than Pang Sheng had in life!

Pang Sheng’s return from death was all thanks to the protection of the Lady of the Veil. Whenever such wonders occur, one should know that the Lady truly exists between heaven and earth and must be treated with reverence.

items.name: 近卫队信神疏
items.raw_name: 蒙花圣母乃涤罪者也。欲消罪孽，长寿长生，当心诚意正，善颂善祷。虔敬奉行者，必得庇佑，善果自至。犹疑怠慢者，必遭灾殃，永世不复！
items.description: 蒙花圣母乃涤罪者也。欲消罪孽，长寿长生，当心诚意正，善颂善祷。虔敬奉行者，必得庇佑，善果自至。犹疑怠慢者，必遭灾殃，永世不复！
items.description_en: The Merciful Lady of the Veil cleanses all sin. Those who seek absolution and long life must be sincere of heart and steadfast in prayer and praise. The devout shall receive her protection and reap good fortune. Those who doubt or neglect her shall suffer calamity and be denied redemption for all eternity!

items.name: 尊者以“镜”封禁遗迹
items.name_en: The High Elder has sealed the ruins with a mirror
items.raw_name:
晚矣，晚矣！

<LetterBold>尊者以“镜”封禁遗迹</>，无信物者皆不得入！吾等徘徊在外，只怕已误接迎圣母之仪……

有识之士勘察“镜面”乃言：<LetterBold>唯诸般灭法之法齐聚，方可开此尘封。</>

然<LetterBold>彼等寄身于草扎之躯</>，遁行于里武林中……以吾等微末之能，安能觅其踪迹……
items.description:
，无信物者皆不得入！吾等徘徊在外，只怕已误接迎圣母之仪……

有识之士勘察“镜面”乃言：唯诸般灭法之法齐聚，方可开此尘封。

然彼等寄身于草扎之躯，遁行于里武林中……以吾等微末之能，安能觅其踪迹……
items.description_en:
. None may enter without a token! We linger outside, fearing we have already missed the rite to welcome the Lady...

Those versed in such matters examined the mirror and declared: Only when all the Acolytes are gathered may this seal be broken.

Yet they inhabit bodies woven of straw, slipping through the Discordance... With our meager arts, how could we ever find them...?

items.name: 至高尊者法旨
items.raw_name:
诸徒听令：

昔有法舟，载我众渡厄海、破迷津，泊于此岸，实乃救世渡人之至宝，通灵显化，神异非常。

今本座命尔等齐聚里武林，倾己身幻法之力，竭至诚至敬之心，重铸王船！

待摆渡之舟落成，圣母自彼岸降世，吾等即以此舟迎奉尊临，沐无上恩泽！

items.description_en:
Hear my command, disciples,

Once, a sacred vessel bore us across the sea of suffering and through the mists of delusion, coming to rest upon this shore. A treasure of salvation, it manifested wondrous powers beyond measure.

Now I command you to gather in the Discordance. Give all the strength of your Phantom Arts, with utmost reverence and devotion, to rebuild the Spectral Vessel!

When the vessel is complete and the Lady descends from the far shore, we shall welcome her aboard and receive her boundless grace!

items.name: 凌乱的字条
items.raw_name:
为奉圣母，众皆狂悖。违逆者，缄口者，尽遭屠戮……非也非也……妄也，诳语也，妖言也！

凡有此念者，皆当诛灭！诛灭……不可，不……不信不信信信信信亻言亻言亻言亻言言言口口口二二二一一一

All have gone mad in their devotion to the Lady. Those who defy her, those who keep silent, all are slaughtered... No, no... Falsehood! Lies! Blasphemy!

All who harbor such thoughts must be destroyed! Destroyed... No, mustn't... don't... believe don't believe believe believe believe believ belie beli bel be b b b-

items.name: 圣母娘娘真身图
items.raw_name:
漫天星宿通浊海，无尽乾坤皆法相。
噬灭穹隆吞宙宇，重开万古作仙乡。
items.description:
漫天星宿通浊海，无尽乾坤皆法相。
噬灭穹隆吞宙宇，重开万古作仙乡。
items.description_en:
Stars across the heavens open into the Sea of Blight; all the endless cosmos becomes her sacred form.

She devours the firmament and swallows the universe, remaking eternity into an immortal paradise.

items.name: 星表
items.raw_name:
宇宙玄奥，常显诸异。诸异之上，更有至异。非星非辰，非云非气，所至处，经纬失衡，星度离偏，寰宇晦暗。

古贤只知其蔓生穹隆，无以穷尽，未知其因何而起，源头何在。故以星表记之，名曰：“浊侵”。
items.description:
宇宙玄奥，常显诸异。诸异之上，更有至异。非星非辰，非云非气，所至处，经纬失衡，星度离偏，寰宇晦暗。

古贤只知其蔓生穹隆，无以穷尽，未知其因何而起，源头何在。故以星表记之，名曰：“浊侵”。
items.description_en:
The cosmos is filled with mysteries and wonders beyond reckoning. Yet above all stands the greatest anomaly, neither star nor moon, neither cloud nor mist. Wherever it passes, the celestial order falters, the courses of the heavens drift astray, and the firmament grows dim.

Ancient sages knew only that it spread across the vault of heaven without end. None could fathom how it came to be, nor where its source lay. Thus, they marked it upon the star charts and named it the Blight.

items.name: 各式发愿文
items.description: 众口万愿，不知圣母娘娘听了哪一条。可有谁真的心愿得偿，前来还愿？
items.description_en: Countless voices, countless wishes. Who knows which of them the Lady of the Veil has truly heard? And has anyone ever had their wish granted, then returned to redeem their vows?

items.name: 给圣母的祷文
items.raw_name:
弟子半生刀头舔血，死不足惜！然大哥待我如手足，救我于穷途……今弟子以残躯为祭，求娘娘慈悲，引我大哥出此木人之村，得见天日！

弟子徐威叩首，蒙花百拜。
items.description:
弟子半生刀头舔血，死不足惜！然大哥待我如手足，救我于穷途……今弟子以残躯为祭，求娘娘慈悲，引我大哥出此木人之村，得见天日！

弟子徐威叩首，蒙花百拜。
items.description_en:
I have spent half my life living by the blade. If death comes for me, I have no regrets. But my elder brother treated me as his own kin and saved me when I had nowhere left to turn...

Now I offer this broken body as a sacrifice and beg the Lady of the Veil for mercy. Guide my brother out of this village of Wooden Puppets, and let him see the light of day once more!

Xu Wei bows, blossom veiled, a hundred times.

items.name: 周川发愿文
items.raw_name:
敬祈圣母娘娘垂听：

弟子周川，庞镇人氏。家母卧病日久，昏睡不醒，形容消瘦。弟子遍访良医，未见起色。今闻娘娘圣德广大，特来叩拜，恳请娘娘慈悲，庇佑家母早日康复。

<right>弟子 周川 敬上</>
