弟子 周川 敬上
items.description_en:
May the Lady hear my prayer:

I, your disciple Zhou Chuan of Pangzhen, humbly petition you. My mother has been ill for a long time, sleeping without waking and wasting away. I have sought out every skilled physician, yet none has helped. Having heard of the Lady's boundless virtue, I come to kneel before you and beg for your mercy. Please bless my mother with a swift recovery.

Respectfully, Zhou Chuan

items.name: 李幺妹发愿文
items.raw_name:
求娘娘眷顾。眼下湖水涨落失了准，实在不好下网。村子外头又总是打打杀杀的，不好卖鱼……求娘娘慈悲，保佑我家能过安稳日子，也保佑梅谷村风调雨顺。信女给您磕头了。

<right>梅谷村 李幺妹</>
items.description:
求娘娘眷顾。眼下湖水涨落失了准，实在不好下网。村子外头又总是打打杀杀的，不好卖鱼……求娘娘慈悲，保佑我家能过安稳日子，也保佑梅谷村风调雨顺。信女给您磕头了。

梅谷村 李幺妹
items.description_en:
Lady, please watch over us. The lake no longer rises and falls as it should, making it terribly difficult to cast our nets. There is constant fighting outside the village, too, so the fish are hard to sell... Merciful Lady, please grant my family a peaceful life and bless Meigu Village with fair winds and timely rain. This faithful woman bows before you.

Li Yaomei of Meigu Village

items.name: 王益仁发愿文
items.raw_name:
敬祈神明垂听：

弟子益仁，近日邂逅庞氏之女静茹，淑女品貌俱佳，家学渊源，自此一见倾心。弟子自知出身寒微，难许佳人荣华富贵，故而自愿入赘庞府，承彼家业，扬庞氏家声，伏乞圣母成全！

<right>庞镇 王益仁 敬拜</>
items.description:
敬祈神明垂听：

弟子益仁，近日邂逅庞氏之女静茹，淑女品貌俱佳，家学渊源，自此一见倾心。弟子自知出身寒微，难许佳人荣华富贵，故而自愿入赘庞府，承彼家业，扬庞氏家声，伏乞圣母成全！

庞镇 王益仁 敬拜
items.description_en:
May the divine hear my prayer:

I, your disciple Yiren, recently met Jingru, daughter of the Pang family. She is graceful, virtuous, and from a distinguished household, and I fell in love at first sight. I know my humble birth cannot offer her wealth or honor, so I willingly ask to marry into the Pang household, inherit its estate, and uphold the family name. I beg the Lady to bring this union to pass!

Wang Yiren of Pangzhen, in reverent worship

items.name: 不肖子孙三迁发愿文
items.raw_name:
敬祈大慈大悲圣母娘娘垂听：

陆氏十六世孙三迁叩首。陆氏祖上失德，误借神佛风水宝地修建宗祠，罪孽深重，幸而娘娘仁慈，托梦点拨，使陆氏得以弥补罪过。今村中怪病肆虐，木人横行，还望娘娘再度垂怜，为陆氏指点乾坤，度脱苦难！

<right>愚叟 陆三迁 敬上</>
items.description:
敬祈大慈大悲圣母娘娘垂听：

陆氏十六世孙三迁叩首。陆氏祖上失德，误借神佛风水宝地修建宗祠，罪孽深重，幸而娘娘仁慈，托梦点拨，使陆氏得以弥补罪过。今村中怪病肆虐，木人横行，还望娘娘再度垂怜，为陆氏指点乾坤，度脱苦难！

愚叟 陆三迁 敬上
items.description_en:
May the great and merciful Lady hear my prayer:

Lu Sanqian, sixteenth-generation descendant of the Lu family, bows before you. Our ancestors acted without virtue and wrongfully built their ancestral hall upon sacred ground blessed by gods and buddhas. Their sin was grave. Fortunately, the Lady showed mercy and gave guidance in a dream, allowing the Lu family to make amends. Now a strange sickness ravages the village and wooden puppets roam unchecked. I beg the Lady to show compassion once more, guide our path, and deliver us from suffering!

Respectfully, the foolish old man,Lu Sanqian

items.name: 被武当派涂抹的发愿文
items.raw_name:
陈兄：

我等正道中人，岂能向邪教妖邪发愿祈福？若再拉拢我入教，莫怪小弟割席绝交！

<right>武当 陆冲云</>
items.description:
陈兄：

我等正道中人，岂能向邪教妖邪发愿祈福？若再拉拢我入教，莫怪小弟割席绝交！

武当 陆冲云
items.row_name: 被武当派涂抹的发愿文
items.description_en:
Brother Chen,

How can those of us who follow the righteous path pray for blessings from a wicked cult? Try to draw me into this faith again, and do not blame your younger brother for severing all ties with you!

Lu Chongyun of Wudang

items.name: 无名的发愿文
items.raw_name: 免得仇家发现，我就不留名姓了。圣母娘娘，我不求名利，只求您为我洗脱罪责，不必再四处躲藏，颠沛流离，让我也能得个安然终老！
items.description: 免得仇家发现，我就不留名姓了。圣母娘娘，我不求名利，只求您为我洗脱罪责，不必再四处躲藏，颠沛流离，让我也能得个安然终老！
items.description_en: So my enemies cannot find me, I will leave no name. Lady, I ask for neither fame nor wealth. I ask only that you cleanse me of my guilt, free me from a life of hiding and wandering, and let me live out my remaining years in peace!

items.name: 血刀门发愿文
items.raw_name:
血刀门韩一刀，今来上香求愿。“组织”不仅毁我祭坛，夺我祭品，更使我所炼绝世武功功败垂成！

望蒙花圣母娘娘为我做主，降灾祸于“组织”！若您老人家应验显灵，韩某愿奉上数十红祭！
items.description:
血刀门韩一刀，今来上香求愿。“组织”不仅毁我祭坛，夺我祭品，更使我所炼绝世武功功败垂成！

望蒙花圣母娘娘为我做主，降灾祸于“组织”！若您老人家应验显灵，韩某愿奉上数十红祭！
items.description_en:
I, Han Yidao of the Scarlet Knife Sect, have come to burn incense and make my petition. The Order destroyed my altar, stole my offerings, and even ruined the peerless Kungfu I was cultivating before it could be completed!

Merciful Lady of the Veil, bring judgment upon the Order and cast disaster upon it! Should your divine power answer my prayer, I, Han, will offer dozens of blood sacrifices in return!

items.name: 霹雳堂陈虎头发愿
items.raw_name: 俺，霹雳堂陈虎头。不大信什么神鬼仙魔，只信手上炸弹，背后弟兄！蒙花圣母，若你真像那什么告谕、宝卷上说的那么大能耐，那就助我霹雳堂天下无敌！到时候，俺给你立一座金像！
items.description: 俺，霹雳堂陈虎头。不大信什么神鬼仙魔，只信手上炸弹，背后弟兄！蒙花圣母，若你真像那什么告谕、宝卷上说的那么大能耐，那就助我霹雳堂天下无敌！到时候，俺给你立一座金像！
items.description_en: I'm Chen Hutou of the Sky-Thunder Sect. I don't put much faith in ghosts, gods, immortals, or fiends. I believe in the bombs in my hands and the brothers at my back! Lady of the Veil, if you're really as powerful as those proclamations and aacred scrolls claim, then make the Sky-Thunder Sect invincible! Do that, and I'll build you a statue of solid gold!

items.name: 戏梦山庄的过往
items.description:
依山傍水起层轩，百戏争辉胜昼天。
门连闹市通商旅，广纳宾朋列玉筵。
演武台高争雅券，宫商调里醉华烟。
莫道断魂邻禁地，笙歌一曲隔云边。
items.description_en:
Tiered halls rise where mountain meets stream,
A hundred spectacles outshine the light of day.

Its gates join the bustling market, where merchants and travelers pass,
Guests gather from afar before tables spread with finest fare.

High on the martial stage, elegant tokens are fiercely won,
Amid graceful melodies, all revel in splendid haze.

Never mind that Soulrend lies beside forbidden ground,
One song of pipes and strings carries beyond the clouds.

items.name: 戏梦山庄图释
items.raw_name:
本商会旧址，初为小筑，后扩为山庄。今再拟扩建，依山就水，延展四隅。

前接庞镇集市，便通商贾；后虽倚断魂禁地，可砌石为界，据地势之威以安基业。
items.description:
本商会旧址，初为小筑，后扩为山庄。今再拟扩建，依山就水，延展四隅。

前接庞镇集市，便通商贾；后虽倚断魂禁地，可砌石为界，据地势之威以安基业。
items.description_en:
This former site of our merchant guild began as a modest residence and was later expanded into an estate. We now propose a further expansion, following the contours of the mountains and waterways and extending outward on all sides.

To the front lies Pangzhen Market, providing easy access for merchants and trade. Though the rear borders the Forbidden Grounds of Soulrend, a stone boundary can be raised there, using the natural strength of the terrain to secure the estate.

items.name: 余成章
items.raw_name:
谨此列名铭志，十二本邑翘楚，同启鼎新之业。

<LetterBold>余成章</>
将门之后，开设武馆兵器铺，群侠敬重。

<LetterBold>姚乐天</>
主酒肆客栈，性烈人豪，门下昼夜喧腾如沸。

<LetterBold>高渊</>
香料、药材巨擘。商号远通西域，惠及黎庶。雅好民俗技艺，广结江湖奇士。

<LetterBold>柳千帆</>
……

items.description_en:
Born to a military family, he established a martial arts school and weapons shop and is highly respected among the heroes of the Wulin.

Yao Letian
Proprietor of a tavern and inn. Fiery in temperament and bold by nature, his establishments bustle with noise day and night.

Gao Yuan
A leading merchant in spices and medicinal herbs. His business reaches as far as the Western Regions and benefits common folk far and wide. He has a refined appreciation for folk arts and customs and keeps company with many remarkable figures of the Wulin.

Liu Qianfan
...

items.name: 三杰赋
items.raw_name:
幸得三杰齐到访，群英慕名至，偶戏佳声扬。

席间，玉音子潜心宫商，以指叩案，妙韵和鸣；荒行子兀自独酌，偶发一语，必点武道迷津；墨玑子温润随性，与吾辈以诗佐酒，尽抒江湖豪情。

可叹世道多舛，怪面横生。幸有三杰仗剑，扶正道于将倾！且尽杯中，同醉此宵，共咏昆仑英雄！

items.description_en:
To celebrate the visit of the Pillars of Kunlun, heroes gathered from far and wide, and the puppet theater resounded with splendid song.

At the feast, Yuyin devoted herself to melody, tapping the table with her fingers as wondrous notes answered in harmony. Huangxing drank alone, yet each occasional word he spoke illuminated the mysteries of martial cultivation. Moji was gentle and easygoing, joining us in poetry and wine as we gave full voice to the heroic spirit of the Wulin.

Alas, the world is beset by misfortune, and Maskwalkers rise everywhere. Fortunately, the Pillars of Kunlun still take up their swords to support the righteous path as it teeters on the brink! Empty your cups, share in tonight's revelry, and sing of the heroes of Kunlun!

items.name: 废弃的武训
items.raw_name:
诸位护院：

演武场乃我等切磋技艺、精进武功之地，当点到为止，不得结怨生仇。

胜者可得雅座戏票一张，与众宾客同赏同乐！

望诸位奋勇争先，一展所长！
items.description:
诸位护院：

演武场乃我等切磋技艺、精进武功之地，当点到为止，不得结怨生仇。

胜者可得雅座戏票一张，与众宾客同赏同乐！

望诸位奋勇争先，一展所长！
items.description_en:
Guards,

The training grounds are where we spar and refine our martial skills. All bouts should stop at first touch. Do not bear grudges or make enemies. 

The victor will receive one premium theater ticket, to enjoy the performance alongside our honored guests! 

May you all compete bravely and show your finest skill!

items.name: 水行帮拾遗
items.description:
梅谷湖上曾有一支水帮，不问来者名姓过往，只凭水性高低、渔获多少来论英雄。

若有落魄失意之人流落至此，也能讨得几杯浊酒，就着潮声与灯影，饮下半生风霜。
items.description_en:
There was once a waterborne crew on Meigu Lake that cared nothing for a newcomer's name or past. A person was judged only by their skill on the water and the size of their catch.

And if some weary, down-on-their-luck soul happened to drift this way, they could still earn a few cups of rough wine, drinking away half a lifetime of hardship to the sound of the water and the glow of lanterns.

items.name: 讨贼告示
items.raw_name:
<center>怪面犯我梅谷村，</>

<center>豪侠集结讨贼人。</>

<center>扫尽邪祟清天地，</>

<center>匡扶武林正乾坤！</>
items.description:
怪面犯我梅谷村，

豪侠集结讨贼人。

扫尽邪祟清天地，

匡扶武林正乾坤！

items.name: 【停水忆录】其一：比试
items.raw_name:
刀剑在手二十载，比试武功，我未有败绩。直到我遇上一个自称“改造者”的铁面怪人。

不过三招，我不得还手， 而他根本未用全力……我向师父解释，只落得一句：“我门下没有你这般无用的弟子。”便被逐出山门。
items.description:
刀剑在手二十载，比试武功，我未有败绩。直到我遇上一个自称“改造者”的铁面怪人。

不过三招，我不得还手， 而他根本未用全力……我向师父解释，只落得一句：“我门下没有你这般无用的弟子。”便被逐出山门。
items.description_en:
For twenty years, with blade in hand, I never lost a martial contest. Then I met an iron-masked man who called himself a Transcended.

In only three moves, I was left unable to fight back—and he had not even used his full strength... I tried to explain myself to my master, but received only one reply: "I have no disciple as useless as you." Then I was expelled from the sect.

items.name: 【停水忆录】其二：盼头
items.raw_name:
我酒醉落水，又被人网了上来。那七八个吵闹的打渔汉。有的看笑话，有的埋怨我搅了打好的鱼窝，还有人琢磨我算不算是水产。

有的说话太不中听，我便与他们动起手来，我还想动剑，就被一青衣汉子按住了。他有种不容置疑的气势：“都住手，这个小兄弟，跟我来。”

他没问我的来历，只是请我吃酒。第二日，他带我到河边，教我叉鱼。
items.description:

有的说话太不中听，我便与他们动起手来，我还想动剑，就被一青衣汉子按住了。他有种不容置疑的气势：“都住手，这个小兄弟，跟我来。”

他没问我的来历，只是请我吃酒。第二日，他带我到河边，教我叉鱼。
items.description_en:
Drunk, I fell into the water and was hauled back up in someone's net. Seven or eight noisy fishermen crowded around me. Some laughed, some complained that I had ruined a good fishing spot, and one wondered aloud whether I counted as part of the catch.

A few of their remarks were more than I could tolerate, so I started a fight. I was about to draw my sword when a man in blue pinned me down. His presence brooked no argument. "Enough. Young man, come with me."

He never asked where I came from. He simply invited me to drink. The next day, he took me to the river and taught me how to spear fish.

items.name: 【停水忆录】其三：输赢
items.raw_name:
水行帮的弟兄，有的曾是悍匪，有的做过镖师，也有的只是寻常渔人。他们教我结网打渔，教我看水识鱼，同我在月夜饮酒烤鱼。

上月，帮主问我：“还念着高低成败吗？”我看着自己被水泡得发白的手，笑了：“帮里逞英雄的弟兄太多了，我还是多让让他们吧。”

items.description_en:
The brothers of the Blackwater Crew included former bandits, retired escorts, and ordinary fishermen. They taught me to knot nets, read the water, and find the fish. At night, we drank wine and roasted our catch beneath the moon.

Not long ago, the leader asked me, "Do victory and defeat still matter to you?" I looked at my hands, pale from the water, and laughed. "There are already too many brothers in the crew eager to play the hero. I should give them more chances to shine."

items.name: 水行帮武帖
items.raw_name:
江湖同道，四海英豪！今我水行帮主游龙寿辰！

哪怕不为寿辰，只为水战知音，更当设此水擂，邀各路好汉，以武会友，一展绝技！

<right>水行帮帮主 游龙</>
items.description:
江湖同道，四海英豪！今我水行帮主游龙寿辰！

哪怕不为寿辰，只为水战知音，更当设此水擂，邀各路好汉，以武会友，一展绝技！

水行帮帮主 游龙
items.description_en:
Fellow wanderers of the Wulin, heroes from across the land! Today is the birthday of You Loong, leader of the Blackwater Crew!

Even setting the birthday aside, kindred spirits who understand combat upon the water deserve a tournament of their own. We invite heroes of every path to meet through martial skill and display their finest techniques!

You Loong, Leader of the Blackwater Crew

items.name: 水行帮簿册
items.raw_name:
【帮会资产】
梅谷东段三水里……不对！是整片梅谷湖！！！
渔船十八艘（大小不等）、各式渔网
游龙叉
帮会大院一座、陈年老酒十八坛
欠老王家酒钱三十二文（已付清！）

第十二代帮主，游龙。
功绩：豪夺码头，义救落水童子，智斗商会……一杆游龙叉，连贯十八条黑背大鲢！

items.description_en:
[Crew Assets]
-About a mile of water in eastern Meigu... No! The entire Meigu Lake!!!
-Eighteen fishing boats of various sizes, plus assorted fishing nets
-The Loong Trident
-One crew compound and eighteen jars of aged wine
-Thirty-two coins owed to Old Wang's tavern (PAID IN FULL!)

[Crew Leader]
-Twelfth leader: You Loong.
-Achievements: seized the docks, heroically rescued a drowning child, outwitted the merchants' guild... and skewered eighteen black-backed silver carp in a row with the Loong Trident!

items.name: 琐碎的游记残页
items.raw_name:
……这里村人皆是凫水的好手，就连黄毛小儿，尚不善跑，却已精通潜游闭气……

今日日头已落，四处瘴气，不见故人，不如先在树下将就一夜……
items.description:
……这里村人皆是凫水的好手，就连黄毛小儿，尚不善跑，却已精通潜游闭气……

今日日头已落，四处瘴气，不见故人，不如先在树下将就一夜……
items.description_en:
...Everyone in this village is a strong swimmer. Even the little children, who can scarcely run, already know how to dive and hold their breath...

The sun has set. Miasma hangs everywhere, and there is no sign of my old friend. I may as well spend the night beneath this tree...

items.raw_name:
【一排破败的茅屋布局图，旁边打了“叉”】

未见生还者。

No survivors found.

[An otherwise unremarkable stretch of riverbank, with several places circled]
(Note below:)
I wonder where the Blackwater Crew has gone...

items.name: 搁浅的纸船
items.raw_name:
（将纸船展开，是几行歪歪扭扭的字迹，似是尚在学字的孩童所写。）

水里有好多鱼怪，伤了好多人，夜里还有东西在豪叫。

阿姐和我朵在屋里，干良快吃完了……救救我们……
items.description:
（将纸船展开，是几行歪歪扭扭的字迹，似是尚在学字的孩童所写。）

items.description_en:
(Unfolding the paper boat reveals several crooked lines of writing, apparently made by a child still learning their characters.)

There are so many fish monsters in the water. They hurt lots of people. Something howls at night, too.

Sister and I are hiding in the house. We're almost out of food... Please save us...

items.name: 虚空留下的记忆之花
items.description: 并非所有的记忆，都用来被遗忘。聆听花的声音吧，或可对此行有所助益。
items.description_en: Not all memories are meant to be forgotten. Listen to the voice within the flower; it may prove helpful on this journey.

items.row_name: 白赤练的残存记忆·其一

items.name: 白赤练的记忆之花
items.description: 林映林，镜生镜，四面皆是她自己的倒影，而没有一条路，能让她走出这昼夜不分的囚笼。
items.description_en: Forest reflects forest, mirror reflects mirror. On every side, she sees only her own reflection, with no path leading out of this prison where day and night blur into one.

items.row_name: 有关“龙体”的残存记忆·其一

items.name: 有关“龙体之术”的记忆之花
items.raw_name: 有关“龙体之术”的记忆之花
items.description:
昆仑三杰的盛名仿佛还回荡在昨日，可仍在率领正道坚守大营的，已仅余荒行子一人。

而他执起一把名为“龙体之术”的刀，刺开了正道之中早已有之的裂痕。
items.row_name: 有关“龙体之术”的记忆之花
items.description_en:
It seems only yesterday that the Pillars of Kunlun were renowned throughout the Wulin, yet now Huangxing alone remains to lead the Mandate in holding the camp.

And he has taken up a blade called "Perfect Transcension," cutting open a divide that had long existed within the Mandate.

items.name: 其一：同门之谊
items.row_name: 有关“同门”的残存记忆·其一

items.name: 其二：三令五申
items.row_name: 有关“同门”的残存记忆·其二
