持续20秒自身对敌人造成的点燃、麻痹、冰冻、大出血状态积累速度+70%，并回复30%生命值。
持续25秒自身对敌人造成的点燃、麻痹、冰冻、大出血状态积累速度+70%，并回复40%生命值。
items.description_en:
Before every performance, wine was poured in offering: first to pray for blessings from gods and spirits, then for the peace and well-being of the audience. But ever since the Estate changed hands, the ritualists have never removed their Nuo Masks, and the spirits within have grown ever more rampant with each exorcism.

Increases Burn, Paralysis, Freeze, and Bleed buildup rate by 50% for 15 seconds and restores 20% HP.

items.name: 长生饮
items.description:
本是商旅贩运的药饮，却于半途为强盗所劫。强盗将此物视作珍奇，无奈不通机巧之术，至死亦未能尝得半滴。

回复全部生命值。
effects: 回复全部生命值。
回复全部生命值。饮用后10秒内，生命值保持全满状态时，+10%对敌人造成的伤害。
回复全部生命值。饮用后15秒内，生命值保持全满状态时，+10%对敌人造成的伤害。
回复全部生命值。饮用后15秒内，生命值保持全满状态时，+20%对敌人造成的伤害。
回复全部生命值，饮用后20秒内，生命值保持全满状态时，+20%对敌人造成的伤害。
items.description_en:
Originally a medicinal drink transported by merchants, it was stolen by bandits along the way. The bandits treasured it as a rare curiosity, but knowing nothing of its ingenious mechanism, they went to their graves without ever tasting a single drop.

Restores all HP.

items.name: 禁忌合剂
items.description:
流窜于里武林深处的杀手们秘传的药剂。将亡者的杀气与不稳定的幻术残渣混合制成。不仅能迅速疗愈伤躯，更可强行汲取里武林的能量为己所用。

在15秒内+10%影之武装伤害，同时回复20%生命值。
effects: 在15秒内+10%影之武装伤害，同时回复20%生命值。
在15秒内+15%影之武装伤害，同时回复20%生命值。
在15秒内+15%影之武装伤害，同时回复30%生命值。
在15秒内+20%影之武装伤害，同时回复30%生命值。
在15秒内+20%影之武装伤害，同时回复40%生命值。
items.description_en:
A secret tonic passed among assassins who lurk in the depths of the Discordance. Brewed from the Sha-Chi of the dead and unstable remnants of Phantom Arts, it rapidly heals injuries while allowing the user to forcibly draw power from the Discordance itself.

Increases Phantom Edge damage by 10% for 15 seconds and restores 20% HP.

items.name: 悲鸣药
items.description:
原为“组织”蛇屋制作，似乎流落到了江湖之中。封存着残缺的悲伤记忆的药瓶。

持续30秒对敌人的伤害+10%，同时回复20%生命值。
effects: 持续30秒对敌人的伤害+10%，同时回复20%生命值。
持续30秒对敌人的伤害+10%，同时回复30%生命值。

持续40秒对敌人的伤害+20%，同时回复40%生命值。
items.description_en:
A medicine developed by the Order's Serpent House that somehow found its way into the Wulin. Sealed within the bottle are fragments of sorrowful memories.

Increases damage dealt to enemies by 10% for 30 seconds and restores 20% HP.

items.name: 黑伤（逃亡）
items.description: 轻便的行装，历经那场惊天动地却无人见证的对决后，已然残破，但仍与魂的身法相得益彰。
items.description_en: Light traveling gear, left worn and tattered by a duel that shook heaven and earth with no one there to witness it. Even so, it still moves as one with Soul's footwork.

items.name: 黑伤
items.description: 轻便的行装，兼顾防护与灵活。施展“鬼步”时，可见一道暗红随身法飞扬，乱敌眼目，难辨衣影与刀光。
items.description_en: Light traveling gear that balances protection with freedom of movement. When Ghoststep is unleashed, a streak of dark crimson flies with every motion, confounding the enemy's eye until cloth and blade blur into one.

items.name: 传承
items.description:
不着甲胄，唯有宗师的从容。力量、血脉、身世……那些寂寥时分掠过心头的困惑，如今皆有了答案。

达成特定结局后解锁。
effects: 达成特定结局后解锁。
items.description_en:
No armor, only a grandmaster's composure. Strength, bloodline, origin... every doubt that drifted through his mind in the quiet hours has finally found its answer.

Unlock by reaching a specific ending.

items.name: 武林传说
items.description: 或许多年之后，武林中仍流传着这个侠客的故事。世间无人能追及他的“影”，亦无人可招架他的“刃”。
items.description_en: Perhaps many years from now, the tale of this wandering swordsman will still be told throughout the martial world. None in this world could ever match his Phantom, nor turn aside his Blade.

items.name: 风雪
items.description:
武人的旅装，早已将风雪饮尽。衣袋中叠放着少年的画像，紧系着一位父亲的执念。

达成特定结局后解锁。
effects: 达成特定结局后解锁。
items.description_en:
A warrior's traveling attire that long ago drank its fill of wind and snow. Folded in its pocket lies the portrait of a young boy, and bound up with it, a father's unrelenting obsession.

Unlock by reaching a specific ending.

items.name: 追命
items.description:
宽博的猎装，兜帽厚实，疾行时压得住扑面的风。除却时间，没什么能轻取魂的性命。

达成任意结局后解锁。
effects: 达成任意结局后解锁。
items.description_en:
A loose hunter's garb with a hood heavy enough to hold back the wind at a dead run. Nothing takes Soul's life easily. Nothing but time.

Unlock by reaching any ending.

items.name: 故友
items.description:
制式庄重的武服，叠覆鱼鳞札甲，尤适阵地鏖战。也许不久的来日，他们还会再见。小酌几杯，吃一顿便饭。

达成任意结局后解锁。
effects: 达成任意结局后解锁。
items.description_en:
A dignified martial uniform layered with scale armor, ideal for holding the line in a long, grinding battle. Perhaps before long they will meet again. A few drinks, a simple meal.

Unlock by reaching any ending.

items.name: 机械魔躯
items.description: 杀气随血脉同沸，涌动于战甲之中，将其淬出一重奇异的赤红。
items.description_en: Sha-Chi comes to a boil with the blood in his veins and surges through the war-plate, tempering it to a strange, deep crimson.
